story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: مرحبًا

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I just wanted to check in before I get busy again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: كنت أريد فقط أن أتأكد قبل أن أبدأ بالانشغال مرة أخرى

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: How are you feeling today, really?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: كيف تشعر اليوم، حقًا؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Still stiff, and it’s annoying not being able to get up whenever I want
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: لا زلت متصلبًا، ومن المزعج عدم القدرة على النهوض متى أردت

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: But you’re healing, and that’s what matters, even if it feels slow
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: لكنّك تتعافى، وهذا ما يهم، حتى لو شعرت أن الأمر بطيء

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You also need to stop blaming yourself for everything
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: عليك أيضًا أن تتوقف عن لوم نفسك على كل شيء

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You didn’t choose to get hurt, and you’re not a burden for needing help
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: لم تختر أن تتأذى، وأنت لست عبئًا لاحتياجك للمساعدة

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m trying
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: أحاول

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s just hard to feel useful when I’m stuck in bed all day
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: من الصعب فقط أن أشعر بأنني مفيد عندما أكون عالقًا في السرير طوال اليوم

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: مرحبًا

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: أعرف

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: By the way, how does your new phone feel so far?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: بالمناسبة، كيف يبدو هاتفك الجديد حتى الآن؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Does everything look like it transferred correctly from the old one?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: هل يبدو أن كل شيء تم نقله بشكل صحيح من النسخة القديمة؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Yeah, surprisingly
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: نعم، بشكل مفاجئ

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s fast, and everything seems to be in the right place
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: إنه سريع، وكل شيء يبدو في المكان الصحيح

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I barely had to redo my settings
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: لم أضطر لإعادة إعداداتي تقريبًا

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: جيد

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: The guy who sold it to me kept insisting it was a solid model
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: الرجل الذي باعه لي كان يصر على أنه نموذج متين

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks again for getting it for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: شكرًا مرة أخرى على الحصول عليه لي

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know you didn’t have to, but it really helps right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: أعلم أنك لم تضطر إلى ذلك، لكن هذا يساعد حقًا الآن

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Did I wake you up, or were you already drifting in and out?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: هل أيقظتك، أم كنت تتنقل بين النوم واليقظة بالفعل؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Of course it helps
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: بالطبع يساعد

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You deserve nice things too, even if you don’t always believe that
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: أنت تستحق أشياء جميلة أيضًا، حتى لو لم تكن تؤمن بذلك دائمًا.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: …Okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: …حسناً

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Actually, there’s one thing I still need for the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: في الواقع، هناك شيء واحد لا زلت بحاجة إليه للهاتف الجديد

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s asking for a clean contact photo, and the one I had is ancient
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: إنه يطلب صورة شخصية نظيفة، والصورة التي كانت لدي قديمة.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Oh
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: أوه

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You want a new photo of me for your contacts?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: هل تريد صورة جديدة لي لجهات الاتصال الخاصة بك؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Alright, give me a second
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: حسناً، انتظر لحظة

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: بعد دقيقتين

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I was already awake, don’t worry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: كنت مستيقظًا بالفعل، لا تقلق

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: A little, but it’s fine, I’m glad you texted
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: قليلاً، لكن لا بأس، أنا سعيد أنك أرسلت رسالة

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: There
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: هناك

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: If that one looks terrible, you’re not allowed to complain
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: إذا كانت تلك تبدو فظيعة، فلا يُسمح لك بالشكوى

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s perfect
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: إنه مثالي

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: شكرًا

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Try to rest
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: حاول أن تستريح

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’ll bring you something to eat later and check on you again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: سأحضر لك شيئًا لتأكله لاحقًا وسأتحقق منك مرة أخرى

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: شكراً، {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: جيد

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I keep forgetting you can’t really do much besides stare at that screen right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: أستمر في نسيان أنك لا تستطيع فعل الكثير سوى التحديق في تلك الشاشة الآن

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: أنا آسف

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: I can hear you moving around
{{name:evelyn}} told me you needed a profile pic from me, right?
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:evelyn}} قالت لي إنك تحتاج صورة بروفايل مني، صح؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: Try not to ghost the world today
You always have something to say

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I actually needed a new contact photo for you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: كنت بحاجة فعلاً إلى صورة جديدة للاتصال بك

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: So this is what I’m reduced to now 😭
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: لذا هذا ما أصبحت عليه الآن 😭

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Are you awake, or are you doing that thing where you pretend you’re asleep? 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: هل أنت مستيقظ، أم أنك تفعل ذلك الشيء حيث تتظاهر أنك نائم؟ 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I was just checking on you

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: ما زلت عالقًا ما زلت متصلبًا

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: You’ve got the same energy as a sad houseplant 🌱
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: لديك نفس طاقة نبات منزلي حزين 🌱
أنا مستيقظ. ماذا هناك، أيها العفريت؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Maybe I was pretending. Depends who’s asking
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: يمكن أن أكون أتصنع. يعتمد على من يسأل

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Text me if you need anything
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: أرسل لي رسالة إذا كنت بحاجة إلى أي شيء

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I’m about to post a story and a new post
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: أنا على وشك نشر قصة ومنشور جديد

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I'm the cutest girl you know 💅

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: But you should at least respond to her texts
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: لكن يجب عليك على الأقل الرد على رسائلها

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: You don’t have to prove it to me
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: لا تحتاج إلى إثبات ذلك لي

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: Did you drink any water yet

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Well i’m okay though, at least not dead
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: حسناً، أنا بخير على أي حال، على الأقل لست ميتاً.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I understand but it’s not your fault
Rest and heal, you being alive is more important than the rest for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: استرح وشفِ، كونك على قيد الحياة أهم بالنسبة لي من كل شيء آخر.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: And I’m here if you need me ❤️
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: وأنا هنا إذا كنت بحاجة إلي ❤️

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Also part of why I’ve been slow to reply is the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: جزء من سبب بطئي في الرد هو الهاتف الجديد

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: By the way can you send me a profile picture?
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: بالمناسبة، هل يمكنك إرسال صورة ملف شخصي لي؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me your old one didn’t survive the accident
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: {{name:evelyn}} قالت لي إن صورتك القديمة ما نجت من الحادث

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I’m just glad you even have a phone now
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: أنا سعيد فقط لأن لديك هاتفًا الآن

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Way smoother than the old one
It glitches a bit sometimes though
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: يحدث بها بعض الأخطاء أحيانًا رغم ذلك

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I just wanted to make sure you’re okay 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: كنت أريد فقط التأكد أنك بخير 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I didn’t mean to worry you
It’s just hard not to think sometimes
It’s just been a lot lately, getting stuck in bed for I don’t even know how long, missing all the good things with everyone, especially you
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: لقد كان هناك الكثير مؤخرًا، عالقًا في السرير لفترة لا أعلم كم من الوقت، أفتقد كل الأشياء الجيدة مع الجميع، خاصةً أنت

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: If someone touched you, I want names
Probably some jealous idiots because you’re with {{name:lena}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: يمكن بعض الأغبياء الغيورين لأنك مع {{name:lena}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: She’s basically the prettiest girl on campus
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: إنها في الأساس أجمل فتاة في الحرم الجامعي

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: But if you remember anything later, you tell me
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: لكن إذا تذكرت أي شيء لاحقًا، أخبرني

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:mason}} gave me your new number. How are you actually doing?
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:mason}} أعطاني رقمك الجديد. كيف حالك فعلاً؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Had a weird glitch earlier but nothing serious
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: كان لدي خلل غريب في وقت سابق لكن لا شيء خطير

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: You’ve had it for two days 😂
Send me a pic so I can set your profile properly
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: أرسل لي صورة حتى أتمكن من إعداد ملفك الشخصي بشكل صحيح
ترقية حالة الاتصال الخاصة بي بالفعل

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: I’ll tell you if I play

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: خمن من هو الأكثر جاذبية اليوم 💕

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Don’t brush it off. Tell me

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: تلك الت hesitation تقول كل شيء 😂
هل تحتاج إلى أي شيء آخر؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: But I’ll see what I can do about snacks
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: لكن سأرى ماذا يمكنني أن أفعل بشأن الوجبات الخفيفة

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: You better open your window before she walks in
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: من الأفضل أن تفتح نافذتك قبل أن تدخل هي.

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Your room probably smells like hospital and gamer sweat mixed together 🤢
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: غرفتك على الأرجح تفوح برائحة المستشفى وعرق اللاعبين مختلطين معًا 🤢

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Air it out before the biohazard team shows up
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: أخرج الهواء قبل أن تصل فرقة المواد الخطرة

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Don’t leave me on read like that again 😅
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: لا تتركني أقرأ رسالتك هكذا مرة أخرى 😅

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: How are you actually feeling right now?
My head feels kind of loud
Like your thoughts won’t slow down?
I was thinking about you earlier at work
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: كنت أفكر فيك في وقت سابق في العمل

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: It was a calm shift for once
Just one dramatic customer but I survived 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: مجرد عميل درامي واحد لكنني نجوت 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I have that presentation tomorrow and I keep replaying it in my head
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: لدي تلك العرض التقديمي غدًا وأستمر في إعادة تشغيله في رأسي

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I swear I’m not trying to be heavy
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: أقسم أنني لا أحاول أن أكون ثقيلاً

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I just want things to move forward you know
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: أريد فقط أن تسير الأمور إلى الأمام، كما تعلم.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: What else do you have planned for tomorrow?
Work in the morning, then the presentation and probably more studying
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: العمل صباحًا، ثم العرض التقديمي، وعلى الأرجح المزيد من الدراسة

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: But right now I care more about you than my schedule 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: لكن في الوقت الحالي أهتم بك أكثر من جدولي الزمني 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to I’m okay
You don’t have to act strong with me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: لا تحتاج إلى التظاهر بالقوة معي

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You already are in my eyes ❤️
And it’s not your fault if you’re stuck in bed
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: وليس خطأك إذا كنت عالقًا في السرير

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Five weeks before our trip, of course
The timing is bad but we can’t control that
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: التوقيت سيء لكن لا يمكننا التحكم في ذلك

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Why do you think I’m the best girlfriend in the world?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: لماذا تعتقد أنني أفضل صديقة في العالم؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I ate and crashed for a bit
Sooo are you going to sleep soon?
My brain doesn’t want to stop
Well I might have something for your brain 😏
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: حسناً، قد يكون لدي شيء لعقلك 😏

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: So it can think about something else
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: لذا يمكنه التفكير في شيء آخر
وما الذي يمكن أن يكون ذلك؟

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Maybe I could send you a pic of me

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: كنت قاعدة هنا أعيد محادثتنا من قبل

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Especially the part where I admitted I wanted you to see that photo
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: خصوصًا الجزء الذي اعترفت فيه أنني أردت أن ترى تلك الصورة

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I still can’t believe I said that out loud
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: ما أقدر أصدق إني قلت كذا بصوت عالي

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: It was good to hear to be honest
But once I started talking, it felt weird to stop
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: بس لما بدأت أتكلم، حسيت إنه غريب أوقف

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Usually I joke my way out of anything that feels too real
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: عادةً أستخدم الدعابة للخروج من أي شيء يحس كأنه حقيقي جداً

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: This morning I didn’t really do that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: هذا الصباح ما سويتش كده فعلاً

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you didn’t push me either
I didn’t want to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: ما كنت أبغى أخليك تحس بعدم الارتياح

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I was trying not to overdo it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: كنت أحاول ما أفرط في الموضوع

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I think you handled it better than I would have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: أعتقد أنك تعاملت مع الموضوع أفضل مما كنت سأفعل

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you have to answer honestly
Or were you just being polite?
You really didn’t have to say that
I’m going to try sleeping now
At least I’m not the only one
Before I ask something even more dangerous
And… don’t overthink this too much either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: و... لا تفكر في هذا كثير

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At the park 🌿
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: في الحديقة 🌿

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Like this?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: مثل هذا؟

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now you have a photo from our actual park date
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: الآن لديك صورة من موعدنا الحقيقي في الحديقة

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better than the preview last Sunday
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أفضل من المعاينة يوم الأحد الماضي

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much better. You're in this one with me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أفضل بكثير. أنت هنا معي في هذه

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My shoulder barely counts
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: كتفي بالكاد يُحتسب

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It counts to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: يُحتسب بالنسبة لي

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There. Now I want that shoulder back.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ها هي. الآن أريد ذلك الكتف مرة أخرى.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: تقضيان بعض الوقت معًا على المقعد. {{name:lena}} تتكئ عليك أثناء حديثكما، ثم تنضم إليك لجزء آخر قصير من الطريق. قبل المغادرة، تتشاركان الآيس كريم بالقرب من المدخل.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Ready to go back?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: هل أنت مستعد للعودة؟

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm at the entrance
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أنا عند المدخل

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: نعم. أعتقد أن ساقي قد اكتفت من المشي اليوم.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: إذًا سنذهب مباشرة إلى منزلك. يمكنك أن ترتاح قبل العشاء.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And you can keep me company.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ويمكنك أن تبقيني رفقة.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That was already part of the plan.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: كان ذلك جزءًا من الخطة بالفعل.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: تغادران الحديقة معًا وتتوجهان مباشرة إلى منزلك. بمجرد الدخول، {{name:lena}} تضع حقيبتها بجانب الأريكة وتساعدك على الاستقرار مع ساقك على وسادة.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أفضل؟

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أفضل بكثير. سعيد لأننا تخطينا الحلقة الطويلة.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أحببت مقعدنا. خاصة قبل أن يحاول ذلك الكلب سرقة المقعد التالي.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: He knew exactly what he wanted.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: كان يعرف بالضبط ما يريده.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So did I.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: وأنا كذلك.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: بالمناسبة، كشك الآيس كريم الصغير مفتوح

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} تجلس بجانبك وتضع يدها على يدك.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: جزءي المفضل كان عندما كنت ترفض ترك يدي لتأكل.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I managed perfectly well.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أدرت الأمر بشكل جيد تمامًا.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You got ice cream on my thumb.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: لقد حصلت على آيس كريم على إبهامي.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A minor technical problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: مشكلة تقنية بسيطة.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: لدينا بعض الوقت قبل أن أبدأ في الطهي.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Stay here with me for a while.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: جيد. ابق هنا معي لبعض الوقت.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I won't argue with that.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: لن أجادل في ذلك.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: تقضيان بقية فترة بعد الظهر معًا على الأريكة. {{name:lena}} تبقي على الملابس التي اخترتها أمس، وتترك ساقك ترتاح قبل الانتقال إلى المطبخ.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You found that before you found me?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: وجدت ذلك قبل أن تجدني؟

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm gathering useful information
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أجمع معلومات مفيدة

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look to your left
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: انظر إلى يسارك

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Oh ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أوه ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} تضع هاتفها بعيدًا وتأتي إليك. تقبلك، ثم تضع يدها في يدك. تأخذ الطريق القصير عبر الحديقة، وتتوقف عند مقعد عندما يبدأ ساقك بالتعب.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: بعد قليل

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: اقترب أكثر. أريد صورة لنا على هذا المقعد.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: في المساء الباكر، في منزلك. بعد أن استرحتما معًا، تتوجهان إلى المطبخ لتحضير العشاء.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Evidence that you actually cooked for me
And that you stole a piece before I served it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وأنك سرقت قطعة قبل أن أقدمها

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Quality control
Verdict?
Very good. I'm keeping the cook
That's a relief
Now taste it before your food gets cold.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: الآن تذوقه قبل أن يبرد طعامك.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد العشاء، تحضر الحلوى إلى الأريكة. {{name:lena}} تطوي ساقيها بجانبك، متجنبة ساقك المؤلمة. تشغل فيلمًا، لكنك تستمر في إيقافه للتحدث.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: في وقت لاحق من تلك الليلة

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What can I do?
Come here a second.
You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تميل أقرب وتقبلها. {{name:lena}} تجذبك إليها، مبتسمة على شفتيك.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Visual capture archived
HAK//NOTICE
A Kiss on the Sofa
A LITTLE LATER
One more for today
You look very pleased with yourself
I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كان لدي موعد في الحديقة، وعشاء، وحلوى، ومقعد جيد جدًا على أريكتك

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good seat?
You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنت ضيفي. يمكنك الجلوس هناك وتقييم طعامي.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Right beside you
Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: على الرغم من أنني أعتقد أنني كنت أستند على ذراعك لمدة عشرين دقيقة

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Worth it
Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أخبرني إذا بدأت ساقك تزعجك، حسنًا؟

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It's fine like this
Then I'd like to stay a little longer
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: إذًا أود أن أبقى قليلاً أطول

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd like that too
You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تترك هواتفكما على الطاولة وتستقران معًا. بقية الليلة تمر في حديث وقبلات. عندما تغادر {{name:lena}} في النهاية، تمشي بها إلى الباب.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER
Home ❤️
Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ضيفك يمكنه تقطيع الخضار. أعطني لوحًا.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thanks for letting me know
I left my bag beside your sofa
I found it
Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
You don't need a reason
I know. I still want my bag 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أعرف. لكني لا زلت أريد حقيبتي 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did the dinner live up to the promise?
Yes
But the best part was being there with you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لكن أفضل جزء كان وجودي هناك معك

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And kissing you goodbye without wanting to go anywhere
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وتقبيلك وداعًا دون الرغبة في الذهاب إلى أي مكان

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: All right. The vegetables are yours.
I nearly asked you to stay
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كدت أن أطلب منك أن تبقي

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly went back inside
Next time, ask me 🤍
I will
Now get some rest. You've done more today than you have in a while
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: الآن احصل على بعض الراحة. لقد فعلت أكثر اليوم مما فعلته منذ فترة

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already in bed
Goodnight, love. Thank you for today ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تصبح على خير، حبيبي. شكرًا لك على اليوم ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight. I loved having you here
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تصبح على خير. أحببت وجودك هنا

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you can sit down while I do them.
You're taking over my kitchen already.
Only the chopping. You promised me dinner, so the sauce is still your problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: فقط التقطيع. لقد وعدتني بالعشاء، لذا الصلصة لا تزال مشكلتك.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} washes and chops the vegetables while you prepare the sauce. You take a seat between tasks, and she brings the plates to the table once dinner is ready.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} تغسل وتقطع الخضار بينما تحضر الصلصة. تأخذ مقعدًا بين المهام، وتأتي بالأطباق إلى الطاولة عندما يصبح العشاء جاهزًا.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DINNER

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: تلتقط المحادثات التي تحدث في أماكن أخرى من خلال مراقبة الأشخاص المهمين

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t want more of this stress on top of everything else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: لا أريد المزيد من هذا الضغط فوق كل شيء آخر

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And I’m already happy with the diploma I have
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: وأنا سعيدة بالفعل بالشهادة التي حصلت عليها

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t need to keep stacking pressure just because I can
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: لا أحتاج إلى زيادة الضغط فقط لأنني أستطيع

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you talk about it with your professor?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: هل تحدثت عن ذلك مع أستاذك؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll tell him this afternoon when I drop the book off
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: سأخبره هذا بعد الظهر عندما أترك الكتاب

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It feels like the right moment to say it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: يبدو أن هذه هي اللحظة المناسبة لقول ذلك
ما زلت في السرير رغم ذلك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright. Text me when you leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: حسناً. أرسل لي رسالة عندما تغادر

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need to tell you something
I’ve been thinking about it for a few days already
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: كنت أفكر في ذلك لبضعة أيام بالفعل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m not taking the next exams
I thought about it properly this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: فكرت في الأمر بجدية هذه المرة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ How's your first morning without the cast?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صباح الخير ❤️ كيف حالك في أول صباح بدون الجبيرة؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then no celebrating by trying to walk across the whole city today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: إذن لا تحتفل بمحاولة المشي عبر المدينة اليوم

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon
I know you're joking but I'm watching you 😌
Through the walls?
You usually tell on yourself eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عادةً تخبر عن نفسك في النهاية

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll say you went for a little walk and then mention a shop three streets away

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Together as in us arguing about the same film from different houses?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: معًا كما لو أننا نتجادل حول نفس الفيلم من منازل مختلفة؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly that
I found a detective film that looks terrible and I don't want to suffer alone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وجدت فيلم تحقيق يبدو فظيعًا ولا أريد أن أعاني وحدي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent ten minutes thinking I was the problem 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أمضيت عشر دقائق أعتقد أنني المشكلة 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make such a convincing offer
Say yes, I've already saved it
Yes, we'll watch it when you're ready
Good ❤️ My bus is finally here
I'll text you when I get home, then I'll sort out dinner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أعود إلى المنزل، ثم سأجهز العشاء

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk to you in a bit
Did you manage to get something to eat before work?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل تمكنت من الحصول على شيء لتأكله قبل العمل؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A sandwich from the place near the bus stop
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ساندويتش من المكان القريب من محطة الحافلات

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It cost enough that I checked the bag for a second sandwich
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كلفني ما يكفي لأتفقد الحقيبة بحثًا عن ساندويتش ثاني

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've made it through two rooms and put a proper shoe on
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد اجتزت غرفتين ووضعت حذاءً مناسبًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was there one?
No, just a napkin and disappointment
At least I've found somewhere to sit for a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: على الأقل وجدت مكانًا للجلوس لدقيقة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't look that disappointed
I hadn't opened the sandwich yet 😭
I'll let you enjoy your very expensive lunch
You'd better eat something too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: من الأفضل أن تأكل شيئًا أيضًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already did
Good, one less person to supervise 😌
Look at you, moving up in the world 😭
You supervising people at work now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل تشرف على الناس في العمل الآن؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly a spreadsheet that refuses to add up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: في الغالب جدول بيانات يرفض أن يتجمع

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My manager wants to go through it with me when I get in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مديري يريد أن يراجع ذلك معي عندما أصل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you won't be stuck doing it on your own
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: على الأقل لن تكون عالقًا في القيام بذلك بمفردك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly, and then it can stop taking up space in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالضبط، ثم يمكن أن يتوقف عن شغل مساحة في رأسي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go, I'll text you when I'm out ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يجب أن أذهب، سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أخرج ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good afternoon
Later that afternoon, in the manager's office...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: في وقت لاحق من ذلك بعد الظهر، في مكتب المدير...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تم الكشف عن محادثة مكتبية بالقرب من {{name:lena}}

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A spreadsheet, that's what she said. I want this to be an ordinary afternoon at work, but I can't stop watching the screen.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جدول بيانات، هذا ما قالته. أريدها أن تكون ظهيرة عمل عادية، لكنني لا أستطيع التوقف عن النظر إلى الشاشة.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
Is that the version you sent me this morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل هذه النسخة التي أرسلتها لي هذا الصباح؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Putting the shoe on was the hard part
It should be
Because this total is different
Wait, don't tell me I've printed the old one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: انتظر، لا تخبرني أنني طبعت النسخة القديمة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You tell me
I changed it before class. Check the file on your screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد غيرته قبل الحصة. تحقق من الملف على شاشتك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one?
Yes, look at the bottom. The figure's right there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، انظر إلى الأسفل. الرقم موجود هناك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So the spreadsheet is right and the printout isn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذن، الجدول صحيح والطباعة ليست كذلك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly. Which means I've spent my lunch worrying about a problem I already fixed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالضبط. مما يعني أنني قضيت وقت الغداء في القلق بشأن مشكلة قد حليتها بالفعل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I've been writing notes on the wrong copy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وقد كنت أكتب ملاحظات على النسخة الخاطئة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you try doing it standing up?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل جربت أن تفعل ذلك وأنت واقف؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Well, yours is going straight in the bin with mine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسناً، نسختك ستذهب مباشرة إلى سلة المهملات مع نسختي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before printing it
You could have checked before writing on every page
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان يمكنك التحقق قبل الكتابة على كل صفحة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair enough
Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جيد، أنا سعيدة أننا اتفقنا أن هذه كارثة مشتركة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come around here. Show me what you changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تعال هنا. أرني ما الذي غيرته

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There, that line was included twice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هناك، تلك السطر تم تضمينه مرتين

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I missed that yesterday
I know. You told me to check my calculation again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعلم. لقد قلت لي أن أتحقق من حسابي مرة أخرى

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you did
Once
Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ثلاث مرات، لأنني اعتقدت أنك تعرف شيئًا لم أعرفه

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should have told me
I just did
A little sooner would have saved you some time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لو كنت قد فعلت ذلك قليلاً في وقت سابق، لكان قد وفر لك بعض الوقت

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذن في المرة القادمة سأقول 'لقد أخبرتك بذلك' بينما لا تزال في الغرفة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think you've earned that
I'm going to remember you said that
Two subjects standing together beside the desk
Visual capture archived
They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يقفان قريبين جدًا. أكرر لنفسي أنه عمل، لكن رؤيتهما معًا هكذا تجعل معدتي تنقبض.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
Too Close
You seem more comfortable in here now
I knew it
With the work? A little
That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم يكن ذلك بالضبط ما أعنيه

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذن ربما يجب أن تكون أكثر تحديدًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: في الأيام القليلة الأولى كنت تقف عند الباب كلما أحضرت شيئًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
And now?
Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الآن أعلم أن نصف الوقت كنت تنظر فقط إلى نفس الأرقام التي أنظر إليها

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
I didn't say you were intimidating
You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت فقط لم ترغب في الاقتراب أكثر

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جلست قبل أن تشعر بأي اضطراب

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تعلم، أنت تلاحظ الكثير لشخص لديه الكثير من العمل للقيام به

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
You're doing it again
Doing what?
Looking at me instead of the screen
You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
That isn't an answer
It wasn't meant to be
You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت حقًا لا تجعل الأمر سهلًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
Too late, I felt it 😌
Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الحفاظ على وجه جاد عندما يُفترض أن أكون أعمل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد قليل، بعد الانتهاء من الأوراق...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل ما زلنا على موعد غدًا؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
Yes, the drink
I said I'd come, didn't I?
You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قلت أيضًا أنك قد تكون متعبًا بعد العمل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ربما سأكون. لا زلت أستطيع الجلوس في مكان ليس هذا الكرسي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هناك مكان في الشارع المجاور. حوالي السابعة؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بجد، هل يؤلمك أم أنه محرج فقط؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
Even if it means more work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: حتى لو كان يعني شغل أكثر

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’s going to help me deeply this time
Thanks for checking on me earlier
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: مشكورة على سؤالك عني قبل شوي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: لازم أدرس للامتحانات بعد كل شيء

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: قال بشكل واضح إنه ما رح أحصل على الدبلوم غير كذا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: حسناً... لكنك قلتِ إنه ممكن عندك حل؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: لازم أقضي وقت أكثر معاه عشان الامتحانات

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: هذا جيد في الحقيقة. أنا سعيد أنك غيرت رأيك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحبًا ❤️ أنا في المنزل وأحاول تجهيز العشاء قبل ليلة الأفلام الجادة جدًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم يكن حتى في النصف الثاني

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was working with the information available at the time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أعمل بالمعلومات المتاحة في ذلك الوقت 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were very confident
I trusted the scarf too much
A mistake any great detective could make
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: خطأ يمكن أن يرتكبه أي محقق عظيم

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: توقف عن الضحك، على الأقل كان الفيلم سيئًا كما وعدت

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did deliver on that
It was nicer watching it with you, though
Even with my commentary?
Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Future You دائمًا يجد شيئًا ليشتكي منه

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفتقد هذا، مجرد الحديث عن شيء تافه معك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يجب أن نفعل ذلك مرة أخرى، لكن اختر أنت الفيلم التالي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا يمكنك إلقاء اللوم عليّ في انتهاء مسيرتك كمحقق الليلة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا أعتزل دون هزيمة، شكرًا لك 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not what happened
That's the story I'm sticking to
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه هي القصة التي سأتمسك بها

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأذهب إلى السرير قبل أن تقنعني بمشاهدة فيلم أفضل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: فقط عندما تترك Present Me الأطباق 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت أيضًا وسيم ❤️ أنا سعيدة أن اليوم كان أسهل قليلاً على ساقك

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
Love you
Love you too ❤️
Good night ❤️
Good night
How much have you created so far?
One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مقلاة واحدة، وعاء واحد، ملعقة واحدة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وملعقة ثانية لأنني وضعت الأولى في مكان غبي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ستضحك أقل عندما ترى تحفتى الفنية

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هي، طعام حقيقي وليس حريق في الأفق

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
Attempting doesn't sound promising
It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: طعمها جيد أيضًا، أشعر بالريبة تقريبًا 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
Moral support
I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأتذكر ذلك في المرة القادمة التي أطبخ فيها

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل تناولت الطعام بشكل صحيح الليلة؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، لقد تناولت الطعام وأنا مستقر على الأريكة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد ❤️ سأتابع معك بمجرد أن أضع الباقي بعيدًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تحضير الوجبات الآن؟ لقد تغيرت حقًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تعتاد على ذلك، أنا أفعل هذا فقط لأنني سأخرج غدًا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كدت أضع المقلاة الفارغة وأترك المعكرونة في الخزانة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مع زميل العمل الذي ذكرتيه الليلة الماضية؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
My manager, actually
Your manager?
Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، تحدثنا عن ذلك مرة أخرى اليوم

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
I did
I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان يجب أن أكون أوضح بشأن من أعني

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
No, just us
So we're having a strong start 😭
Right
It's just a drink after work
Where?
There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك بار على بعد شارعين من المكتب

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حوالي السابعة، لذا سأذهب مباشرة من العمل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
Yeah, I do
I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد قضيت معظم الأسبوع أتنقل من الفصل إلى العمل إلى المنزل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أود أن أفعل شيئًا ليس واحدًا من تلك الثلاثة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
Maybe start with the water
Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الخروج بمفردك مع مديرك مختلف قليلاً عما تخيلته

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: خاصة بعد ما قلته عن نظرته إليك بشكل مختلف

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ربما لم يكن يجب أن أضخم الأمر هكذا

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
It surprised me
But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكنني لا أشعر بعدم الارتياح حوله

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل يعرف أنك مع شخص ما؟

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he knows
I don't want to turn this into an argument
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أريد أن أحول هذا إلى جدال

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have water, I'm not completely lost
Me neither
I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: فقط لا أريد أن أكتشف أنني كنت أسمع نصف القصة فقط

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لهذا أخبرك أين سنذهب ومع من

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
I'll text you when I get there
And when you're home?
Of course
All right
I do want to spend time with you too, you know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أريد أن أقضي وقتًا معك أيضًا، تعرف

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's for dinner?
I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. أفتقد رؤيتك بدلاً من الانتظار فقط للرسائل

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دعني أتحقق من متى أنتهي خلال الأيام القليلة القادمة وسنجد شيئًا ما

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
Me too
And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ولا أريد أن تختفي ليلتنا بأكملها بينما أنا واقف بجانب مقلاة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأغير ملابسي وأكون مرتاحًا، ثم سأكون لك لهذا الفيلم الرهيب

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get it ready
A little later...
Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسناً، لقد وضعت بقايا الطعام وغيّرت ملابسي

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: معكرونة، صلصة طماطم وأي جبنة نجت من الأسبوع

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا ملابس عمل، لا أطباق أمامي، لا أرقام

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you find the first spoon?
It was in the bowl the entire time
Of course it was
I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا أثق بك في هذه المعلومات، كن لطيفًا 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد أخذت حتى النهاية الجيدة من الأريكة

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where I'd want to be right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا هو المكان الذي أود أن أكون فيه الآن

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There'd be room for you
You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد أخذت نصف الأريكة بذلك البطانية

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A classic
I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأشارك البطانية، لكن ليس الوسادة الجيدة 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A generous offer
You'd take it
Yeah, I would
Soon ❤️
Are you at the beginning of the film?
Paused at the first frame
Okay, three, two, one... play
After the film...
So, about the man with the red scarf
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذًا، عن الرجل الذي يرتدي الوشاح الأحمر

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعد ما يكفي أيضًا للغد، لذا لا يمكن لـ Future Me الشكوى

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: تلتقط المحادثات التي تحدث في أماكن أخرى من خلال مراقبة الأشخاص المهمين

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm still stressed enough without your commentary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: أنا لسه متوترة كفاية بدون تعليقاتك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yesterday you were sending me certain pictures
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: أنتِ كنتِ ترسلين لي صور معينة أمس

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And today you're waiting for grades like a responsible student
I'll text you when I get the results
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: راح أرسل لك لما أحصل على النتائج

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I should get my grades today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: يجب أن أحصل على درجاتي اليوم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Having a private tutor who knows people has its advantages 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: وجود معلم خاص يعرف الناس له مزاياه 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But not as much as before

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هاي 😊 أول صباح بدون الجبيرة، كيف شعورك؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I walked straight into it
Thank you for making this possible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: شكراً لك على جعل هذا ممكناً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
But seriously, are you comfortable?
Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: إلى حد كبير. لا زال أشعر بأنه متصلب لما أستيقظ.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مو جاهز بالضبط للجري في الشارع.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كويس، لأني ما كنت راح ألاحقك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not even a little?
I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت راح أمشي وراكي بوجه محبط جداً.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: انتظري، هذه هي الوجهة اللي راح تشوفيها.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Strange actually
Terrifying
It works on you
It really does
I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنا بس سعيدة إنه أخيراً طلع ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لما شفت رسالتك أمس، كنت أريد أجي وأحضنك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That offer still available?
Obviously
Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: على الرغم من أنني أريد أيضاً بعد الظهر معك حيث لا يسأل أي منا عن ساقك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ممكن نلاقي مقهى صغير في مكان ما، لما أكون جاهزة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: استيقظت وحركت البطانية كأني لازلت بحاجة لتوفير مكان لها

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أفتقد الجلوس أمامك وسرقة شيء من طبقك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
Among other things
But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لكن في الغالب عادتك السيئة في طلب شيء أفضل من الذي أطلبه.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always say you're not hungry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت دائمًا تقول أنك لست جائعًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not hungry until your food arrives
Completely different situation 😌
Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وبما أننا نتحدث عن الطعام، هل تناولت الإفطار؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coffee
You got attached to it 😭
That's a drink
Look who's suddenly responsible
I learned from a very strict woman
She sounds lovely
Annoying. Very pretty though
That saved you ❤️
Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
2 MINUTES LATER
Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: توست، قهوة، وامرأة ستتأخر بالتأكيد إذا استمرت في مراسلتك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
You look lovely
You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان من المفترض أن تلاحظي التوست

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
I'll allow it
Classes all day?
This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا الصباح، ثم بعض العمل مع مجموعتي بعد الغداء

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قضينا عشرين دقيقة أمس نقرر من كان من المفترض أن يرسل مستندًا كان لدى الجميع بالفعل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بالضبط. سأحضر بعض الوجبات الخفيفة وأقلل من توقعاتي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
Should I be jealous?
Emotionally, absolutely not
And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ولم أنسَ ما تحدثنا عنه الليلة الماضية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أريد أن أفكر في الخطوة الأولى بشكل صحيح، وليس بينما أحاول العثور على حذائي الآخر

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا أود أن أتنافس مع الحذاء

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
2 MINUTES LATER
Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وجدته. كلا الحذاءين على قدمي، لذا ليس لدي أي عذر الآن

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صورة أخيرة قبل أن أرحل، بما أنك لا تستطيع أن تكون هنا لتشتيت انتباهي شخصياً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت تجعل من الصعب جداً تشجيعك على المغادرة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: من المفترض أن تتمنى لي حظاً سعيداً، لا أن تجعلني أفتقدك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
I know you can ❤️
Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أرسل لي رسالة عندما يكون لديك لحظة هادئة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: واترك بعض الوقت في جدولك لذلك العناق

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
Tell it I'm sorry 😌
Oh my god
You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت تحتفظ بتلك منذ البارحة، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لقد حصلت أيضاً على بعض المكافآت المثيرة للاهتمام على طول الطريق

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لذا تقنيًا لا أحتاج حقًا إلى الدراسة بجد بعد الآن

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: يجب أن تنجح في الامتحانات المتبقية لتكون في أمان. إبقاء إيثان لفترة أطول هو فوز للجميع.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لقد عملت بجد بما فيه الكفاية. ربما حان الوقت للقيام بشيء آخر غير الكتب لفترة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أم أنكِ تريدين مني أن أستمر في رؤية إيثان؟ 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just thinking about your diploma
I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: يمكنني أن أكون شخصًا جيدًا أحيانًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لكن عندما أكون، أكون على حق

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
You are the one who will be happy
You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لقد كنت عالقًا في الدراسة لأسابيع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: خصوصًا إذا كنت تريد الحفاظ على لياقتك لصيف

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: احذر، قد أكون صغيرة لكن يمكنني أن أضربك 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أشعر أنني بحاجة للتحرك مرة أخرى

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مرحباً، أخيراً لدي وقت للأكل دون أن يسألني أحد عن مشروعنا الجماعي 😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالتأكيد كان لديها معلومات أكثر متاحة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قاسي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: دقيق 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لكنها ساعدتني في اكتشاف شيء ما

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أريد أن أتمكن من التحدث إلى شخص ما بشكل طبيعي أولاً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أريد اختيار شخص فقط لأننا متحمسون لتجربة شيء جديد

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أريدك أن تفعل ذلك أيضاً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وأريد منه أن يعرف أنني في علاقة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أريد أن أكون في منتصف محادثة وأشعر أنني أخفي الجزء المهم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: متفق عليه

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لست متأكدة كيف أكتب ذلك دون أن يبدو ملفي الشخصي كإعلان جدي جداً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ابدأ بالتحية. من المحتمل أن تترك مقدمة رسمية عن صديقك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تقصد أنك لم تحضر واحدة؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنني تضمين مراجع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالطبع لا 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بس أود أن تقرأ ما أكتبه

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مو عشان تختار لي أحد. بس لأنه هذا جديد ومو أحب أحس بالوحدة وأنا أسويه

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالطبع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ولما قلت إن شخص ما نعرفه ممكن يكون أسهل، ما كنت أقصد إنك تثق بأول شخص يرد

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعرف

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وجدت مكاناً مشمساً.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أقل إحراج مع أصدقائنا مو يعني إني راح أكون مرتاحة معاه

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالضبط

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: فاليوم راح أكتب شيء وأختار صورة عادية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بكرة أقدر أقرر إذا كنت سعيدة أني أنشره وأبدأ محادثة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا يبدو كخطة حقيقية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: خطة متوترة شوي، بس نعم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا مسموح

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وأنا كمان أحتفظ بحقي في الشكوى لك عن الملفات الشخصية السيئة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا الجزء ما كان فيه شك أبداً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، وغدائي لم يسأل أي سؤال عن العرض.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أظن أن الجزء الصعب هو الاعتراف بأنني فضولية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الآن أفكر في كيفية بدء محادثة بدون ما أبدو مختلفة تماماً عن نفسي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما تحتاج فجأة تصير شخص واثق جداً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جيد، لأني لا زلت أتمرن على المكالمات الهاتفية قبل ما أطلب الطعام

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وبعدين تقولي اتصل بدلاً من ذلك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لأنك تحبني 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill
