story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: للأسف لفاتورة هاتفي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أريد حقاً أن أجرب هذا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أريد فقط أن أشعر أن الخطوة الأولى كانت شيئًا اخترته، وليس شيئًا اندفعت إليه لأننا أجرينا محادثة جيدة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: رفقة ممتازة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذن لنبدأ من هناك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسناً ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يجب أن أعود. لقد وجدوا سببًا آخر لمناقشة الشرائح.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ابقَ قويًا.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سآخذ بقية غدائي معي. إنه الشيء الوحيد الذي أثق به الآن.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت مدعو في المرة القادمة. بشرط أن تحضر بطاطس مقلية خاصة بك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أفكر في البارحة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: في الغالب عن ما سأشعر بالراحة في القيام به أولاً.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل حققت أي تقدم؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. تقدمت قليلاً أكثر من مجرد الجلوس هناك أتساءل عما تريده.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل هربت؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ذكرك لـ {{name:aiden}} جعل الأشياء العادية تبدو أقل عادية.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما هي الأشياء؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سألني إذا كان لدي ملاحظات من درسنا الأخير.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عادةً ما كنت سأرسلها فقط.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: اليوم، حدقت في الرسالة لفترة طويلة قبل أن أتذكر أنه كان يسأل حرفياً عن ملاحظات الدرس.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: من فضلك قل لي أنك لم ترسل له رد غامض

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مؤقتاً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد حصل على الملاحظات. تطور مثير جدًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: اهدأ، أنت تتقدم على نفسك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: اسكت

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لكن هذه هي المشكلة. هو بالفعل جزء من حياتي الطبيعية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذا تحدثنا عن هذا وشعرت أنه غريب بعد ذلك، سأراه لا يزال في الحرم الجامعي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. لم أفكر حقًا في الغداء العادي التالي معًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لدي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أعتقد أن هذا يعني أنه يجب علينا ألا نتحدث معه

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا فقط لا أريد أن أتعامل مع الأمر كما لو كنت أطلب منه الانضمام إلينا للعب

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أفهم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قلت إنني بحاجة إلى الغداء وسألني أحدهم إذا كان بإمكاننا مناقشة الشرائح بينما أتناول الطعام.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كيف تريد أن تطرحه؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بمفردي، كبداية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أفضل أن أكون في محادثة محرجة قليلاً بدلاً من محاولة شرح شيء شخصي وأصدقائي يستمعون

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وربما تقديم نصائح لم يطلبها أحد

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالضبط

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: انتظر

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هو قادم. سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أجد لحظة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد لحظة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is anyone sitting here?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل يجلس أحد هنا؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يعتمد. هل جئت لتسرق غدائي؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you throw the slides at them?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل رميت الشرائح عليهم؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone joins the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ينضم شخص ما إلى الطاولة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: المحادثة جارية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مقعد غير متوقع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت سألت عن الملاحظات، لكن بما أنك ذكرت الغداء...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد حصلت على الملاحظات. هذه هديتك لليوم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سخي كما هو الحال دائمًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل أنت بخير؟ كنت تبدو بعيدًا جدًا قبل قليل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. فقط أفكر في شيء ما

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل هناك شيء يمكنني مساعدتك فيه؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ربما. أفضل أن أتحدث عن ذلك عندما يكون المكان أكثر هدوءًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تستمر المحادثة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الانتباه موجه نحو المتحدث الآخر

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: فكرت في ذلك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: شيء لتقوله

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أوه. حسنًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا تبدو قلقًا جدًا، ليس هناك شيء سيء

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't worried until you said that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم أكن قلقًا حتى قلت ذلك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: رائع، الآن جعلت الأمر يبدو دراميًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنك إخباري عندما تكون جاهزًا. كنت فقط أتيت لأقول شكرًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: من أجل الملاحظات؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لإنقاذي من الاعتراف بأنني لم أكتب أيًا من ذلك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ها هو. كنت أتساءل لماذا كنت لطيفًا جدًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنني أن أكون لطيفًا دون أن أريد شيئًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لكنني وجدت طاولة في الخارج بدلاً من ذلك، لذا أختار النمو الشخصي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then take your hand away from my fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذن ابعد يدك عن بطاطستي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نقطة عادلة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Playful exchange at the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تبادل مرح على الطاولة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shared laughter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ضحك مشترك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يسعدني أنها تضحك، حتى لو كنت ما زلت أعتاد فكرة وجودهما معًا.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Lunch Negotiations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مفاوضات الغداء

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 20 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد 20 دقيقة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, I have my phone to myself again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسنًا، لدي هاتفي لنفسي مرة أخرى

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كل شيء بخير؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We just had a normal conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. لقد أجرينا محادثة طبيعية فقط

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت على وشك التحدث عن ذلك، لكن كان هناك أشخاص يجلسون بجوارنا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هو يعرف أنني أريد التحدث عن شيء ما. لكنه لا يعرف ما هو

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: فخور بك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كيف كان شعورك؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أقل رعبًا مما توقعت

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: على الرغم من أنه حاول سرقة غدائي، لذا لم أستطع أخذه على محمل الجد

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يبدو أن هذا مألوف

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: غدًا سأجد لحظة أكثر هدوءًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أريد أن أرى ما إذا كان بإمكاننا التحدث عن ذلك قبل اتخاذ أي قرار آخر

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسنًا. قل لي كيف تشعر الليلة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأقوم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: شكراً لك 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I downloaded an app during my break
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد قمت بتحميل تطبيق خلال استراحتي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You did?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل فعلت؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: فقط لأرى كيف كان. لم أضع ملفًا شخصيًا أو أرسل رسالة لأي شخص

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: انتظر، أحاول أن أتذكر كيف أعود إلى شاشة الملف الشخصي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد لحظة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, found it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسناً، وجدته

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان الأمر أقل رعباً عندما توقفت عن اعتبار كل رجل على الشاشة كقرار مصيري ضخم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل اكتشفت أي شيء مثير للاهتمام؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان هناك رجل لديه ست صور لنفسه بجانب نفس السيارة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ربما السيارة لديها شخصية جيدة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ها هي مكان غدائي الحصري جداً.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: حتى لو كانت عائلتها، ستحصل على نفس المعاملة مثل الجميع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: وبما أننا نتحدث عن الأشخاص الذين يحتاجون للجدية…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: ساقك لن تتحسن إذا استمريت في الكسل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: الطبيب أزال الجبس عن ساقي أمس فقط، أتذكر؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: فقط لا تأتي تبكي عندما تبدأ الجلسات الحقيقية

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She wants to join the training sessions
I might have given her a little push

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحبًا 😊 هل حدثت مغامرتك الكبرى بعيدًا عن الأريكة، أم أن وحدة التحكم انتصرت؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably not immediately
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ربما ليس على الفور.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وهذا جزء من السبب الذي يجعلني أريد التحدث وجهًا لوجه. يمكنني أن أخبره أن يتوقف عن المزاح إذا احتجت لذلك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: من فضلك لا تخبره كم قلت اسمه بسرعة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You mean immediately?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تقصد على الفور؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds worse when you say it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أسوأ عندما تقوله.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can leave that detail out 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنني ترك تلك التفاصيل 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أظهر له رسائلنا أيضًا. يمكنني شرح الموقف بنفسي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شكراً لك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم سنرى كيف يشعر. لن أدعوه إلى أي مكان قبل أن نتحدث.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أخبرني كيف تسير الأمور عندما تتاح لك الفرصة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم عدت إلى المنزل، وطهيت العشاء، وأدركت أنني طهيت ما يكفي من المعكرونة لعائلة من ستة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأفعل ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كتبت مقدمة قصيرة سابقًا. هل تريد قراءتها؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Send it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أرسلها

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا في علاقة، وشريكي يعرف أنني هنا. أود التعرف على شخص ما، بدءًا من محادثة وربما قهوة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That says what you mean
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا يعبر عما تعنيه.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't sound too formal?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ألا يبدو رسميًا جدًا؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قليلاً. أضف شيئًا عن نفسك لا يتعلق بنا.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مثل قدرتي المدهشة على طهي ستة أطباق من المعكرونة عن طريق الخطأ؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's tomorrow sorted
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا يعني أن غدًا مرتب.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly, yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بصراحة، نعم.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب المقاهي الهادئة، والأفلام السيئة، ومن الواضح أنني أطبخ لأشخاص لا وجود لهم.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds much more like you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا يبدو أكثر مثل شخصيتك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت مشمول في المعكرونة، لا تقلق 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انتظري، أريد أن أجرب أخذ واحدة الآن بينما الضوء جميل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأحاول أن أعطيك رأيًا غير متحيز تمامًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That would be a first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا سيكون الأول من نوعه

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد دقيقتين

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, this one actually looks like me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسنًا، هذه الصورة تبدو مثلّي فعلاً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And possibly the rest of my life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وربما بقية حياتي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه هي التعبيرة التي أظهرها عندما تخبرني أنك سرقت بطاطا واحدة فقط

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I look innocent because I am
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أبدو بريئة لأنني كذلك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الصورة ممتازة. الدفاع القانوني يحتاج إلى تحسين

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the photo then 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأحتفظ بالصورة إذن 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأستخدم تلك وسأقرأ المقدمة مرة أخرى غدًا قبل أن أنشر أي شيء

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم يمكنني أن أرى إذا كان هناك شخص أريد حقًا التحدث إليه

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت لا تدين لأحد بمحادثة لمجرد أنهم أرسلوا لك رسالة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. أنا فضولية، لا أقبل طلبات من الإنترنت كله

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الآن هذا عنوان ملف شخصي جيد

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت لا تساعدني بعد الآن

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك إحضار بعض منها في المرة القادمة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا متوترة بشأن الغد

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكنني أحب أنه شيء صغير أريد فعله حقًا، بدلاً من قفزة كبيرة أحاول أن أكون مستعدة لها

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك أن تخبرني إذا شعرت أنه مختلف عما كنت تتوقع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت أيضًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أريدك أن تتظاهري بأنك بخير لمجرد أنك من أثار الموضوع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أفعل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسناً ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الآن، سؤال مهم جدًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انظر إليك تحل مشاكلي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا أستمع

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: عندما أحضر لك المعكرونة، هل سنشاهد شيئًا لائقًا، أم أنك ستجعلني أشاهد فيلمًا آخر حيث لا يشغل أحد الأنوار؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه هي الأجواء

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا ساعتان من سؤالي من يقف في المدخل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك اختيار هذا الوقت

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حقًا؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. لكنني أحتفظ بحقي في الشكوى

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأكون قلقة إذا لم تشتكي

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أريد تلك الظهيرة معك، كما تعلم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس لإجراء مناقشة جدية أخرى. فقط لأتناول الكثير وأجلس بجانبك لبعض الوقت

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انتظر، دعني أستعد قبل أن تشتت انتباهي مرة أخرى.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أريد ذلك أيضًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذن لا تنسي. ما زلت أطالب بمكاني على الأريكة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إنه لك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انتظري، سأنتقل من الأريكة إلى السرير قبل أن أنام هنا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد 5 دقائق

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هي. سأحفظ لك الوسادة الأخرى

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت حقًا لا تساعد في مدى اشتياقي لك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذن تعالي واطلبيها عندما تستطيعين

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأفعل ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد 5 دقائق

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبح على خير، وسيم ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبح على خير. احفظي لي بعض المعكرونة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك ما يكفي من المعكرونة لتعيش أكثر منا. اذهبي إلى النوم 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هي. شعري لا يزال رطبًا، لكنني لن أتحرك مرة أخرى

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تبدو وكأنك على وشك النوم

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد وصلت إلى المطبخ وعدت عدة مرات.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لست كذلك. لقد جلست للتو

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: عادةً ما يبدأ الأمر هكذا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مضحك جدًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك شيء أردت التحقق منه قبل الغد، في الحقيقة

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تفضل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في الليلة الماضية، عندما سألتك ماذا تريد أن تعرف إذا أرسلت صورة لشخص آخر

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أتذكر إجابتك. لا أريد أن أفترض أنها تشمل كل شيء قد نفعله

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا عادل

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مسافر ذو خبرة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قلت أنك تريد أن تعرف، وأن تتلقى الصورة أيضًا

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. أحب فكرة أن أكون جزءًا مما تختار مشاركته

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسنًا. لكن إذا كنت أتحدث مع شخص ما، فلن أكون بالضرورة أنظر إلى هاتفي طوال الوقت

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أطلب منك أن تعطيني تحديثات كل خمس دقائق

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أود أن أرى الصورة إذا كان هذا شيئًا تقررين مشاركته. المحادثة شيء مختلف

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. لا أريدك أن تنتظري رسالة وتظني أن هناك شيئًا خاطئًا لأنني لا أكتب

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قولي لي عندما تكونين حرة، ثم يمكننا التحدث فعلاً

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان هناك أيضًا بعض الوقت في الخارج.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب ذلك أكثر

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ولا تتشوقي كثيرًا للصور بعد. لم أجرِ حتى المحادثة الأولى 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا أتحلى بالصبر الشديد

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تقومين بانطباع مقنع لذلك

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قلت أنك تريد أن تعرف، لكنك مش بالضرورة تريد الصورة بنفسك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أيوة. هذا لا يزال ينطبق.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أريد أن أسمع عن ذلك منك. مش محتاجة أنك تجمع أشياء لتظهرها لي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا مريح، بصراحة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم جلست قبل أن أبدأ في ندم طموحي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل أن أخبرك كيف شعرت بشيء بدلاً من القلق بشأن إثبات أنه حدث.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا مش راح أشيك على واجبك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. لقد اكتفيت من ذلك اليوم.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وإذا كنت مشغول، يمكننا التحدث بعدين.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسناً. سأخبرك عندما أجد لحظة، بدلاً من محاولة مواكبة محادثة ثانية على هاتفي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالضبط

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالمناسبة، لا زلت تحصل على صوري العادية. مش هتقدر تهرب من وجهي بهذه السهولة 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما كنتش مخطط للهروب.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا يبدو منطقيًا بالفعل.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قلت أنك قد لا تريد أن تعرف.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل تقصد عدم معرفة كل شيء على حدة، أم عدم الحصول على تحديثات أثناء حدوثه؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما كنتش مفصل بين هذول في رأسي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لهذا السبب أسأل.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أستطيع أن أفهم ترك مجال لمفاجأة. بس ما أريدش أن نفهم شيئين مختلفين بدون ما ندرك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دعنا نتفق على الحدود، لكن نترك بعض الأشياء كمفاجأة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل أن لا يكون هناك تحديثات أثناء ذلك، ثم نتحدث بعدين.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل أن نتفق على ما نحاول أولاً، ثم نترك مجالاً لكِ لعدم إخباري بكل شيء صغير.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسناً. مفاجأة ضمن ما تحدثنا عنه فعلاً، وليس أن أخمن مدى عمق تلك الإجابة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالضبط

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تبدو متفاجئًا.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في الوقت الحالي، نحن نتحدث فقط عن التواصل ورؤية ما إذا كان الموعد الأول مناسباً.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. لا أتعامل مع هذا وكأننا اتفقنا على كل شيء آخر.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وإذا شعرت أن هناك شيئاً خاطئاً، سأخبرك. لن أحتفظ بذلك لنفسي للحفاظ على الغموض.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالطبع. نفس الشيء بالنسبة لي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسناً. هذا يبدو أكثر منطقية بالنسبة لي الآن.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعتقد أنني أفضل ألا أتابع كل شيء أثناء حدوثه.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكن بعد ذلك، أود أن أسمع كيف سارت الأمور وكيف شعرت.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لذا سأضع هاتفي بعيداً، وأجري المحادثة، ونتحدث عندما أكون متفرغاً.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحاول ألا أفسد اللحظة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. يبدو أن هذا أقرب لما أعنيه.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسناً. يمكنني فعل ذلك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وإذا احتجت للتحدث إليك في وقت أقرب، سأفعل ذلك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالطبع. لا تحتاج للتمسك بخطة معينة عندما تحتاج إلي.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة لأننا تحدثنا عن ذلك الآن.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أتخيل نفسي أنظر إلى هاتفي، أتساءل عما إذا كان يجب أن أرسل لك شيئاً.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أريدك أن تقلق بشأن ذلك.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف كانت بقية يومك؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. أصبح الأمر أسهل الآن بعد أن قلنا ذلك بالفعل.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ماذا تريد أن تفعل غداً؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأطلب من {{name:aiden}} إذا كان بإمكاننا التحدث لبضع دقائق بعد الحصة.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أريد أن أشرح أننا كنا نتحدث عن فكرة أن أذهب في موعد مع شخص آخر.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنه شخص سأفكر في إجراء تلك المحادثة معه.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تعتقد أنه سيصدق أنك جاد؟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد أنهينا جزءنا من المشروع، لذا يمكنني أخيرًا التوقف عن التفكير فيه.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: بس ما كنت متوقعة أنك تقترح شيء زي كده بعد الليلة الماضية

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: لا تأخذ وقت طويل أو ببدأ بدونك وأشتري أكل غير صحي

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: قاعده أستنى على نفس الصفحة لمدة عشرين دقيقة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
She has a permanent invitation
Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
How's your leg after yesterday?
A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: كانت متيبسة قليلاً عندما استيقظت، لكن أفضل بعد التحرك قليلاً

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: أنا سعيد لأننا توقفنا عندما فعلنا

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: وأنا كذلك. سأكون هادئًا هذا الصباح

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: بعض الأشياء حول المنزل هذا الصباح، ثم ربما بعض الألعاب لاحقًا

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
I'm spending the afternoon with my family
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: سأقضي فترة ما بعد الظهر مع عائلتي

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: مددت يدي إلى حقيبتي وتذكرت أين كانت

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: الغداء أولاً. ثم على ما يبدو سنلعب ورق

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: تم إخباري. لم تكن مشاركتي اختيارية 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
That's the spirit
And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ثم سأسمح لهم بلطف بالإعجاب بي

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
Exactly
Okay, I need to get ready
It's still beside the sofa
Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: احتفظ بحقيبتي بأمان. سأجمعها عندما أراك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
You too love
At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: على الأقل واحد منا قضى الليل في منزلك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
Then don't get too attached to it 😌
Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: لقد فات الأوان. لقد تناولنا الإفطار بالفعل

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ها هي الشخص الذي كان يجب أن تدعوه بدلاً مني

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
You’re not allowed to just supervise
A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: بعد فترة، بعد ما طهينا في المطبخ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: أنت أيضًا من تسبب في أكبر فوضى

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: وما اشتريت إلا ثلاث أشياء غير ضرورية

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
While I have sauce on my face?
You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: لا يُسمح لك أن تقول ذلك وأنا مغطاة بتوابل التاكو

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: أنا فقط هكذا لأن التاكو على وشك أن تكون جاهزة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: الآن توقف عن الكلام وساعدني في إنهاء التقديم

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: البسكويت كانوا ينظروا لي بطريقة غريبة
كانت تلك في الحقيقة لذيذة جدًا

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: أحتفظ بالـ 10 لوقت لا نكاد نشعل إنذار الدخان

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: تقصد عندما لا تكاد تشعل إنذار الدخان

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: على أي حال... سأقوم بتنظيف المكان ثم أستسلم للنوم

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
It helped more than I expected

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: لا تقل في أي وقت بسرعة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ممكن أبدأ أطلب ليالي التاكو الأسبوعية

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: على أي حال... سأقوم بتنظيف المكان ثم أستسلم للنوم

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: دليل إني حملت على الأقل كيس واحد

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
She sends you a kiss back 😘
But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: لكن في كل مرة أبدو سعيداً، يجعلني أحدهم أرسم المزيد

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
Did you keep a straight face?
Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ثم سألني أحدهم لماذا كنت أبدو وكأنني أخفي جريمة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: أعتقد أنني بحاجة إلى مستشار جديد

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: سألوا من كنت أرسل له الرسائل

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: هل أخبرتهم أنك تتلقى مساعدة خبيرة؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: قلت إن صديقي يساعدني على الخسارة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: يجب أن تعطيهم فرصة ليفتقدوك. خذ استراحة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: لقد فعلت. سأحصل على شريحة أخرى من الكعكة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: على الأقل أنا أفوز في الحلوى

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: سأكون في المنزل لاحقًا هذا بعد الظهر

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: عندي فكرة. سأخبرك عندما أكون في المنزل ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: جيد. دعني أنهي كعكتي المهمة جدًا أولاً

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: الجميع يصبح فجأة تنافسياً جداً عندما أكون على وشك الفوز

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: انظر إلى وجه شخص يُعامل بشكل غير عادل

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: في وقت متأخر من المساء — عدت إلى البيت ولديك لحظة هادئة لنفسك.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: حقًا؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نعم. سأحب اللعب معكِ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: دائمًا تبدين وكأنكِ تستمتعين

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت أعتقد أنني أود تجربته معكِ بدلاً من مجرد سماع عنه

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: إذًا دعينا نجد شيئًا يمكننا الاستمتاع به معًا

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ماذا عن لعبة السباق التي ذكرتها؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هذا سيكون جيدًا. يمكننا القيام بسباق خاص

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: حسنًا. لكن عليكِ أن تشرحي لي التحكمات أولاً

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: اتفقنا. سأرسل لكِ دعوة بمجرد أن تكوني جاهزة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد قليل - أنتما تطلقان لعبة السباق. قبل البدء، تشرح التحكمات وتسمح لـ {{name:lena}} بتجربة لفة تدريبية.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنا في المنزل

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: جاهزة. أرجو أن تقدر تركيزي

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: محترفة جدًا. كيف تسير لفة التدريب؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد اصطدمت بنفس الحائط ثلاث مرات

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: اضغطي على الفرامل قبل الزاوية، ثم التفتِ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنتِ تحاولين القيام بالأمرين بسرعة كاملة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت أعتقد أن السرعة هي الهدف

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: البقاء على الطريق يساعد أيضًا

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: حسنًا. لفة تدريبية أخرى

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد السباق الأول

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وعندي سؤال جدي جدًا

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد أنهيت السباق بعيدًا عني 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد لعبتها كثيرًا أكثر. لا تقارن سباقك الأول بذلك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد علقت أيضًا أواجه الاتجاه الخاطئ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لكنّكِ اجتزت الزاوية الأخيرة بسلاسة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هذا هو الحائط الذي كنتِ تصطدمين به في التدريب

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد لاحظت ذلك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أترى؟ أنت بالفعل تتحكم في التوقيت

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: حسناً. مرة أخرى

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نفس المسار؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نعم. لدي أمور غير منتهية معه

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنا أستمع

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد السباق الثاني - {{name:lena}} لا يزال ينهي خلفك، لكنه أكمل المسار مع حوادث أقل.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ما زلت خاسرة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تحقق من وقتك، مع ذلك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد أنهيت أسرع بكثير من السباق الأول

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: فقط دُرت مرتين

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بالضبط. تذكرت أن تبطئ قبل الزوايا الحادة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت أكرر تعليماتك في رأسي

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد نجحت. كانت تلك لفة أفضل بكثير

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنت لطيف لأنني صديقتك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لكنت أخبرتك لو لم تتحسني

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هل ستلعب شيئًا معي الليلة؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: اللفة الأسرع لأنك قدت بشكل أفضل

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: حسناً، هذه إجابة جيدة ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هل تريد التوقف أم تجربة مسار مختلف؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: واحدة أخرى على هذا

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أريد أن أرى إذا كنت أستطيع فعل ذلك دون أي حوادث

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد سباق أخير واحد

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت قريباً من تحقيق ذلك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد لمست الحاجز فقط في النهاية

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لأنني شعرت بالحماس ونسيت أن أضغط على الفرامل

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نصفك الأول كان جيداً جداً. استمر في ذلك وسيتبع الباقي

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: انتظري. أنتِ تطلبين مني أن ألعب؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أريد إعادة مباراة في ليلة أخرى

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: سأكون سعيداً جداً بذلك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ما زلت مبتسماً لأنني سألت، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: قليلاً

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أحب أن أشارك هذا معك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وأنا أيضاً. حتى لو كنت صعبة المنال بشكل مزعج

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: الآن تفهم لماذا أريد دائماً جولة أخرى

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: للأسف، نعم 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هل كنت تلعب ألعاباً مثل هذه عندما كنت صغيراً؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نعم. كنت أميل جانباً مع وحدة التحكم كما لو أن ذلك سيساعدني على الانعطاف

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نعم 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: فعلت ذلك الليلة 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: إذن لديك غريزة ممتازة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: يبدو أن الجميع باستثناء السيارة فهموا ما أريده

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: سنعمل على جعل السيارة تشارك في المرة القادمة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: شكراً لك على صبرك معي الليلة

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: استمتعت كثيرًا. مش لازم تفوز عشان أستمتع باللعب معك

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: استمتعت أيضًا ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: حسنا. أستعد للغد، ثم النوم

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تصبح على خير، حبيبي. شكرًا لأنك طلبت مني اللعب

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تصبح على خير ❤️ سنفعلها مرة أخرى

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لماذا أنتِ متفاجئة هكذا؟

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنتِ لا تقترحين ذلك أبدًا. عادةً ما أكون أنا من يخبرك عن ألعابي

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنا سعيدة حقًا لأنكِ سألتِ، في الحقيقة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
No
Today I’ve got the whole day free
Miraculously
Want to come shopping with me then?
Shopping?
I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: أحتاج إلى سراويل جديدة. أزال الطبيب الجبس قبل يومين، لذا يمكنني أخيرًا ارتداء سراويل تناسبني جيدًا من جديد.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
Yes, with pleasure
I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: هايلين: كنت أستنى عذر عشان أطلع من البيت بدون شعور بالذنب الأكاديمي

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: اديني نص ساعة عشان أظهر أقل كوارثية 😅

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
Don’t start without me 😌
Yeah. How are you feeling today?
Better than yesterday
Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: هايلين: لسه شوي تعبانة بس دماغي مو شوربة تمامًا بعد

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: كويس. متى راح تشوفي أستاذك مرة ثانية؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: - هايدي: أحيانًا كل يوم إذا حس إنه أحتاجها

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: هو جاد جدًا بموضوع "الجلسات الإضافية" هذا.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مرحبًا ❤️ لقد قررت أننا لم نشاهد ذلك الفيلم وسمعتي لا تزال سليمة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
What about you? Better night?
Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أفضل بكثير، واستيقظت وطبخت الإفطار قبل ما أشيك على هاتفي

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: من غير ما تترك أثر للأشياء اللي سقطت؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
I've also put both shoes on
Sitting down?
Sitting down
See, you can be taught 😌
Good morning to you too, detective
How's your breakfast going?
It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الأمر جيد، لكن مشكلة تعبئة حقيبتي

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سآخذ المعكرونة من الليلة الماضية حتى لا يسرقني ساندويتش آخر

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت في المستقبل حصلت أخيراً على شيء من تلك العشاء

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد حصلت على طعام وحقيبة ممتلئة للغاية

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
Then I have to carry the book
Carry the book
You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تجعل كل شيء يبدو سهلاً جداً عندما لا تكون أنت من يحاول إغلاق هذه السحّاب 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا تبدأي، لم أتناول الإفطار بعد 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بما في ذلك أي شيء كان جالساً في القاع لمدة ثلاثة أسابيع؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت لا تعرف ما هو في القاع

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
That's not the point
Wait, I think I've got it
Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يرجى تقدير أنني ارتديت ملابسي وجاهزة قبل آخر دقيقة ممكنة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
Thank you handsome 😊
Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل ستجعلك وشاح أحمر تشعرين بتحسن؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تبدو الحقيبة وكأنها على وشك أن تخسر معركة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أثني على الفتاة، وليس على الأمتعة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
Much better 😌
Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل لديك دروس هذا الصباح مرة أخرى؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أود إنهاء كل شيء دون النظر إلى الساعة في الساعة الأخيرة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
What are you doing with your day?
Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأقوم بتنظيف خزانة المطبخ التي كنت أتجنبها

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأخفي جهاز التحكم عن بعد في المرة القادمة التي أتيت فيها

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الذي تسقط فيه الأشياء عليك عندما تفتحه؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أفضل أن أفكر فيه كميزة مفاجئة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنك أيضًا وضع أشياء أقل فيه 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أقوم بعمل مساحة لأكواب القهوة الجيدة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مهم، لا أريد أن تأتي أول قهوة صحيحة لنا من إبريق قياس

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: احتفظ بالجهد للقهوة، لن أحكم على الكوب كثيرًا ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
I'd like that
All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
