story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حسنًا، يجب أن أذهب قبل أن يتحول الوصول مبكرًا إلى تفويت الحافلة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ربما لن أكون على هاتفي كثيرًا هذا بعد الظهر

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا تنس غداءك بعد كل هذا الجهد

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: إنه بالفعل يحفر في جانبي، لا أستطيع نسيانه حتى لو حاولت 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أصل إلى البار الليلة، كما قلت

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
You too handsome ❤️ Love you
Love you too
It sounds like a warning 😌
Did you sleep well at least?
Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، بمجرد أن توقفت عن محاولة فهم كيف كان النهاية منطقية

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
Thanks for the vote of confidence
I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: رأيت شيئًا جميلًا بالقرب من المدخل

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: هايلين: ممكن نروح ندفع ونجيب أكل بعدين

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحبًا ❤️ نحن في البار، وأخيرًا جلست في مكان ليس كرسي مكتب

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ممكن تواصل السخرية من توصياتي، لكن يبدو أنك تحب هذه

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
See, that wasn't difficult
You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بتكون لا تطاق بخصوص هذا طوال الليل، مو كذا؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بس لحد ما توقفي تتظاهري بالدهشة إن عندي ذوق جيد

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
You don't have to
And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت؟ ماذا تفعل فعلاً عندما ما تكون في ذلك المكتب؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اخرج، وابحث عن مكان جيد للأكل، واذهب إلى مكان ما عندما يكون لدي يوم فراغ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وتخبر الجميع أين يجلسون عندما تصل هناك؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لازم أحد يوقفهم عن اختيار الطاولة بجانب الحمامات

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
Why would I?
I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما أقدر أقرر إذا كان هذا ثقة أو عدم حياء كامل

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بينما الموسيقيون يجهزون في الطرف الآخر من الغرفة...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
Looks like it
I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أظن أن هذا مجرد معدات من ليلة ثانية

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لدينا طاولة صغيرة بالقرب من الجدار الجانبي

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا أفكر إذا أطلب قائمة الطعام

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
You've noticed
I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أحمل مكرونة متبقية طوال اليوم. خليني أشوف شيء ثاني

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
I'm checking the time
Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قلت له أني سأخبره بما أفعله

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
Why?
So he knows why you're staying
I haven't said I'm staying yet
You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تنظر إلى تلك القائمة منذ خمس دقائق

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
Then stay and eat with me
All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسناً، أريد أن أسمع جزء من الموسيقى أيضاً

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
I thought you'd say that
Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
That does look nice
We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سنأخذ شيء للأكل قبل ما نغادر، في فرقة تبدأ هنا 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، ما كنت أدري أنهم عندهم موسيقى حية الليلة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: خبز مسطح وبطاطس مقلية، ما في شيء معقد

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل من حمل غداءك طوال المساء

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ذاك الحاوية فارغة الآن، يمكنها أن تتوقف عن الحكم على قراراتي 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أظن أنك جاي بس لشرب

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا كمان، لكننا نستمتع وانا ما أكلت منذ الغداء

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: والكرسي لا يحاول تدمير ظهري، وهو ما أقدره

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
Okay
When the food arrives...
Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: العشاء، قبل أن آكل كل البطاطس 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: رائحته جيدة أيضًا، سأأكل بينما هو ساخن

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
Talk in a bit ❤️
Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
Have you ordered?
I took one photo, you'll survive
They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كانوا يبدو أفضل بدون الهاتف بيننا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك الحصول على انتباهي دون أن تكون دراميًا بشأن ذلك

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
The flatbread?
No, the tablecloth
Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: استمر في الحديث وسأأكل نصفك أيضًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
You do have your uses
Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: احترس، هذه تكاد تكون مجاملة أخرى

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
A few songs into the set...
What did you say?
Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انقل كرسيك إلى هنا، لا أريد أن أصرخ عبر الطاولة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان يمكنك فقط أن تطلب مني أن أجلس بجانبك

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
In the most bossy way possible
And yet you're moving the chair
Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لأنني لا أستطيع سماعك، لا تبدو سعيدًا جدًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دعني أنقل حقيبتي قبل أن تضع قدمك فيها

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل سيحصل الكتاب على كرسي خاص به أيضًا؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لديه آداب أفضل منك، يستحق واحدًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} تنقل كرسيها بجانب مديرها لتسمعه فوق الموسيقى

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تميل أقرب للإجابة عليه، ويدها تستقر لفترة قصيرة على ساعده

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يدها على ذراعه هي ما يؤلمني. إيماءة صغيرة جدًا، وأنا جالس هنا أتساءل إلى أي حد سيقتربان.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
A Little Closer
You know this one?
Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، لا تطلب مني أن أغنيها

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to risk the evening
Excuse you, I might be very good
You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قد تكون. أنا أستمتع بهذا كثيرًا لأكتشف

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
Did the cupboard survive you?
You laughed
That doesn't make you less horrible
You're different out here
Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أقل تعبًا مما كنت عليه في السادسة؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت فعلاً تحافظ على نظريتك عندما تتحدث إليّ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
I like looking at you
You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك أن تحاول أن تكون أكثر دقة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
I noticed
It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إنها حاليًا في عدة أكوام في المطبخ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
After the set, with the plates cleared...
I should check the bus times
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يجب أن أتحقق من مواعيد الحافلات

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get the bill
I can pay for my food
I invited you
That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا لا يعني أنني لا أستطيع الدفع

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
You really are like this everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت حقًا هكذا في كل مكان

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم تكن لديك ليلة مملة، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لذا أنت في النقطة التي تندم فيها على البدء 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك حافلة بعد حوالي عشرين دقيقة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
Please?
Get your jacket, please
See, you can learn
Deeply
Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اترك لي على الأقل كوبًا قابلًا للاستخدام، حسنًا؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأضع هاتفي جانبًا قليلاً، سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أعود إلى المنزل ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
At their table, a little later...
A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تم اكتشاف محادثة في البار بالقرب من {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قالت إنه مجرد مشروب بعد العمل. أريد أن أصدق أنني أستطيع الاسترخاء، لكنني أواصل النظر إلى الشاشة.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
You look good
You saw me at work an hour ago
There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك طعام أيضًا، لذا فهي تفوز كثيرًا 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل هذا هو السبب في أنك كنت تنظر إلي؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل كنت تعتقد أنني أتحقق مما إذا كنت قد أنهيت التقرير؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
The report got finished, didn't it?
No work talk tonight
You brought it up
I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنني أن أخبر بالفعل أنك ستكون مرهقًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: كنت سأقول إنني قضيت مساءً جيدًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: بشكل ما، لا زلت تجعلين ذلك يبدو مغرورًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
Don't push your luck
Worth a try
I need to go now
Your bus isn't here yet
I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
All right. See you tomorrow
Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: فقط لأنك كنت تجعلني أنحني لأجيب

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
That's where I'll be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: هذا هو المكان الذي سأكون فيه

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night
Good night, {{name:lena}}
A little later, on the bus home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: بعد قليل، في الحافلة إلى المنزل...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: أنا في الحافلة ❤️ سأكون في المنزل قريبًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: نعم، وأخيرًا تم أخذ حقيبتي من على كتفي

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: لقد كان يومه أكثر إثارة بكثير مما يستحق 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
Was it a long walk to the stop?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: هل كانت مسافة طويلة إلى المحطة؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: لا، لقد مشى معي حتى الزاوية، ثم ذهبت لأنتظر الحافلة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أكون داخل

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right
Once she is home...
Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: مرحبًا ❤️ أنا في المنزل، هل تمكنت من البقاء مستيقظًا؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here
Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: آسفة لأننا بقينا لفترة أطول مما توقعت

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: أنت سريع جدًا في تحديد ما أفعله وما لا أمانع فيه

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: كان الطعام جيدًا وانتهى الأمر بالفرقة لعزف مجموعة كاملة

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?
Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: معظمها أغاني مغطاة، بعضها كنت أعرفه والعديد منها تظاهرت أنني أعرفه 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: إيماءة مقنعة جدًا تأخذك بعيدًا بشكل مدهش

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: سأتذكر ذلك في المرة القادمة التي تشاهدني ألعب فيها شيئًا

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: هذا مختلف تمامًا، أنا دائمًا أفهم قراراتك المعقدة في اللعبة 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: كانت الحانة لطيفة. لم أكن هناك من قبل

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ثم أخبرني. هل قضيت ليلة جيدة؟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: نعم، وقد قضى جزءًا جيدًا من المساء يتأكد من أنني أقدر ذوقه الممتاز

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: يبدو أنه هو نفس الشخص خارج العمل إذن

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: هو بالتأكيد يحب أن يحصل على ما يريد

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: جعلته يضيف 'من فضلك' عندما طلب مني أن أحضر سترتي

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
I'm choosing to count it 😌
You sound like you enjoyed yourself
I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: نعم، كان من الجيد الخروج قليلاً

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, I did
I'm glad you're home
Me too ❤️
Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: أعطني دقيقة لتغيير ملابسي، لا أريد الجلوس في هذه الملابس أكثر من ذلك

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
A few minutes later...
There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ها هي، لا أحذية ولا شيء آخر لحمله

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
Much. The bag can wait until morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: كثيرًا. يمكن للحقيبة الانتظار حتى الصباح

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At least take the lunch box out
There we go

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: لا أستطيع الانتظار حتى أحصل على دبلوماي في يدي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: سهل نسيانه لما يكون دائماً لابس ملابس رياضية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: أريد جسمي الصيفي في المقام الأول

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That comment yesterday really got to you, huh?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: التعليق اللي قلتيه أمس أثر فيك، صح؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to look good in a bikini this summer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: أريد أن أبدو رائعة في البيكيني هذا الصيف

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I need to start now
We have a session planned today
I'm not completely sure about the diploma yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: لست متأكدًا تمامًا من الشهادة بعد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you're the one who suggested I keep him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ومع ذلك أنت من اقترح أن أحتفظ به

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But I'm going to keep pushing until the end
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: لكنني سأستمر في الدفع حتى النهاية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I didn't think studying with Ethan would give you this much motivation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: لم أكن أعتقد أن الدراسة مع إيثان ستعطيك هذه الحماسة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The carrot at the end of the stick is very motivating 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: الجزر في نهاية العصا محفز جداً 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're not even trying to hide it anymore
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: أنت حتى مش بتحاول تخفيها بعد الآن

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can come down whenever you want

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صباح الخير ❤️ لقد فقدت حلقًا وقررت بطريقة ما أنه ذنبك، كيف تسير صباحك؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان ذلك سلسًا بشكل مريب لشخص استيقظ للتو

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been awake a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد كنت مستيقظًا منذ فترة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Couldn't sleep?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لم تستطع النوم؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: استيقظت مبكرًا ولم أستطع أن أكون مرتاحًا مرة أخرى

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا شيء درامي، مجرد جدال مع الوسائد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could have messaged me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان يمكنك مراسلتي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت ستجيب ثم تلومني على كوني متعبًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا مختلف تمامًا عن لومك على المجوهرات

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بالطبع

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, found it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: انتظر، وجدته

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذه اتهام مثير للإعجاب قبل الإفطار

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان عالقًا في كمّي طوال الوقت

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that apology in writing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أريد تلك الاعتذار مكتوبًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عزيزي الوسيم، أندم أن الأدلة لم تدعم اتهامي المعقول جدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Accepted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مقبول

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: رائع، الآن ساعدني في تحديد ما إذا كانت هذه تبدو جيدة معًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بعد دقيقتين

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كلا الأقراط، كلا الحذاء، ملاحظات المحاضرة الفعلية في الحقيبة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: انطباع مقنع جدًا عن امرأة تملك حياتها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it took several attempts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: شكرًا، استغرق الأمر عدة محاولات

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was reading your messages while putting them on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت أقرأ رسائلك أثناء ارتدائها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And yes, they look good together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، تبدو جيدة معًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I'm not changing again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جيد، لأنني لن أغير مرة أخرى

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never going to listen to me, were you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لم تكن لتستمع إليّ أبدًا، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not if you were wrong 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ليس إذا كنت مخطئًا 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling about today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كيف تشعر بشأن اليوم؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أرسلت رسالة إلى {{name:aiden}} قبل أن أبدأ في الاستعداد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ثم ضحكت، وأسقطت واحدة، والآن لدي أذن أنيقة جدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Asked if he had a few minutes after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأل إذا كان لديه بضع دقائق بعد الحصة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What did he say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ماذا قال؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، ثم سأل إذا كان يجب أن يحضر الملاحظات التي اقترضها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least he remembers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: على الأقل هو يتذكر

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He still has no idea what I want to talk about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا يزال ليس لديه أي فكرة عما أريد التحدث عنه

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وهذا يجعلني أرغب في شرح كل شيء عبر الرسائل فقط لأتجاوز الجملة الأولى

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would that actually make it easier?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل سيسهل ذلك حقًا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For about ten seconds
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لمدة عشر ثوانٍ تقريبًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ثم سأقضي الصباح كله أتساءل عما إذا كان يضحك على هاتفه

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're allowed to open with something awkward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنك البدء بشيء محرج

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let me see the damage
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: دعني أرى الأضرار

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أعلم، لكنني كنت آمل أن أتجاوز مباشرة إلى أن أكون ساحرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You managed with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد نجحت معي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت جمهورًا متسامحًا بشكل غير عادي ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You had me at the first insult
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أخذتني من أول إهانة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ربما يجب أن أبدأ بإخباره أنه مزعج

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might not realize this is a special conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قد لا يدرك أن هذه محادثة خاصة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly my concern
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا بالضبط ما يقلقني

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأتحدث معه بشكل صحيح بعد الحصة، قبل أن أعطي نفسي عذرًا آخر

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sound much too pleased about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تبدو سعيدًا جدًا بشأن هذا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I published the profile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد نشرت الملف الشخصي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Already?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بالفعل؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قبل أن أتمكن من إعادة كتابة المقدمة للمرة السادسة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الصورة من الليلة الماضية، والجزء عن كوني في علاقة، ومشكلتي الجذابة جدًا مع المعكرونة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A strong introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مقدمة قوية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أضفت أنني أعني قهوة حقيقية في مقهى حقيقي، وليس شخصًا يدعو نفسه إلى منزلي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يبدو أن هذا يشبهك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وضعت الهاتف مقلوبًا بعد ذلك كما لو كان سيبدأ في إعطائي التعليمات

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You know you don't have to answer anything during class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت تعرف أنك مش مضطر تجاوب على أي شيء أثناء الحصة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنا أفعل، وسأتركه وحده حتى استراحتي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: في الغالب لأنني لا أريد أن تحتوي أول إجابة لي على جملة من محاضرة اليوم

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Depends on the lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يعتمد على المحاضرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا أحد يستحق ملاحظاتي عن طرق البحث كمقدمة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find someone with very specific interests
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنك أن تجد شخصًا لديه اهتمامات محددة جدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already have one of those 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عندي واحد من هؤلاء بالفعل 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Fair enough
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عادل بما فيه الكفاية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It feels strange that it's actually there now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يبدو غريبًا أنه موجود فعلاً الآن

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لكنني سعيدة لأنني ضغطت الزر بدلاً من قضاء يوم آخر في تعديل الفواصل

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I see the problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أرى المشكلة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What time do you finish?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: في أي وقت تنتهي؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حوالي وقت الغداء، إلا إذا اكتشف أحدهم سؤالًا justo عندما نغادر

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وعندي كتاب يجب أن أرجعه قبل أن تبدأ المكتبة في إرسال رسائل بريد إلكتروني تهددني بأدب

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A busy day of facing your enemies
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يوم مشغول في مواجهة أعدائك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You, university, the library
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت، الجامعة، المكتبة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm on the list?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنا على القائمة؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جعلتني أفتقدك بينما كنت أحاول أن أرتدي ملابسي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عفواً

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That wasn't a thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لم تكن تلك شكرًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وضعت المعكرونة الخاصة بك في حاوية منفصلة، بالمناسبة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أخيرًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لذا الآن لدي سبب عملي جدًا للقدوم قريبًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You already have several very impractical ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لديك بالفعل العديد منها غير العملية.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Those are my favorites ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هؤلاء هم المفضلين لدي ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حسناً، سأغادر الآن قبل أن أبدأ محادثة أخرى معك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good luck today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حظاً سعيداً اليوم

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: شكراً لك، وسيم.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وتناول فطوراً لم يخرج من علبة بجانب وحدة التحكم.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've narrowed down my options considerably
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد ضيقت خياراتي بشكل كبير.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ما زلت تبدو جميلة، مما يضعف قضيتك ضدي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have a crush on him, don't you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ما زلتِ معجبة به، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm ready, let's go before you say something even worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أنا جاهزة، دعينا نذهب قبل أن تقولي شيئًا أسوأ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're going to be late for {{name:aiden}}
You're not going to a party
I know… but I still want to look good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أعرف... لكنني ما زلت أريد أن أبدو جيدة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But with that outfit he's only going to be looking at your ass the whole time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لكن مع هذا الزي، هو فقط سينظر إلى مؤخرتك طوال الوقت

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still can't believe you're continuing after the main exam
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ما زلت لا أصدق أنك مستمرة بعد الامتحان الرئيسي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a really good supervisor
Or rather… really good punishments and rewards 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أو بالأحرى… عقوبات ومكافآت جيدة جداً 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have to actually study though
It's hard to focus when you do that…
So the reward came before the work this time, and my feelings about that are harder to joke away.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: إذًا جاءت المكافأة قبل الجهد هذه المرة، وصار من الأصعب تبديد مشاعري بالمزاح.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of physical reward during study session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK أرشفت دليل المكافأة المادية خلال جلسة الدراسة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll do my best to make sure you get the best grade possible then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: سأبذل قصارى جهدي لضمان حصولك على أفضل درجة ممكنة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Ethan is coming to pick me up
Why doesn't he just come to the house?
We're more comfortable at his place

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مرحباً 😊 انتهت الحصص، أعدت كتاب المكتبة، وسرقت مكاناً مشمساً على الدرج.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لأنه إذا كنا سنجرب شيئاً مثل هذا، أفضل أن يكون مع شخص نثق به

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Both of you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كلاكما؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. هو يثق بك، وأنا أيضاً

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعرف أنك تستطيع المزاح حول أي شيء، لكنني أيضاً أعلم أنني أستطيع أن أخبرك عندما يكون هناك شيء مهم

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أوه

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was that the part that finally shut you up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل كانت هذه هي النقطة التي أخيرًا جعلتك تصمت؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For a second, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لحظة، نعم.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا يعني لي الكثير. لم أتوقع تلك النقطة أيضًا.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا تبدو متفاجئًا جدًا. أحيانًا أقول أشياء لطيفة عنك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ليس عادةً دون أن تناديني بالأحمق بعد ذلك مباشرة.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did the morning go?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كيف كانت صباحك؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can still do that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما زلت أستطيع فعل ذلك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ها هي.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا متأثرة. حقًا. لكن من الغريب أيضًا أن أعلم أن صديقي مرتاح لفكرة أن أخرج مع صديقته.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنك أن تكون متأثرًا وتجد الأمر غريبًا. أنا أشعر بالفضول والحرج في نفس الوقت.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed the embarrassed part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد لاحظت الجزء المحرج.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالطبع لاحظت.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد قضيت خمس دقائق تتجنب عيني بعد أن مشيت هنا لتطلب مني الخروج.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت آمل ألا تشير إلى ذلك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم تختارني بسبب قدرتي على البقاء صامتًا.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly that was an oversight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: من الواضح أن ذلك كان سهوًا.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fine once I actually started listening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كانت جيدة بمجرد أن بدأت في الاستماع.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لكن هل تريد هذا حقًا؟ ليس فقط لأنه يحب الفكرة؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم أكن لأتيت هنا إذا كنت أريد فقط أن أجعله سعيدًا.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحب أن أكون حولك. أنا فضولية بشأن كيف سيكون الشعور إذا توقفنا عن التظاهر بأن كل هذه المعاكسة كانت مجرد مزحة.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لقد لاحظت، إذن.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not nearly as subtle as you think
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت لست خفيًا كما تظن.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to be charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أحاول أن أكون ساحرًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحيانًا تنجح. لا تجعلني أندم على اعترافي بذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت تجعل الأمر صعبًا جدًا لأتصرف بشكل عادي حيال هذا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم تكن عاديًا منذ أن قلت الجملة الأولى

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عادل. ونعم، أود أن أخرج معك لتناول القهوة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: على الرغم من أنني كتبت التاريخ في المكان الخطأ ثلاث مرات قبل أن ألاحظ.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت متأكد؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مفاجئ، وليس غير مهتم. هناك فرق

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جيد، لأنك للحظة بدوت وكأنك تحاول إيجاد المخرج

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أحاول التفكير في شيء أقل إحراجًا من أن أطلب منك تكرار كل شيء للمرة الثالثة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if this was something we'd agreed on, I said yes, and he didn't keep trying to turn it into a secret
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأل إذا كان هذا شيء اتفقنا عليه، قلت له نعم، وما حاول يحوله لسر بعدين

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we got to have an ordinary conversation, which was the part I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وبعدين قدرنا نتحدث بشكل عادي، وهذا كان الجزء اللي أريده

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What made you answer him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وش اللي خلاك ترد عليه؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One of his pictures was a very burnt pizza with an apology underneath it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: واحدة من صوره كانت بيتزا محترقة جداً مع اعتذار تحتها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So you chose him for his cooking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يعني اخترتيه عشان طباخته؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I chose him because it made me laugh, which seemed like a reasonable place to start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: اخترته لأنه خلاني أضحك، وهذا كان مكان معقول نبدأ منه

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: رسالته الأولى سألت إذا كان الناس الخياليين اللي أطبخ لهم يساعدوني في غسل الصحون

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better than asking whether you're single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أفضل من سؤال إذا كنت عازب

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sentence at a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جملة واحدة في كل مرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A significant improvement
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تحسن كبير

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قلت له إنهم ضيوف سيئين جداً، فقال إن ضيفه الوحيد في العشاء جاب طفاية حريق كنوع من المزاح

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because of the pizza?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بسبب البيتزا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يبدو أن هناك عدة محاولات قبل البيتزا في الصورة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أستطيع أن أقرر إذا كانت المثابرة تستحق الإعجاب

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to let him cook for you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما تحتاجيش تخليه يطبخ لك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ذكرت ذلك واقترح على الفور مكانًا به موظفين حقيقيين 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds sensible of him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا يبدو منطقيًا منه

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عمره ستة وعشرون عامًا، يعمل في الجانب الآخر من المدينة، وليس جزءًا من دائرتنا الجامعية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أعرفه بعد، بالطبع، لكن أعجبني أنه يستطيع التحدث دون محاولة إبهاري في كل جملة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's annoyingly sensible
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا منطقي بشكل مزعج

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل تشعر بالراحة في التحدث إليه؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حتى الآن، نعم، وجعلني أضحك دون أن يحاول كثيرًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحتفظ ببعض التفاصيل الصغيرة لنفسي، لكن هذا شخص جديد، ليس أحدًا من أصدقائنا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's enough for now, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا يكفي الآن، إذن

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحببت أيضًا أنني أستطيع أخذ بضع دقائق للرد دون أن يسألني أين اختفيت

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عدم جعل هاتفك يبدو كأنه واجب منزلي هو بداية جيدة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالضبط

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأضع هاتفي الآن، وإلا سأستمر في التحدث إليك بدلاً من ذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عندما توقفنا، كنا نتحدث عن تناول القهوة غدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already picked somewhere?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل اخترت مكانًا بالفعل؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: اقترحت المقهى بالقرب من الشارع الرئيسي للتسوق، الذي لديه نوافذ كبيرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مكان أعرفه، في فترة بعد الظهر، ومجرد مشروب لنرى إذا كنا نتوافق شخصيًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Does that feel like something you want to do?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل يبدو لك أن هذا شيء تود القيام به؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وجدت نفسي أكتب الاقتراح قبل أن يسأل، في الواقع

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما فاجأني أكثر من تلقي الرسائل في المقام الأول

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You sound happy about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تبدو سعيدًا بذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تابع. سأكون هنا لاحقًا ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم أبحث عن شخص لأحقق شيئًا، بل كان لدي حديث استمتعت به وأردت آخر

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds more like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا يبدو أكثر مثلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It felt like me, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان شعوري كذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وساعدني أنني لم أكن أحاول تحديثك في نفس الوقت

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الآن يمكنني التحدث إليك بدلاً من التنقل بين حديثين

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أفضل ذلك على أن أحصل على نصف جملة من كل منهما

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: شكراً لك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: على أي حال، هذه صديقتك بعد أن أرسلت رسالة طبيعية بنجاح دون إعادة كتابتها عشرين مرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look pleased with yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تبدو راضيًا عن نفسك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، وأنا أسمح لنفسي بخمس دقائق من ذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can have more than five
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنك أن تأخذ أكثر من خمس دقائق

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dangerous, I might become unbearable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا خطر، قد أصبح لا يُطاق

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأتحمل المخاطرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This photo is for you, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذه الصورة لك، بالمناسبة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لن أعطي أي شخص آخر النسخة مني وأنا أحتفل بانتصار صغير جدًا 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll treasure the exclusive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأعتز بهذه النسخة الحصرية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد بضع دقائق

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأؤكد الوقت لاحقًا عندما أعرف ما إذا كانت اجتماع المجموعة غدًا سيبقى في الصباح

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قل لي الليلة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأفعل ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا تنسَ أنك لديك صديق أيضًا يستمتع بالحديث عن أشياء غير متعلقة بالجامعة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't forgotten you for a second
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم أنساك لحظة واحدة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لكن قولي لي شيء عادي من يومك قبل أن أذهب

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: فتحت لعبة لأفعل شيء واحد وقضيت نصف ساعة أغير الإعدادات

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That is painfully believable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا مؤلم ولكنه معقول

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أبدأ في التفكير أنك هربت من مخرج آخر

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: المرأة على المكتب لم تنظر إلي حتى.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ثم عدت إلى الإعدادات القديمة لأنني أفضلها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: شكراً لك، هذا جعلني أشعر بأنني أكثر إنتاجية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy to help
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سعيدة بمساعدتك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: راسلني لاحقاً، أريد أن أعرف إذا كنت تلعبها فعلاً ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كدت أفعل، لكن لدي سمعة بأنني موثوق

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Since when?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: منذ متى؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making an excellent first impression
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تترك انطباعًا أول رائع

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: First impression? I thought I was well past that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: انطباع أول؟ كنت أعتقد أنني تجاوزت ذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on, let's walk a little
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هيا، دعنا نمشي قليلاً

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects enter the courtyard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: شخصان يدخلان الفناء

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تستمر المحادثة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنني أن أترك لها مساحة للاختيار دون التظاهر بأنني لا أشعر بشيء.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Away from the Crowd
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعيدًا عن الحشد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, now you actually are making me curious
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسنًا، الآن أنت تجعلني فضولياً بالفعل

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل تذكر ما قلته أمس؟ عن رغبتي في التحدث في مكان أكثر هدوءًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، وقد كنت ناضجًا جدًا بعدم سؤالك اثني عشر مرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعددت اعتذاراً لجهاز فقط أصدر صوتاً.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أقدر الجهد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this a good place?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل هذا مكان جيد؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, let's sit for a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، دعنا نجلس لدقيقة.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت تفعل ذلك الشيء بحزام حقيبتك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What thing?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أي شيء؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Twisting it around your fingers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تدور به حول أصابعك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم ألاحظ ذلك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا تحتاج لجعل ما يحدث هنا يبدو مثالياً.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A very moving exchange

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا و{{name:player}} كنا بنتكلم عن إني أخرج في موعد مع حد تاني

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, what the fuck?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little quieter, please

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: معلش، بس... {{name:player}} عايزك تخرجي في موعد مع راجل تاني؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. لقد كنا نتحدث عن ذلك منذ فترة.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذاً، أنا بالتأكيد أفتقد شيئاً، لأنني سأكون أتساءل لماذا تريد صديقتي مواعدة شخص آخر.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هو من طرح الفكرة. يحب فكرة أن أكون مع شخص آخر، وأن نقرر معاً.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعتقد أننا كبرنا كأشخاص.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هو من طرحها؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. وبعد الحديث عن ذلك، أدركت أنني كنت فضولية أيضاً.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت جاد؟ هل أنتما لا تحاولان معرفة ما سأقوله؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل أبدو وكأنني أستمتع بشرح هذا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسنًا، لكن لماذا تخبرني؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لأنني أردت أن أسألك كيف ستشعر إذا كنت تلك الشخص

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا؟ انتظر، تعني أنك تريد الخروج معي في موعد؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا تفعل ذلك، أنا لا زلت أحاول اللحاق بك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، أنت. لهذا السبب طلبت منك أن تلتقي بي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يا إلهي. وهو يعرف أنني أنا؟ ليس مجرد شخص لا يعرفه؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تحدثنا عنك بشكل محدد، لذا هذا ليس شيئًا أطرحه من وراء ظهره

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لذا هو يعرف أنك هنا الآن، تسألني هذا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. كان يعرف أنني سأتحدث إليك بعد الحصة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أتوقع منه أن يخبرني بالتوقف عن مغازلتك. هذه محادثة مختلفة تمامًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: على ما يبدو. كان لدي نفس التعبير على وجهي عندما تحدثنا عن ذلك لأول مرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يا له من مسكين. أخيرًا يخبرك بما يدور في ذهنه والآن نحن هنا نقارن ردود أفعالنا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت من تحدق في وجهي كما لو كنت قد طلبت منك مساعدتي في سرقة بنك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بجد، لم أتوقع أبداً أن أسمع هذا النوع من الاقتراحات منكما

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قرار موضة عملي جدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا أحتوي على الكثير

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأحتفظ بالزي إذن

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: العشاء أم أنا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وإذا قررت إرسال صورة له، ستحصل على تلك أيضًا، كما قلنا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا كان فقط من أجلك، لم أرسله إلى أي مكان آخر

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب الحصول على المعاينة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذن قدّره، كان هناك صراع غير مشرف مع الجاكيت قبل أن أضعه

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يا للأسف، فاتني ذلك الجزء

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سألتني عن العشاء

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا فقط بيننا، بالمناسبة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أجعل الغد مجموعة من الأشياء التي يجب عليك النظر إليها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت سأشعر بخيبة أمل إذا فاتني الفستان

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: صور صديقتك العادية لن تتوقف 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه الصورة فقط من أجلك، ليست تقريرًا عن شيء أرسلته له

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك الاستمتاع بالفستان ودعني أحتفظ ببعض الأشياء الصغيرة لنفسي غدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنني العيش مع ذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد، لأنني أستمتع بعدم التخطيط لكل جملة مسبقًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك أن تُظهر المبادرة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه الصورة فقط من أجلك، لم أرسلها له

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وغدًا يمكنني ترك هاتفي وحده أثناء حديثنا، ثم أخبرك عنه لاحقًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا لا يزال يبدو صحيحًا بالنسبة لي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
