story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنا أيضًا، لا أريد أن أقضي قهوتنا الأولى وأنا أنظر إلى الشاشة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حدث شيء آخر بينما كنت أجرب هذا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ماذا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: العشاء يبدو لذيذًا، وأتمنى لو كنت جالسًا أمامك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وجدت نفسي أتساءل إذا كان سيعجبه

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم أردت على الفور رؤية وجهك عندما رأيته

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب أنك أردت كلاهما

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنا أيضًا، في الواقع

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أعتقد أن هذه المشاعر قد تعيقنا عن بعضنا البعض

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكنني كنت هنا فقط أريد أن أريك الفستان

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة أنك فعلت

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنا أيضاً ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا أفضل ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وما زالت جلسة الفيلم بعد الظهر قائمة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وضعت علبة المعكرونة في مقدمة الثلاجة حتى لا أنساها عندما أتيت

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت سأسمح لك بالدخول حتى بدونها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعلم، لكن من المهم أن تفهم كم أنا زائرة كريمة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كريمة في الطعام، لكن بلا رحمة مع جهاز التحكم عن بعد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت وافقت أن أختار

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أتذكر.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد، لقد وجدت شيئًا يمكنك فيه رؤية الممثلين فعلاً

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن تتخلى عن ذلك أبدًا، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أتخلى عن ذلك حتى أعرف من كان واقفًا في ذلك المدخل

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكن عليك أن تتوقف عن جعلني أضحك بينما أحاول الأكل

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أحد يعرف، هذه جزء من الفيلم

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نظام فظيع

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انتظر، سأغير ملابسي قبل أن أنام في ملابس الغد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد 8 دقائق

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل بكثير، سأحتفظ بهذه الملابس دون أي جمهور على الإطلاق

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حتى أنا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have a small exception
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك أن تحصل على استثناء صغير

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like this version too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب هذه النسخة أيضًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد، لأن هذه هي النسخة التي ستحصل عليها أثناء فيلمنا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا وعود في هذا الجزء

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: طالما أنني سأجلس بجانبك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه هي الفكرة ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأضع هاتفي قبل أن أجد سببًا آخر لإبقائك مستيقظًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبحين على خير، يا فتاة جميلة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبح على خير، وسيم

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأتناول الإفطار قبل أن أضطر للسؤال غدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أغادر أبدًا 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف حال ساقك بعد اليوم؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أكلت، ولعبت فعلاً لفترة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شعرت بالتعب قليلاً، لكنني لم أضغط على نفسي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحببت الخروج، حتى لو لم يكن مغامرة بالضبط

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا يجب أن تكون مغامرة لتكون جيدة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أسمعك تتحدث بعقلانية

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: استخدمت الكثير من الشجاعة اليوم، سأحتفظ بما تبقى

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وعلى ذكر ذلك، تم ترتيب الغد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مع الإعدادات كما كانت من قبل؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} ينتهي مبكرًا بما فيه الكفاية، لذا سنلتقي في المقهى بالقرب من الحرم الجامعي في الساعة الثالثة والنصف

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الذي يحتوي على الكراسي غير المتطابقة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل بدا مختلفًا عندما أرسل لك رسالة؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ربما كان أكثر حذرًا قليلاً

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس محرجًا، فقط أقل إصرارًا على تحويل كل شيء إلى نكتة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ربما أدهشته

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد أدهشت نفسي بالتأكيد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أضع أشيائي عندما تذكرت ما سألته بالفعل

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم وقفت في الممر أبتسم بلا سبب

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أحب أن أرى ذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا داعي لذكر ذلك مرة أخرى

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا، كنت ستسأل عن سبب ابتسامتي وتزيد الأمر سوءًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالتأكيد تقريبًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الجزء الغريب هو أنني أعرفه بالفعل

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: غدًا سأكون أنظر إلى شخص مألوف وأتساءل إذا كان سيقول شيئًا لم أسمعه من قبل

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل هذا هو الجزء الذي يثير فضولك؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، أعتقد أنه كذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أحاول تحويله إلى شخص آخر، أريد فقط أن أرى كيف سيكون الأمر عندما نتوقف عن التظاهر بأنه غداء عادي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سنلتقي في المقهى بجانب الشارع الرئيسي للتسوق في الثالثة والنصف

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك حاجة بسيطة لذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اخترته لأنني أعرف مكانه ولن أضيع أول عشر دقائق أبحث عن المكان

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اختيار جيد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وسأذهب هناك بمفردي، لا أريد مساعدة من شخص لم ألتق به بعد

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل تحدثتما كثيرًا هذا المساء؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قليلًا قبل العشاء

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم أخبرته أنني أتناول الطعام وسأضع الهاتف بعيدًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف أخذ ذلك؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مثل شخص عادي لديه أشياء أخرى للقيام بها

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أنه شيء صغير، لكنني أحببت عدم الحاجة لشرح نفسي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل تعتقد أنك ستنسجم معه شخصيًا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ماذا صنعت؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أتمنى ذلك، لكن لهذا السبب أريد أن ألتقي به بدلاً من تخيل شخصيته بالكامل من الرسائل.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أعرف إذا كان هادئًا في البداية أو يتحدث بإيماءات يديه أو يضحك على نكاته.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لديك بالفعل شخص يفعل ذلك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، وهو يصر دائمًا على أنها نكات ممتازة.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هي كذلك.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أترى؟ غير معقول تمامًا 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب أن هناك أشياء لا أعرفها بعد.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس بما يكفي لدعوته إلى حياتي دفعة واحدة، بل يكفي فقط لرغبة في تناول القهوة.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: عجة وسلطة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسنًا، دورك الآن.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دوري في ماذا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما هو أول شيء خطر ببالك عندما قلت إنني سألتقي به غدًا؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس الجواب الداعم جدًا، بل الأول.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بصراحة؟ ابتسمت قبل أن أنتهي من القراءة.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أريد هذا، لكن فجأة يبدو أكثر واقعية بكثير.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بهذه السرعة؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، خاصة لأنك بدوت سعيدًا عندما أخبرتني.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم حاولت أن أفكر في شيء أقل وضوحًا لأقوله بدلاً من كم كنت مبتسمًا.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان بإمكانك أن تقول ذلك فقط.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ماذا حدث لكل المعكرونة؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أكن أريد أن أحول فترة بعد الظهر الخاصة بك إلى رد فعلي.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما زلت أريد أن أسمع ردك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أريد أن يكون دورك في هذا مجرد السؤال عما إذا كنت بخير

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذن نعم، أنا متحمسة، وأنا سعيدة لأنك أردت أن تسأله

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد فعلت

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأحب أن أعلم أنك جالس هناك مبتسم في هاتفك أيضًا ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حقيقي بطريقة سيئة؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس سيئًا، فقط مختلف عن الحديث عن بعد ظهر خيالي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أخذت استراحة قبل أن تبدأ المعكرونة وأنا في كره بعضنا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الآن هناك وقت فعلي، وغدًا ستستعد وتذهب

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان لدي نفس اللحظة الصغيرة عندما وضعته في تقويمي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما زلت أريدك أن تذهب، فقط لم أتوقع أن ألاحظ الفرق كثيرًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شكرًا لك على إخباري بدلاً من محاولة الظهور بمظهر مسترخٍ تمامًا

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أطلب منك أن تقنعني بعدم القيام بذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ولن أقضي غدًا أحاول أن أقدم لك قصة مثالية عن ذلك

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد، لأنني أفضل أن أسمع عن بعد ظهرك الفعلي

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذن هذا ما ستحصل عليه ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انتظري، ها هي الدليل أنني أستطيع صنع وجبة مختلفة

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: مو أكثر من المغازلة مع {{name:aiden}} اللي كانت ممتعة؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: ما عندي فكرة عن شو تتكلمين 😇

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: أنا بس سعيدة إنكم الاثنين تستمتعون

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
I had a really good session
I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: تنجحين في إدخال إيثان سريرك، صح؟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
I need to rest after today

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: لأنه إذا كان لديك، فأنت صامت بشكل مريب

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: أنا فقط بارعة جدًا في ملاحظة متى يتأخر الناس في مدحهم

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: على أي حال، أشعر بالملل الشديد

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
Because the year is basically over
I don’t technically need to show up anymore
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: لا أحتاج تقنيًا للحضور بعد الآن

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: So I’m taking my well-deserved freedom very seriously
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: لذا، أنا آخذ حريتي المستحقة على محمل الجد

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: It’s not skipping if there’s nothing left to learn
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: ليس تخطيًا إذا لم يتبقى شيء لتتعلمه

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And a free woman is currently very bored
I’ve been in bed too long
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: لقد كنت في السرير لفترة طويلة جدًا

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Or I’ll start posting worse stories just to force you to react
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: أو سأبدأ بنشر قصص أسوأ فقط لأجبرك على التفاعل

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: New day, same face, still cute 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: يوم جديد، نفس الوجه، لا زلت لطيفة 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: كدت أفتح لعبة السباق بدل ملاحظات المحاضرة 😭

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What's up?
I have a presentation to prepare for university
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: عندي عرض تقديمي أحتاج أجهزه للجامعة

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: الشريحة تقريبًا جاهزة، لكنني أضيع مكاني عندما أمارس بصوت عالٍ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come over after your day. You can practise with me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: تعال بعد يومك. يمكنك أن تتدرب معي

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd sit through it?
Of course. What is it about?
Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ولاء العملاء. لماذا يعود الناس لنفس العمل

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: يمكنني طرح الأسئلة. خاصة عندما تضيعني

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: من فضلك. أفضل أن أكتشف الأجزاء المحيرة معك بدلاً من أمام الجميع

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then bring your notes
Already planning your comeback?
Okay ❤️
University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: الجامعة، العمل، ثم أنت. هذا هو ترتيب يوم الاثنين الخاص بي

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for the first part
Looking very prepared
The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: الحقيبة تحتوي على الملاحظات. فقط يجب أن أتذكر استخدامها

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll be fine
You have to listen properly tonight, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: لكن عليك أن تستمع جيدًا الليلة

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No distracting me halfway through
I'll save it for after
Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ربما. لكن تذكرت أن لدي فصل دراسي هذا الصباح

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I walked right into that one 😌
I'll let you know when I can get away from work
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: سأخبرك عندما أستطيع الابتعاد عن العمل

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Have a good morning, love
You too ❤️
The rematch can wait
I really liked playing with you yesterday
You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ما خلتني أشعر بالغباء لما كنت أتحطم باستمرار

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You were learning. And you got better
I know. I want another try soon ❤️
Any time
Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: اليوم أحتاج نوعًا مختلفًا قليلاً من المساعدة

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: LATER THAT EVENING — {{name:lena}} has gone home. You have cleared the table before joining {{name:hailey}} on the sofa.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: في وقت لاحق من تلك الليلة — {{name:lena}} قد ذهبت إلى المنزل. لقد قمت بتجهيز الطاولة قبل أن تنضم إلى {{name:hailey}} على الأريكة.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just come already before I eat everything
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: فقط تعالي قبل أن آكل كل شيء

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A bit later on the couch
What if I need to steal food from your plate?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ماذا لو احتجت لسرقة الطعام من طبقك؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You already stole half of it
The point is you’re being weirdly distant
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: النقطة هي أنك تتصرف بغرابة وبُعد

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m literally right next to you
Because I might fall asleep like this
I even left space for you
Why are you texting me if you’re already in the living room?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: لماذا تتواصل معي إذا كنت بالفعل في غرفة المعيشة؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: تحديث سريع قبل أن أبدأ العمل: يجب أن أخرج في السادسة

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: لقد أعيدت كتابة المقدمة خلال الغداء

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: يبدو الآن أقل كأني أقرأ كتابًا دراسيًا

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We'll try it out when you get here
And I'll finally collect my other bag
By bringing another one?
A bag full of notes. They're different categories
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: حقيبة مليئة بالملاحظات. إنها فئات مختلفة

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. I should have realised
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: بالطبع. كان يجب أن أدرك ذلك

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: لا تقلق. سأغادر مع كلاهما هذه المرة 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll put the old one by the door
Thanks, love. I need to go now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: شكرًا، حبي. يجب أن أذهب الآن

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Want to come straight here?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: هل تريد أن تأتي مباشرة إلى هنا؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: See you tonight ❤️
Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: نعم. سأتوقف لأتناول شيئًا للأكل في الطريق

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll have the table cleared for your notes
My very exclusive rehearsal venue
One seat. Very selective audience
At least the audience already likes me
Very much
Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: جيد. كن مفيدًا بالإضافة إلى كونك عاطفيًا الليلة ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I can manage both

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one leaning on me
If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to do something
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: إذا استمريت في النظر إلي هكذا سأفعل شيئًا

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re really not scared of me huh
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: أنت حقًا لا تخاف مني، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK سجل دليل على أول قبلة بالتراضي بين {{name:hailey}} والـ{{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I don't need HAK to tell me that kiss meant something to me.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: لا أحتاج إلى HAK ليخبرني أن تلك القبلة كانت تعني لي شيئًا.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK سجل دليل على أول قبلة بالتراضي بين {{name:hailey}} والـ{{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK سجل دليل على أول قبلة بالتراضي بين {{name:hailey}} والـ{{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Now you’re stuck with the consequences
You’re not the one who just made the first move
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: أنت لست من قام بالخطوة الأولى

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You pull her back for a longer kiss
HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK أرشفت دليل القبلة الطويلة بالتراضي

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I want to stay in this moment with her, without rushing whatever comes next.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: أريد أن أبقى في هذه اللحظة معها، دون استعجال ما سيأتي بعدها.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK أرشفت دليل القبلة الطويلة بالتراضي

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK أرشفت دليل القبلة الطويلة بالتراضي

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: We’re definitely not going back to normal after this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: نحن بالتأكيد لن نعود إلى الوضع الطبيعي بعد هذا

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: What can i do when you do that face
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: ماذا يمكنني أن أفعل عندما تضع تلك الوجهة

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re still bad at smooth answers
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: لا زلت سيئًا في الردود السلسة

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to bed before I start something we won’t stop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: سأذهب إلى السرير قبل أن أبدأ شيئًا لن نتوقف عنه

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Try not to miss me too much 😌
HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK سجل دليل على استجابة عاطفية مرتفعة أثناء الاتصال القريب

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK سجل دليل على استجابة عاطفية مرتفعة أثناء الاتصال القريب

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK سجل دليل على استجابة عاطفية مرتفعة أثناء الاتصال القريب

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EARLY EVENING — It is half past six. You are at home, waiting to hear from {{name:lena}} after work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: في أول المساء — الساعة السادسة والنصف. أنت في البيت تنتظر رسالة من {{name:lena}} بعد العمل.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Without looking down once 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بدون ما أنظر لتحت مرة وحدة 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's good. Keep the question at the start
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هذا جيد. خلي السؤال في البداية

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already written in very large letters
Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كل شيء مرتب. خلصت دراسة لليوم

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: شكراً على الليلة. الجزء المفيد وجزء الأريكة كمان ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وأنا كمان. خصوصاً الجزء بعد ما سكرت اللابتوب

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هلا عم أستعد للنوم قبل ما أبدأ أراجع كل شيء مرة ثانية

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
Goodnight, love
Goodnight ❤️

{{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} تفتح شرائحها وتبدأ عرضها. تستمع وهي تشرح كيف يمكن للجودة والراحة والخدمة الشخصية أن تشجع العملاء على العودة. في منتصف الطريق، تتوقف وتنظر إلى ملاحظاتها.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
Can I ask something?
Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نعم. هذا هو السبب في وجودك هنا.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: إذا كان هناك مكانان يبيعان نفس الشيء بنفس السعر، ما الذي يجعل شخصًا يختار واحدًا على الآخر؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: التجربة. سواء كان من السهل التسوق هناك، سواء كان الموظفون يساعدونك...

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هذا منطقي. لماذا لا تبدأ تلك الفقرة بالسؤال؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أيوه. أعطني مثال أولاً، ثم اشرح لي.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنا خارج. سأحضر طعامنا، ثم سأأتي مباشرة ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تضيف السؤال إلى ملاحظاتها وتجرب القسم مرة أخرى، مستخدمة مقهيين من الحي كمثال. هذه المرة، تنجح في ذلك دون توقف.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
Was it too simple?
No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لا. فهمت ما تعنيه. ثم أصبح التعريف أكثر وضوحاً.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
Actually?
Don't ruin your good work.
20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد 20 دقيقة — {{name:lena}} أنهت العرض، وتفحص الوقت وتغلق حاسوبها المحمول. تسألها سؤالاً أخيراً عن استنتاجها، فتجيب دون أن تنظر إلى ملاحظاتها.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
How was work?
You looked up more on the second try, too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نظرت لأعلى أكثر في المحاولة الثانية أيضاً.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت تنظر إلي مباشرة في كل مرة فعلت فيها ذلك.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: فعلت. وأحببت أن يكون لدي واحد.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: شكراً لك على أخذ الأمر بجدية.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
After the Rehearsal
You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت تنتظرني لأغلق ذلك الحاسوب، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت ألتزم بالقواعد. لا قبلة حتى تنتهي.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت مشغولة بما يكفي لدرجة أنني لم أملك الوقت للقلق بشأن العرض

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هل يمكنني التوقف عن التظاهر بأنني مجرد شخص في الجمهور الآن؟

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لم تكن بحاجة إلى عرض لتكون لديك سبب للمجيء.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وأردت قضاء المساء معك. لقد نجح الأمر بشكل جميل.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.

25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد 25 دقيقة — بعد تناول الطعام، تنتقل إلى الأريكة. {{name:lena}} تجلس بجانبك، تاركةً مساحة لساقك التي تتعافى. ذراعك تستقر حول كتفيها، وهي تلتفت نحوك لتقبيل آخر.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
The table wasn't that bad.
I couldn't sit like this there.
I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد أحضرت شطائرنا. أراك بعد قليل

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
After the Sandwiches
Your hand is wandering.
You can tell me to stop.
I didn't say stop. Higher.
Hands Where She Put Them
And the other one?
You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: يمكنك أن تأخذ ذلك أيضاً. تحت. لقد قررت بالفعل.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنت تجعل من الصعب جداً الحفاظ على المساء بأدب.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: انتهت العرض. لا أحتاج إلى المجاملات.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See you soon
My turn too.
You don't have to.
I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
Her Hand
Tell me if that's too much.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: قولي لي إذا كان هذا كثيرًا.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It isn't.
On the Sofa
There. That was the point.
You look very pleased with yourself.
I am. You can thank me later
A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد قليل — {{name:lena}} تصل إلى منزلك مع ملاحظاتها وحقيبة من الطعام. تستقبلها بقبلة، وتضع الشطائر في المطبخ وتجلسان معًا على الطاولة.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد 25 دقيقة — بعد التنظيف، تتقرب منك

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
Yes. Are you?
Very.
Then stop moving away to talk.
I was going to ask about your day.
How was university?
Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بخير. رغم أنني قضيت الغداء أعيد كتابة المقدمة بدلاً من تناول الطعام بشكل صحيح.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: مهمة جدًا. شكرًا لمساعدتك في العرض قبل أن أشتت انتباهي.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: حسنًا. أحتاجك أن تتظاهر أنك لست صديقي لمدة عشر دقائق.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد قمت بمعظم العمل قبل أن تأتي هنا.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ساعدتني على قولها بصوت عالٍ. تلك هي الجزء الذي كنت أحتاجه.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد 20 دقيقة — لاحقاً، {{name:lena}} تفحص الوقت وتجمع ملاحظاتها. تضع حاسوبها المحمول، وتأخذ حقيبتين وتنضم إليك عند الباب.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نعم. أتركك بلا أي سبب إداري يدعوك لدعوتي مرة أخرى.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أعتقد أنني سأدبر أمري بدون واحدة.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
{{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} تضع الحقائب للحظة وتعود نحوك. تقبلك وداعًا، ويدها تستند على كتفك بينما يلتف ذراعك حول خصرها.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
Okay. Now I'm really going.
That's a difficult opening request.
Text me when you get home.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أرسل لي رسالة عندما تصل إلى المنزل.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will. Love you.
Love you too.
{{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} تأخذ الحقائب وتغادر. أنت ترتب الطاولة وتستقر لبقية المساء.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
Home ❤️ Both bags made it
Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
No. I checked twice
And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وحاولت ذلك الجزء الصعب مرة أخرى بينما كنت أفرغ الأغراض.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: شخص عادي في الجمهور، إذن. لا يُسمح له بتقبيلني حتى أنتهي.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
He moved it earlier than usual
Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: بس قال إنه يناسب جدوله أفضل
ما حسيت أني أريد أضغط عليه

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly
I made some breakfast for you too
I kept waking up for no reason
Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ثم جلست في السرير أراقب السقف كالأحمق

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: إنها واحدة من تلك الصباحات اللي يفكر فيها الدماغ كثير

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مرحبًا ❤️ هل تحتاجني أن أحضر أي شيء الليلة؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: استيقظت كثيرًا، لكن سأكون بخير بمجرد أن أتحرك

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بشكل جيد، وقد نزلت إلى صندوق البريد وعدت هذا الصباح

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أراهن أنه كان شعورًا جيدًا ألا تضطر لطلب المساعدة من شخص آخر

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان كذلك، حتى لو كان كل ما جمعته هو بريد غير مهم

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جائزة مخيبة للآمال لكل هذا الجهد 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
What's on the menu tonight?
Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: دجاج وأرز، لا شيء يحتاج إلى دليل تعليمات

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
Just yourself, I've got the rest
I got the lemonade you like too
You remembered?
You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت دائمًا تبحث عنها عندما تكون هنا

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
I'm not going to argue with dessert
Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: رائع، قرار واحد اتخذ بدون قتال

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، أنتهي في الخامسة. سأتوقف في الطريق وأتيت مباشرة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
You didn't have to do everything
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لم يكن عليك فعل كل شيء

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة أننا سنفعل هذا الليلة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يجب أن أنتهي من الاستعداد قبل أن أتأخر

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're not ready yet?
Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تقريبًا، لقد كنت واقفة هنا بأذن واحدة بينما أتحدث إليك 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بعد بضع دقائق، قبل أن تغادر...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ها هي، كلا القرطين وكل شيء 😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
Thank you ❤️
It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
Have a good day
You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وأنت أيضًا، ولا تأكل كل الأجزاء الجيدة قبل أن أصل

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No promises about the crispy edges
Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: احتفظ لي ببعض أو سأحتفظ بالحلوى 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, see you tonight
Love you too
I know, I just wanted to help
You can help me eat it
That part I'm very qualified for 😌
Good morning, by the way
Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صباح الخير وسيم ❤️ دخلت مباشرة في وضع التخطيط

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep okay?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هاي 😊 سؤال مهم سريع قبل ما أرجع: تارت التفاح أو شوكولاتة؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you finish then
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأتركك تنتهي إذن

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I leave ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أغادر ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, in the manager's office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قبل الخامسة بقليل، في مكتب المدير...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تم الكشف عن محادثة مكتبية بالقرب من {{name:lena}}

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يفترض أن أتطلع إلى رؤية {{name:lena}} الليلة. بدلًا من ذلك، يعيدني كل تحديث من ذلك المكتب إلى الليلة الماضية.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//نقل مباشر

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: انتهيت؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الأرقام المحدثة في صندوق الوارد الخاص بك، والنسخ الموقعة في هذا المجلد

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Bring them over, I don't bite
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحضرهم، أنا لا أعض

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنني ترك مجلد على المكتب بدون تعليمات

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ها هي. لم تقم بقول كلمة لي طوال اليوم

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about how last night ended
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أفكر في كيفية انتهاء الليلة الماضية

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apple tart
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تارت التفاح

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So have I
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وأنا أيضًا

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ليس بهذه الطريقة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل ستخبرني أنك لم تستمتع بذلك؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's not the problem
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: استمتعت. هذه ليست المشكلة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عدت إلى المنزل وتحدثت معه وكأنه لم يحدث شيء

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كانت قبلة، ليست عرض زواج

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wouldn't see it that way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لن يراها بهذه الطريقة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wasn't there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم يكن هناك

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't make it better
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا لا يجعل الأمر أفضل

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم تكن قلقًا بهذا القدر خارج الحانة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جيد، هذا ما كنت آملة أن تقوله

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I should've been
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان يجب أن أكون

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I kissed you back that even worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وقبلتك مرة أخرى، وهذا أسوأ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ثم توقف عن محاولة إقناع نفسك أنك لم تستمتع بذلك

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لست كذلك. أشعر فقط بالسوء حيال ما فعلته وأنني أخفيه عنه

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: من يهتم بما يفكر فيه؟ قبلتني، وأنت أحببت ذلك. هذا هو المهم

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to hurt him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أريد أن أؤذيه

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لن تؤذي. يمكنك أن تكون معه وتستمتع معي

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know if I can do that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أعرف إذا كنت أستطيع فعل ذلك

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can. You just have to want to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنك. عليك فقط أن تريد ذلك

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come have a drink with me when you're done
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تعال اشرب معي لما تخلص

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was this ever really a choice?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل كانت هذه حقًا خيارًا؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I'm seeing him tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا، أنا رايحة أشوفه الليلة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عشاء؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عشاء وفيلم. قلت له أني راح أكون هناك حوالي الساعة ستة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very domestic
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كتير عائلي

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هي حاجة أنا حابة أعملها، ما تحتاج تخليها تبدو مملة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can see me another night
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ممكن تشوفني ليلة ثانية

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could try not deciding that for me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكن تحاول ما تقرر لي

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you'd have a good time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعرف أنك راح تستمتع

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما بتتعب أبدًا من سماع نفسك، صح؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not when I'm right
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مو لما أكون على حق

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were allowed to agree with me 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان مسموحًا لك أن تتفق معي 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا رايحة الآن

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know where to find me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت عارف وين تلاقيني

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I work here. It would be difficult not to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا أشتغل هنا. بيكون صعب ما أكون موجودة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} تلتقط حقيبتها وتتحرك نحو باب المكتب

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager look at her ass as she leaves
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مديرها ينظر إلى مؤخرتها وهي تغادر

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تم أرشفة الالتقاط البصري

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إنها تغادر، وأخيرًا أطلق الزفير الذي حبسته. حتى الآن، أكره الطريقة التي يراقب بها رحيلها.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leaving on Time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: المغادرة في الوقت المحدد

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At five, outside the office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عند الخامسة، خارج المكتب...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الساعة خمسة، أنا خارجة ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: خلصت كل شيء؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يكفي لليوم، تركت الباقي في مكانه

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: في العمل؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كيف تسير فترة بعد الظهر لديك؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وين ممكن يزعج شخص آخر لمدة ساعة 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: رح أوقف عند التارت، وبعدين أجي

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: خذ وقتك، الأكل لسا مو جاهز

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد توقف سريع عند المخبز...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان عندهم شريحتين متبقيتين. أعتبر هذا تخطيط ممتاز

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت محظوظ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: رجاءً لا تخرب صورة حبيبتي المنظمة جدًا 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: خلي العلبة عمودية، هذا كل اللي أطلبه

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عم تأخذ مقعد أفضل في الباص مني

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تقريبًا أنهيت آخر دفعة من الأوراق

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أشوفك حوالي الساعة ستة ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أشوفك قريب

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما زلت سأغادر في الخامسة، لن أسمح لمجلد أن يسرق مساءنا

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم أبدأ الطهي بعد، لديك وقت

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعرف، أريد فقط أن أخرج في الوقت المحدد مرة واحدة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ماذا تخطط أن تفعل بعد انتهاء الامتحانات؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ما فكرت لحد الآن في هذا

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: بس أول شيء رح يكون النوم لحد ما جسمي يجبرني أستيقظ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: قضيت وقت طويل في التوتر لدرجة أني نسيت كيف يكون وقت الفراغ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: رح تتذكر بسرعة بعد ما ينتهي

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: أنا متحمسة أكون عديمة الفائدة لفترة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: تعال كل قبل ما تبدأ تعطني تلك النظرة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: تعال كل قبل ما تبدأ تعطني تلك النظرة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: نحن جالسين نتعشى مع {{name:evelyn}}. هل ستنضم إلينا؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: أكلت بالفعل مع {{name:lena}}. راحت للبيت الآن، فبجي أقول مرحبا.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
Just wanted to annoy you a little

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هاي ❤️ أنا تحت، وحلواك نجى من الباص

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تعود هاتفها إلى حقيبتها. عندما تسحب البطانية على قدميها، تتجه نحوك بدلاً من الشاشة. "ماذا؟" تسأل. "لا شيء. تعال هنا." تضع رأسها على كتفك وتمسك يدك تحت البطانية. تحتاج إلى دفعة منك قبل أن تلاحظ أن الفيلم قد بدأ بالفعل.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد 80 دقيقة — تقضيان الفيلم معاً، تتجادلان أحياناً حول ما إذا كان الممثل الرئيسي من المفترض أن يكون مضحكاً. عندما تتدحرج التترات، تبقى لبضع دقائق أخرى قبل أن تأخذ أغراضها. عند الباب، تعطيك عناقاً أطول، وتعدك أن ترسل لك رسالة عندما تصل إلى المنزل، ثم تتجه نحو الحافلة.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا في المنزل ❤️ شكرًا لك على الليلة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، حصلت على مقعد وكدت أن أنام قبل محطتي 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: احتفظي به، سأحتاج إلى عذر لأسرق تلك الوسادة مرة أخرى

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
What about you?
I know ❤️
You went quiet a couple of times tonight
Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: آسفة، كان لدي الكثير في ذهني

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا، لم تفعلي أي شيء خاطئ، أنتِ مثالية

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت سعيدة حقًا بوجودي هناك معك

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنا أيضًا، كنت أفتقد أن أكون بجانبك بدلاً من المشاهدة من طرف الشاشة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
That too 😌
Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حالة أقل إثارة للإعجاب، لكن لسا صالحة للأكل

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأحببت فيلمك، حتى لو كنت لا أعتقد أن ذلك الرجل كان من المفترض أن يكون مضحكًا

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
Mostly at you laughing at him
I'll take it
The dinner was really good too ❤️
Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حتى بدون كل دجاجي على طبقك؟

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: احصلي على بعض النوم، كنت تبدين جاهزة للنوم عليّ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كدت أن أنام. كان لطيفًا عدم الاضطرار للذهاب إلى أي مكان لفترة

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
AVAILABLE 😭
I'd like that
Good night handsome, love you ❤️
Love you too, sleep well
I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا بفتح الباب قبل ما تخربها أكثر

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do

Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حوالي الساعة ستة، تفتح الباب. {{name:lena}} تضع حقيبة المعجنات وتلف ذراعيها حولك قبل ما تخلص من قول مرحبا. تقبلك على خدك وتبقى قريبة منك للحظة أخرى، ثم تدخل.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد 20 دقيقة — أثناء العشاء، تصب الليمونادة التي اشتريتها لها. تنظر إلى الزجاجة، ثم إليك. "حتى وضعتها في الثلاجة،" تقول. "كنت أظن أن الليمونادة الدافئة قد تحصل على تقييم سيء." تبتسم، لكنها تصمت للحظة قبل أن تصل عبر الطاولة لتمسك يدك.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تتساهل المحادثة خلال العشاء. تخبرك عن صباحها وتسرق قطعة دجاج من طبقك بينما تجيب. عندما تلاحظ، تصر على أن طبقك كان لديه الحافة المقرمشة التي وعدتها بها. عندما تضع شريحتين من التارت، تضحك على محاولتك لتحديد أيهما أكبر.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد 20 دقيقة — بعد مساعدتك في إزالة الأطباق، تترك حذاءها بجانب الأريكة وتختار الوسادة الجيدة. تخرج الرباط من شعرها بينما تستقر بجانبك. قبل أن يبدأ الفيلم، تميل إلى كتفك وتأخذ صورة لكما. ترسل لك نسخة لتحتفظ بها.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: يجب أن أذهب لشراء بعض كتب المراجعة مع {{name:ethan}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: هذا مجرد رمز للذهاب إلى منزله

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: لا، أنا بحاجة فعلًا إلى الكتب

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: من المضحك أنك تبدأ فقط في العمل الجاد في نهاية السنة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: هذا ما يحدث عندما يكون لديك أستاذ يعرف كيف يحفز 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
{{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:aiden}} لن يرغب حتى في الخروج معك بعد الآن

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: كان يمكنك تحذيري في وقت سابق

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: أنت متألم، وشعرك فوضوي، وتبدو نصف ميت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مرحبًا 😊 استيقظت قبل المنبه والآن الساعة الثالثة والنصف تبدو وكأنها بعيدة عني بأسبوع

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أريدك في الغالب أن تتوقف عن اعتبار مشاعرك أقل أهمية

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحاول

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحب أنك تريدني أن أفعل هذا كوني، وليس كنسخة من نفسي يجب أن أخترعها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
