story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذه هي الفتاة التي أحبها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان ذلك لطيفاً بشكل غير عادل ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الآن نسيت ما كنت أبحث عنه قبل أن تجعلني أبتسم على طاولة المطبخ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: المفاتيح؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، في الواقع

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: انظر إلي، مفيدة وساحرة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: دعنا لا نفسد ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أكون جاهزة لاحقاً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صباح الخير. وتناول الطعام قبل أن تبتلع الاجتماع فترة غداءك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت حقاً تسرق وظيفتي اليوم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يبدو ذلك أفضل بكثير مما صنعته

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنك محاولة وضع شيء على الطبق بدلاً من الأكل فوق الحوض

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لم تكوني هنا. لا يمكنك إثبات أي شيء

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أعرفك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عندي اجتماع المجموعة هذا الصباح، ثم سأعود إلى المنزل وأغير ملابسي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ما زلت ترتدين الفستان من البارحة؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم. أرفض أن أبدأ ذلك القرار مرة أخرى

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لكن أريد أن أسألك شيئًا قبل أن أذهب

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ما هو؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنك العودة للنوم. سأوقظك في يونيو

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عن اليوم. عن الحدود، أعتقد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تحدثنا عن ما تريد معرفته بعد ذلك، لكن ليس تمامًا عن هذا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عندما قلنا قهوة، هل قصدنا القهوة فقط ولا شيء آخر؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا. اخترنا مكانًا لتلتقي فيه، وليس قاعدة عن أين يجب أن تتوقف فترة بعد الظهر

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لذا إذا سارت الأمور بشكل جيد وأردت البقاء لفترة أطول، هل لا يجب أن أعود إلى المنزل لمجرد أن هذا هو كل ما ذكرناه؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بالطبع لا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أريدك أن تفعلي ما تشعرين برغبة في فعله، وليس أن تتابعي ما إذا كان على قائمة صنعناها هذا الصباح

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وماذا لو أردت أن أقبله؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: إذن قبليه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تقولين ذلك بسهولة كبيرة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مفيد جدًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لأنني أعني ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وماذا لو أردت أن أذهب أبعد من ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لن أضع حدًا لك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا حدود مني. أريدك أن تقرري ما تريدين، وليس ما تظنين أنني أريدك أن تفعليه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حقًا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حقًا. ليس عليك أن تسألني عن الإذن في كل خطوة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا أعرف كيف سأشعر بعد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ليس عليك أن تعرف بالفعل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ربما تشرب قهوة واحدة وتغادر. ربما تريد أن تقضي بقية بعد الظهر معًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا أريدك أن تمنع نفسك فقط لتناسب خطة، أو تدفع نفسك لجعل القصة أكثر إثارة من أجلي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت بخير الليلة الماضية. الآن أتحقق من الوقت بينما يغلي الماء

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كانت تلك النقطة التي كنت قلقة بشأنها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: العودة إلى المنزل والشعور بأنني إما فعلت الكثير أو خيبت ظنك بعدم القيام بما يكفي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا يوجد مقدار يجب عليك القيام به لجعل اليوم ناجحًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لذا أقرر ما أريده حقًا، وأرى ما يريده أيضًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بالضبط

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ويمكنني أن أغير رأيي في منتصفه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بالطبع. هذا ليس وعدًا منك لأي منا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حسناً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذه إجابة أكبر بكثير مما كنت أتوقع

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد تناولت الإفطار بالفعل، قبل أن تسأل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الليلة الماضية قلت إنه فجأة أصبح أكثر واقعية. هل تغير ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ليس تمامًا. لا زلت ألاحظ ذلك عندما أفكر في أنك هناك بالفعل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لكن الشعور بالتوتر لا يعني أنني أريد أن أتخذ قراراتك بدلاً منك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا تحول الاسترخاء إلى شيء آخر يجب عليك القيام به من أجلي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لن أفعل. سأخبرك إذا شعرت أن شيئًا ما مختلف

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جيد. أريد الإجابة الحقيقية منك، حتى لو استغرق الأمر دقيقة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تذكرت ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل لا تزال مبتسمًا كما كنت الليلة الماضية؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم. مشغول قليلاً أيضًا، لكنني متحمسة لسماع كيف تشعر

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بس لا تقرر كيف ستسير فترة بعد الظهر الخاصة بي قبل أن أغادر المنزل حتى

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحاول التركيز على البنت اللي تكتب لي بدلاً من ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تبدو رائعة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هي ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت أستطيع سماع محاضرة الغد تقريبًا قبل أن أذهب إلى السرير

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حتى مع {{name:aiden}}؟ عارفين إننا لسه هنشوفه بعدين؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أيوة. ما نسيتش عن مين بنتكلم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنا أثق فيك. مش بطلب منك تقضي كل الموعد تحميني من إن ده يكون غريب

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ممكن هو اللي يحتاج دقيقة النهاردة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لسه بتحاول تفهم اللي حصل امبارح؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكن. مش متأكدة إن الكلمات "صديقي يعرف" استقرت تماماً لسه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: خليه يطلب حاجة قبل ما تفاجئيه تاني

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مش هقدم عرض تاني. هو يقدر يتعامل 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا ما يسمى أن تكون تأثيرًا جيدًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ولسه هقابل حد مش عارفة عنه حاجة لسه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بالضبط. كونك حرة في الاختيار مش معناه إنك لازم تثقي فيه بكل حاجة فجأة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لسه عايزة أشوف هو شكله إيه على فنجان قهوة الأول. ده ما تغيرش

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يبقى هنا تبدأ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: عجبتني رسائله. مش عايزة أقضي الموعد وأنا بتساءل إذا كنت مطابقة النسخة اللي تخيلتها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ممكن تلاقي الشخص الحقيقي أكثر إثارة للاهتمام

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: طالما هو سيترك الطبخ للمقهى، عندنا فرصة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل تناولت الطعام، أم أنك فقط تشرف على الآخرين؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ولما قلت إنني أستطيع الاحتفاظ ببعض الأشياء لنفسي، كنا نتحدث فقط عن موعد أول

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت عايزة أقول الجزء ده بصوت عالي قبل ما أتعامل مع الإجابة دي وكأنها تعني أي حاجة أكثر

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة لأنك فعلت. الآن تعرف أنني أريدك أن تختار لنفسك، بدلاً من أن تتوقف عند القهوة بسببي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حسناً. بعض الأشياء يمكن أن تبقى لي دون أن نفهم بعضنا بشكل خاطئ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم. وأي شيء يزعج أي منا هو شيء نتحدث عنه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ظننت أنك ستعطيني إجابة دقيقة جداً حول ما هو مسموح

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لدي طعام هنا، شكرًا لك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: استغرق شراء الكتب وقتاً أطول مما توقعت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
{{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek
That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ذلك الترحيب يبدو أقل عفوية كل مرة، وقد بدأت ألاحظ رد فعلي.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK أرشفت دليل {{name:hailey}} على بدء قبلة الخد عند وصول {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?
He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: يستحق مكافأة صغيرة لأنه يهتم بي كثيراً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: الموضوع مشى عمداً أمام كلا الذكرين وهو يرتدي ملابس مكشوفة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أرى التقارب يزداد، لكنني ما زلت أحتاج إلى فهم مدى ارتياحي إليه.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK سجلت {{name:hailey}} جالسة على حجر {{name:aiden}} تحت ذريعة تعلم كيفية اللعب

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لا تجرؤي على النزول مرتدية هكذا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
I have a training session later
It was fun hanging out with you guys
Can you two do that in private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: هل يمكنكما فعل ذلك في الخصوصية؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: إذا كان تحديًا، فسأفعلها بشكل أقوى 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لقد حذرتك أنك ستدفع ثمن هذا الصباح

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مرحباً 😊 أنا في المنزل وأستعد، والفستان قد نجا من إعادة النظر فيه ثلاث مرات

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يبدو ذلك. أشعر أنني فاتني فصل كامل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: استغرق الأمر مني بعض الوقت أيضًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you talk again before coming here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل تحدثتما مرة أخرى قبل أن تأتي إلى هنا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning, yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا الصباح، نعم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وماذا؟ هل يُسمح لي أن أسأل كيف كانت الأمور، أم أن ذلك خاص؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعضه خاص. لكنني سألت عما إذا كان من المفترض أن يكون القهوة هي الحد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل سألتَه ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What did he say?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ماذا قال؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنه لا يريد أن يحدد لي حدًا. يريدني أن أقرر ما أشعر به حقًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تبدين جميلة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously? Just like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جدياً؟ بهذه السهولة؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تحدثنا لفترة أطول من ذلك. سأعطيك الجزء المفيد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحاول تخيل إجراء تلك المحادثة والحفاظ على وجه جاد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم تتمكن حتى من قول الجملة الأولى البارحة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نقطة عادلة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا يزال الأمر غريباً بالنسبة لي. ليس سيئاً، لكن غريب

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكن أن يكون غريباً دون أن نقضي موعدنا بالكامل في شرحه مرة أخرى

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت محق

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وهذا لا يعني أنني جئت مع وعد حول كيفية انتهاء اليوم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعلم. يعني أنه يجب أن أسألك، لا أن أحاول تخمين ما وافق عليه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أشعر أنني جيدة في هذا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالضبط

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. First question for you, then
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسناً. السؤال الأول لك، إذن

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تابع

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل تريد فعلاً مقعد النافذة، أم أنك أخذت المقعد الآخر لأنني كنت جالساً هنا بالفعل؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أريد مقعد النافذة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then swap with me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذن، تبادل معي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حقًا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. يُسمح لك باختيار الكرسي أيضاً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ستكون مزعجاً جداً بشأن هذا الآن، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: فقط حتى تتوقف عن التظاهر بأن ليس لديك تفضيلات

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت على وشك أن أسألك إذا كنت تعتقد أنه مبالغ فيه، ثم أدركت أنني في الواقع أحببته

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تبديل المقاعد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: النظرة الملاحظة تبقى أقل مما هو مقصود

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت أعرف أن الفضول موجود، لكن ملاحظة اهتمامهما ما زالت تفاجئني.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Caught Looking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تم القبض على النظرة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد وصول قهوتهم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it good?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل هو جيد؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جداً. يمكنك الاستمتاع بما لديك حتى لو كان صغيراً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إنه جيد. جيد بشكل مزعج

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's why you keep coming back
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لهذا السبب تستمر في العودة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وهذا لأنه هادئ إذا فاتك وقت الغداء

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أعتقد أنني كنت هنا من قبل دون أن أراقب الوقت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عادةً ما يكون لديك مكان آخر تذهب إليه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then keep that answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذًا احتفظ بتلك الإجابة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: دروس، عمل، شيء نسيت أن أنهيه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: اليوم كدت أحضر ملاحظاتي في حقيبتي من باب العادة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنك تركها هناك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: فعلت. هذا ما أحاول إخبارك به

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: آسف. أستمتع بحقيقة أنك اخترت أن تكون هنا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذه إجابة لطيفة بشكل مزعج جداً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لدي تلك أحياناً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعرف. فقط لا أسمعها دائماً دون ثلاث نكات بعدها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحاول ألا أختبئ وراء تلك كثيراً اليوم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to stop being funny
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا تحتاج إلى التوقف عن كونك مضحكاً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأفعل ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: جيد، لأن أن تكون وسيمًا وصامتًا يبدو مرهقًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ها هو

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ماذا ستفعل بعد ظهر كامل خالٍ؟ ليس ما يجب عليك فعله. بل ما ستفعله فعلاً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت سأخرج في نزهة من غير ما أحسب كم أخذت من الوقت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكن نلاقي مكان نجلس فيه، نسمع حاجة، وما نرد على مجموعة الفصل لفترة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: في حديقة على بعد شوارع قليلة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعرفها. دائمًا أعدي من عند المدخل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ممكن ندخل هالمرة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. أحب ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لاحقًا، خارج المقهى

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling otherwise?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كيف تشعر بخلاف ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Left here, isn't it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: على اليسار هنا، صح؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. إلا إذا كنت تخطط لتدور حول نفس الشارع

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ممكن أتصرف كأني أعطيك جولة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: عن المكان اللي أروح له الجامعة؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It needs work
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يحتاج شغل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قليلًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت هادئ بشكل مريب

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were worried I'd make a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت قلقًا إني أقول نكتة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ما طلبت منك توقف عن الكلام تمامًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا أستمتع. ما أريد أفسد كل لحظة هادئة بالكلام

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: متوترة، لكن لا أتمنى لو كنت قد ألغيت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا جديد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قليلاً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحب ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد قليل، في الحديقة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is nicer than the path outside
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا أجمل من الطريق الخارجي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can hear yourself think in here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنك سماع أفكارك هنا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت آمل أن أفعل أقل من ذلك اليوم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كيف تسير الأمور؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better once we left the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان أفضل بعد مغادرتنا المقهى

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل كنت سيئًا جدًا أثناء تناول القهوة؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أكثر مثل العشر دقائق قبل أن تضطر لفعل شيء ما وعقلك ينفد من الأشياء المفيدة لتقولها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا. توقفت عن تخيل ما كان يجب أن أفعله بعد ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وماذا الآن؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'd like you to stop for a second
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: الآن أود منك أن تتوقف لحظة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هنا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: حسنًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تبدو وكأنك على وشك قول شيء خطير

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كنت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ربما كنت غير صبور

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss

I’m done living only for revisions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: لقد انتهيت من العيش فقط من أجل المراجعات

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to enjoy my life a little
And I’ve always had a crush on him
It seems like it’s mutual… so I’m taking advantage 😇
Aren’t you ashamed to do all that in front of me?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: أليس من العيب أن تفعل كل ذلك أمامي؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not bothered by it at all
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: أنت غير منزعج من ذلك على الإطلاق

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've had a shower and eaten something. Are you free for a proper conversation?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحبًا ❤️ لقد استحممت وتناولت شيئًا. هل أنت متفرغ للدردشة بشكل صحيح؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That is exactly how you choose films
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه هي بالضبط الطريقة التي تختار بها الأفلام

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He said something very similar
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قال شيئًا مشابهًا جدًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having the conversation wander off like that. I stopped thinking about it being a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان جميلًا أن تتجول المحادثة هكذا. توقفت عن التفكير في أنها موعد أول

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل كان هناك أي شيء مختلف عن كيف تخيلته؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: استمع لفترة أطول قبل أن يجيب مما توقعت من الرسائل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في البداية ظننت أنني قلت شيئًا محرجًا. ثم أدركت أنه كان يفكر حقًا فيما سألته

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not always the worst thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس دائمًا أسوأ شيء

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا. أعجبني الأمر بمجرد أن توقفت عن محاولة ملء كل فراغ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تأكد أنه كنت تعرف عن لقائنا، لكنه لم يستمر في ذكر اسمك كما لو كنت بحاجة للدفاع عن وجودي هناك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وإذا لم يكن متأكدًا من شيء، سألني

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've finally sat down properly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أخيرًا جلست بشكل صحيح

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like a good way to get to know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أن هذه طريقة جيدة للتعرف عليك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It felt that way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان الأمر كذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We held hands for part of the walk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أمسكنا بأيدينا خلال جزء من المشي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وخارج المكتبة سألت إذا كان بإمكاني تقبيله

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت تريد ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنا نستعد لتوديع بعضنا، وأدركت أنني كنت أحاول التفكير في سبب آخر للبقاء

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I said what I actually wanted instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لذا قلت ما كنت أريده فعلاً بدلاً من ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he wanted that too?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وكان هو يريد ذلك أيضًا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He did
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان من المحرج قليلاً العثور على الكلمات. لكن القبلة لم تكن كذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد ذلك، كنت سعيدة بشكل عام لأنني سألت بدلاً من قضاء الرحلة بأكملها في التساؤل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة لأنك شعرت بالراحة في فعل ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنا كذلك. لم أكن أعلم هذا الصباح إذا كنت سأرغب في البقاء لتناول مشروب ثانٍ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أPretend أنني أعرفه جيدًا بعد ظهر واحد، لكنني استمتعت بالظهيرة التي قضيناها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تحتاج إلى اتخاذ أي قرارات أكبر الليلة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. أخبرته أنني استمتعت بلقائه، وسنتحدث مرة أخرى

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أصف كل لحظة، كما قلنا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تبدو مرتاحًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تحتاج إلى ذلك. قولي لي كيف حالك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سعيدة. أفكر قليلاً، لكنني لست حزينة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بقيت لأنني أردت أن أكون هناك، وغادرت عندما شعرت أنني أريد العودة إلى المنزل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أكن أحاول جعل الظهيرة تستمر لفترة معينة أو تحويلها إلى شيء أكبر

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل شعرت بالراحة في قول ما تريد؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. شعرت براحة أكبر عندما توقفت عن تكرار كل شيء في رأسي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعض الأشياء أفضل أن أحتفظ بها لنفسي الآن، لكن لا يوجد شيء يزعجني وأتجنب إخبارك به

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا ما يهمني

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب أن أستطيع إخبارك أنني استمتعت بذلك دون الحاجة لشرح كل سبب صغير

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنني أن أكون سعيدة من أجلك دون معرفة كل التفاصيل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بشدة. كانت تلك الأحذية قرارًا جيدًا، لكنني ما زلت أريد خلعها عندما دخلت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. لأنني سعيدة ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت؟ كيف كانت اليوم من جانبك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أتحقق من الوقت أكثر من المعتاد عندما علمت أنك ستلتقي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم وضعت الهاتف جانبًا وواصلت ظهري

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل كنت قلقًا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة لأنك لم تختار تلك التي يمكنك المشي فيها خمس خطوات فقط

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت ألاحظ أنه كان حقيقيًا، مثلما تحدثنا الليلة الماضية.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكنني لم أكن هنا أتمنى لو كنت قد طلبت منك الإلغاء.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة لأنك تقول ذلك بدلاً من التظاهر أنك لم تشعر بشيء.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وسماع أنك قضيت وقتًا ممتعًا يساعد. أحب أنك تبدو كأنك نفسك.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما زلت أنا.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعلم. أتطلع لرؤيتك غدًا.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت؟ هل كان اليوم كما توقعت؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أكن أعرف بالضبط ماذا أتوقع.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أتعلم أحيانًا من أخطائي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت سعيدة لأنك ذهبت، ثم وجدت نفسي أتطلع لرسالتك أكثر من اللعبة التي كنت ألعبها.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا إنجاز كبير.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إنجاز ضخم.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحببت بشكل خاص كيف كنت تتحدث عندما عدت. لم تكن تخبرني فقط بما كنت تعتقد أنني أريد سماعه.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا. أردت التحدث إليك لأنني قضيت بعد ظهر جيد.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا ما جعلني سعيدة.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تجعلني أرغب في المجيء إليك واحتضانك مرة أخرى ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قبل أن أخبرك بأي شيء آخر، ما قلته هذا الصباح ساعدني حقًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل أعجبتك الصورة التي التقطناها معًا من المقهى؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. كان لطيفًا أنك أردت أن تشاركني تلك اللحظة.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سألت عنه أولاً، بالمناسبة. حول التقاطها وإرسالها إليك.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعلم، لقد أخبرتني.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم وضعت الهاتف بعيدًا. لم أكن أريد أن أقضي كل الموعد أحاول إرسال الشيء التالي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم يكن عليك ذلك. أحببت أنني حصلت على شيء كنت تريد حقًا مشاركته

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: عن اختيار ما يناسبك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة لأنني استطعت أن أخبرك عنه بكلماتي الخاصة بعد ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا ما أردته. لم يكن عليك أن تقضي الموعد تجمع أشياء لي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وما زلت حصلت على صورة لصديقتك في طريقها إلى المنزل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحببت تلك الجزئية بشكل خاص

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: امتيازاتك العادية لا تزال سليمة 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ترك هاتفي وحده حتى قلنا وداعًا كان مفيدًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس لأنني لم أكن أريد التحدث إليك. كنت فقط لا أريد أن أكون في محادثتين في نفس الوقت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل أن نتحدث بشكل صحيح الآن

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنا أيضًا. أردت انتباهك عندما كان لدي الوقت للاستمتاع به

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب أن الاحتفاظ ببعض اللحظات لنفسي لا يعني أنه يجب أن أكون بعيدة عنك الليلة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أكن أريد المسافة. أردت أن يكون لديك مساحة لتكون نفسك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو الأمر مختلفًا الآن بعد أن حصلت على ذلك بالفعل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في البداية، كنت لا أزال أتساءل عما ستفكر فيه بشأن ما سأفعله بعد ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. هل وصلت إلى المنزل بخير؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل أنت متفرغ بعد الغداء غدًا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: من أجل امرأة مع فيلم وكمية غير معقولة من المعكرونة؟ نعم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. أريد أن أراك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأحضر الحاوية، ولا يُسمح لك بالتظاهر أنك لا تتذكر أنك وافقت على اختياري للفيلم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أتذكر. حتى أنني أعددت مكانًا على الأريكة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: من أجلي أم من أجل المعكرونة؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكننا مناقشة الأولويات عندما تصل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إجابة خاطئة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لك. المعكرونة يمكن أن يكون لها كرسي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل بكثير

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم تذكرت أنك لم تكن جالسًا في المنزل تنتظر مني اتباع التعليمات

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: افتقدت الجلوس بجانبك اليوم

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك تناول ما تريد منه غدًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنوي ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل أنت متعبة الآن؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قليلاً. ليس النوع البائس، فقط مستعدة للتوقف عن النظر إلى الشاشة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دعيني أذهب إلى السرير قبل أن أنام هنا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد 7 دقائق

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وصلت. حتى تذكرت أن أشبك الهاتف

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: امرأة منظمة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: باختصار

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أكن كذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه لك فقط قبل أن أضعها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أتمنى لو كنت هناك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: غدًا. ثم يمكنك سماع تعليقي الرائع على الفيلم شخصيًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل هذا مشمول في الزيارة؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا يمكنك إيقافه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أكن أنوي ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبح على خير، وسيم ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبحين على خير، يا جميلة. أنا سعيد لأن يومك كان جيدًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا أيضاً. متحمسة لرؤيتك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحببت أن أتمكن من الرغبة في شيء دون أن أحوله على الفور إلى سؤال لك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا ما أردت لك أن تملكه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ولم أكن أحاول الذهاب أبعد فقط لأنك قلت إنني أستطيع

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا أحدث فرقًا أيضًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. عدم وجود حدود مني لم يكن من المفترض أن يصبح هدفًا يجب عليك الوصول إليه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم يحدث. لم أكن أحاول الحصول على الإجابة الصحيحة هذه المرة 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. وضعت كل شيء وقضيت خمس دقائق أبحث عن الهاتف الذي وضعته للتو في جيبي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد المقهى، ذهبنا إلى الحديقة الصغيرة على بعد بضعة شوارع

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف كان عندما كنتما فعلاً في الموعد؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان كما هو. اشتكى من الأكواب قبل أن نطلب حتى

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكنه كان أكثر صدقًا من المعتاد عندما لم يكن متأكدًا مما يجب أن يقوله

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اعترف أنه قضى وقتًا طويلًا يتوقع أن تكون غاضبًا منه لدرجة أنه لا يزال يحاول التكيف مع هذا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أستطيع أن أتخيل

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أخبره بكل محادثتنا. فقط قلت له أنني لم أكن أتبع قائمة بالأشياء التي سمحت بها

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مشتت الذهن؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف أخذ ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تفاجأ مرة أخرى. ثم فهم أنه يجب أن يسألني عما أريده

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: توقفنا عن الحديث عن الوضع بعد ذلك وفعلاً كان لدينا موعد

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة لأنك تجاوزت شرح ذلك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنا أيضًا. تذكر الكثير من الأشياء الصغيرة عني

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وتمكنت من سماعه يقول شيئًا لطيفًا دون أن يحولها على الفور إلى مزحة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا يستحق فنجان قهوة ثاني بمفرده

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تخبريه بذلك. سيبدأ في إعلان كل مجاملة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم توقفنا في الحديقة، و{{name:aiden}} قبلني

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قبلتك أولاً؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قليلًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. قبل أن أنتهي حتى من تحديد ما كنت سأقوله

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دفعت به قليلاً

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل كنت بخير؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، لقد فاجأني فقط

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أريد ثانية. توقف، ثم بدأ يبدو سعيدًا جدًا بنفسه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أنه هو

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أنه قرر أنني سأقبله على أي حال، لذا كان يتقدم عليّ فقط

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالطبع وجد طريقة ليكون على حق

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالضبط 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان يمازحني بشأن ذلك باستمرار

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل ظهرت الجورب المفقود أخيرًا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لذا قبلته بنفسي لأخرسه

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأيضًا لأنك كنت تريد ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. بشكل مزعج، حدث الأمران في نفس الوقت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل نجح جزء إسكاتهم؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: طوال مدة القبلة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم سأل من يقبل أفضل، هو أم أنت

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل سألَك ذلك حقًا؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. يبدو أنها كانت سؤالًا مهمًا جدًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قلت له إنه يحول كل شيء إلى منافسة. الألعاب، الدروس، ويبدو أن هذا أيضًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وهل أوقفه ذلك؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: داخل كم. لا أحد يفهم كيف وصل هناك

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالطبع لا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لذا أخبرته أنه لا يزال بعيدًا جدًا عني في الوقت الحالي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في الوقت الحالي؟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أوه، لا تبدأ أنت أيضًا

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد قضيت فترة بعد الظهر مع أحمق تنافسي. لا أحتاج آخر الليلة

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا فقط أستمتع بتقدمي

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأثبت وجهة نظري 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?

You should have. I would've been tempted
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كان يجب عليك ذلك. كنت سأكون مغرمة

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لكن الغد أفضل. يمكنني إحضار ما أحتاجه بدلاً من الارتجال

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: When can you come?
My afternoon is free after university
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعد الظهر لدي وقت فراغ بعد الجامعة

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
I can go home, get my things and come over around five
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ممكن أروح البيت، آخذ أغراضي وأجي حوالي الخامسة

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Five sounds good
And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وهذه المرة، سأبقى عندما تطلب مني الاقتراب 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I'm looking forward to
Me too
Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: انتظر. سأحضر حقيبتي الآن، قبل أن أنسى شيئًا

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: فرشاة أسنان، ملابس نظيفة ليوم الخميس، شاحن

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very organised
I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أحاول. هل يمكنني استعارة تي شيرت للنوم؟

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بخير. أصبح الأمر أسهل بكثير عندما لم أعد أفكر في العرض

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. You've looked good in mine before
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بالطبع. لقد بدوت جيدًا في تي شيرتي من قبل

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll let you choose one for me
Consider it ready
I hope you know I might get attached to it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: آمل أن تعرف أنني قد أعتاد عليه

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll take the risk
There. Almost packed
You look very pleased about that
I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: نعم. هذه الحقيبة من المفترض أن تبقى في منزلك غدًا

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Along with its owner
What did you do?
Especially its owner ❤️
Actually, before I finish packing...
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: في الواقع، قبل أن أنتهي من التعبئة...

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What are you up to?
Giving you a little preview 🤍
A FEW MINUTES LATER
What do you think?
You look gorgeous
And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: وتلك الابتسامة تخبرني أنك كنت تعرف بالضبط ماذا تفعل

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to distract you a little 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت أريد أن أشتت انتباهك قليلاً 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بعض المهام، نزهة قصيرة، ثم بعض الأشياء حول المنزل

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. Now I wish you were here
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لقد نجح الأمر. الآن أود لو كنت هنا

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What would you do if I was?
Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: سأقربك إلي وأقبلك قبل حتى ما تفتح تلك الحقيبة

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ثم سأترك فتح الحقيبة لوقت لاحق ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. One more before I change
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: انتظر. واحدة أخرى قبل ما أغير

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A MINUTE LATER
There. Your last preview for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ها هي. آخر لمحة لك الليلة

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أنت تجعل الغد يبدو خطيرًا جدًا

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أتطلع لرؤية وجهك عندما أكون واقفة أمامك فعلاً

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was the walk?
Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: اقترب بما فيه الكفاية ولن تحتاج لتخمين كم أحب ذلك

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I intend to 🤍
Keep those pictures just for yourself
Of course. They're staying between us
Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: جيد. غدًا يمكنك وضع هاتفك والتركيز علي شخصيًا

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هل يجب أن أقلق من أنك ستسرق كل اللحاف؟

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: فقط إذا كنت تخطط للنوم بعيدًا جدًا عني

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: بخير. لا زلت أتحرك ببطء، لكن كان شعورًا جيدًا أن أخرج

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: لكن لا أستطيع أن أعدك أنني لن أضع قدمي الباردة عليك

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هذا يأتي مع صديقة. كان يجب أن تقرأ التفاصيل

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: جيد. أريدك هناك عندما أستيقظ أيضًا

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: هذه هي النقطة التي أفكر فيها دائمًا

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أن أكون مرتاحة معك دون الحاجة للتحقق متى يجب أن أعود إلى المنزل
