story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
I'm glad ❤️
Tomorrow we can stay like that
You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
Only until tomorrow afternoon
I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: سأنتهي من التعبئة وسأحاول التوقف عن النظر إلى الوقت

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: أخبرني إذا كنت تريدني أن أحضر أي شيء للعشاء

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: فقط أنت وحقيبتك. أنا سأتولى الطعام

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: تصبح على خير، حبي. أتطلع إلى الغد

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: كنت أريد أن أسألك عن شيء بخصوص الغد

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صباح الخير ❤️ هل رباط شعري لا يزال آمنًا، أم أن أريكتك قد استولت عليه؟

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جيد، ليس لدي وقت لشرح آخر 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الدرس أولاً، ثم العمل. أنا فقط أستعد

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: إلا إذا كان حارسِك أيضاً يوصل رباط الشعر

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: غسيل، ثم أريد إنهاء تلك اللعبة التي بدأتُها

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: علق الغسيل قبل أن تبدأ اللعب

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أفضل أن أسمع عن لعبتك بدلاً من آلة مليئة بالملابس الرطبة 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يجب أن أنتهي في الخامسة مرة أخرى، ثم إلى المنزل مباشرة

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وأنت أيضاً. أفضل أن أكون على أريكتك، لكن الحافلة لن تنتظرني

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
I'll put a guard on it
Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: شكرًا لك، إنه يستحق معاملة مناسبة

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, better than the night before
I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان بإمكاني البقاء تحت تلك البطانية ساعة أخرى

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or are you afraid of me?
You're going to be punished for that.
Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: رؤية الأمر وقد صار شخصيًا إلى هذا الحد تجعل قلبي ينقبض.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded the subject initiating digital penetration during the private session after questioning the need for continued revision.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK سجلت الموضوع وهو يقوم باختراق رقمي خلال الجلسة الخاصة بعد التساؤل عن الحاجة للاستمرار في المراجعة.
تم الكشف عن اتصال جسدي ثانوي
رد فعل الموضوع يشير إلى القبول

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to know how she actually feels, because HAK's interpretation isn't enough.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أحتاج أن أعرف ما تشعر به فعلًا، لأن تفسير HAK لا يكفي.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the stimulation, the professor delivered a firm slap to the subject’s backside. Subject did not pull away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: بعد التحفيز، قام الأستاذ بصفعة قوية على مؤخرة الموضوع. الموضوع لم يبتعد.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just making sure you’re still paying attention.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أريد فقط التأكد أنك لا تزال منتبه.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: أنت تستمتع بهذا أكثر من اللازم.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: بدأت فعلاً أحب هذه الدروس الخاصة.
احترس. هذا كاد أن يبدو صادقاً.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لماذا لا يزال يتعين عليّ المراجعة إذا كان لدينا بالفعل... ترتيب؟

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Was in the middle of something

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: استغرق الأمر وقتاً أطول مما توقعت

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لأنني لا زلت بحاجة لإثبات أنك تعمل معي.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: إذن هو فقط من أجل الأوراق؟

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مرحباً 😊 لقد وجدت مقعداً للغداء بدلاً من الأكل بجانب الطابعة اليوم

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is, before you ask for proof
Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
I need to go back. I'll text you when I'm out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يجب أن أعود. سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أخرج

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk later
Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: في وقت لاحق من ذلك بعد الظهر، بينما يتحققون من جدول اليوم التالي في مكتب المدير...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: تم الكشف عن محادثة مكتبية بالقرب من {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالأمس كان كل شيء سهلًا ونحن معًا. والآن أراقب هذا المكتب مجددًا، خائفًا من أن أمسية جميلة واحدة لم تغير شيئًا.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
You look good with your hair down
Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل هذه مساهمتك في عمل بعد الظهر؟

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can admire you and read a schedule
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يمكنني أن أعجب بك وأقرأ الجدول

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
A big improvement
Much less interesting
It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سيستغرق الأمر وقتًا أطول إذا استمريت في النظر إلي بدلاً من ذلك

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لم أكن أحاول أن أكون كذلك

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
To your place?
That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا هو المكان الذي توجد فيه مطبخي

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وأنت تعرف أنني لا أدعوك لمناقشة عملك

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
We talked about this yesterday
You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان لديك خطط بالأمس. أسأل عن الغد

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
I had a really good evening with him
I'm sure you did
Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ثم توقف عن التصرف وكأن هناك شيئًا مفقودًا ستقوم بإصلاحه

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا أعرض إصلاح أي شيء. أريد أمسية أخرى معك

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت تجعل كل شيء يبدو بسيطًا جدًا

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: العشاء بسيط. أنت تفكر في كل شيء بعده

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أفكر فيما إذا كان يجب أن أكون هناك على الإطلاق

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
You enjoyed the other night
And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: وشعرت بشع بعد ذلك. أنت تستمر في تجاهل تلك الجزئية

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحببت أن أكون معك بمفردي لمساء. أود أن أفعل ذلك مرة أخرى

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ثم فكر في الأمر. الساعة السابعة، إذا قررت أنك قادم

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me finish this first
{{name:lena}} turns back to the open schedule on the desk
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} تعود إلى الجدول المفتوح على المكتب

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: مديرها يراقبها من الجانب الآخر، مستندًا إلى كرسيه

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يراقبها بدلًا من العمل أمامه. أكره الشعور بأنني الوحيد الذي يحتاج إلى توقف هذا.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
An Invitation
Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قبل الخامسة بقليل، مع التحقق من الجدول وتوقيع الصفحة الأخيرة...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's everything. I'll put these with the others
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: هذا كل شيء. سأضع هذه مع الآخرين

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
Leave them there, I'll take them out
You could have said that before I sorted them
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: كان يمكنك أن تقول ذلك قبل أن أرتبهم

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're sorted now
You really do enjoy being in charge
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت حقًا تستمتع بأن تكون المسؤول

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at me a second
What?
I want another kiss
You know why I'm hesitating
I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أعرف. أسأل إذا كنت تريد واحدة أيضًا

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay... just a kiss
After her answer, the manager gets up and steps closer to {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد إجاباتها، ينهض المدير ويقترب من {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He leans in to kiss her and draws her a little closer by the waist; she returns the kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: يميل ليقبلها ويجذبها قليلاً نحو خصره؛ هي تعيد القبلة

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قبلة أخرى، وهي تبادله إياها. أمسيتنا معًا ما زالت تعني لي الكثير، لكنها تبدو الآن بعيدة على نحو مؤلم.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
Another Kiss
Okay, that's enough
I liked that better than the paperwork
I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: قضيت البارحة أخبر نفسي أن ذلك لن يحدث مرة أخرى

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I preferred today's decision
Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بالطبع فعلت. أنت لست من سيعود للمنزل يشعر بالذنب

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أحببت تقبيلك. لن أ pretend أنني لم أفعل

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
I'll text you about dinner later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأرسل لك رسالة عن العشاء لاحقاً

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks peaceful
I still haven't agreed
I heard you. Think about it
After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد مغادرة العمل، في الطريق إلى محطة الحافلات...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنا خارجة ❤️ في طريق العودة للمنزل الآن

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: شيء لن تضطر للقلق بشأنه الليلة إذن

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أكون داخل

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم. أستمتع بعدم سؤالي عن مكان شيء ما لمدة عشر دقائق

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
Only if it's actually hanging up

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: تبدو سعيداً جداً بشأن هذه الدروس الخاصة مؤخراً

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: كنت تشتكين من كل جلسة إضافية

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: أو ربما فقط وجدت طريقة أفضل للدراسة

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: الآن توقفي عن استجوابي واذهبي للنوم

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: أنت في مزاج جيد وتبتسم عندما تعود إلى المنزل

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: يبدو أن أحدهم يشعر بالغيرة من أستاذي

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: هو فقط جيد جدًا في ما يفعله

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحباً ❤️ أنا في المنزل. هل تمكنت من إنهاء لعبتك؟

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
You look comfortable
I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا ❤️ رغم أن أريكتك كانت لديها شركة أفضل

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حفظت تلك الصورة التي التقطتها الليلة الماضية

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
It was nice having you here
It really was. I'd missed that
Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في المرة القادمة سأجد شيئاً أفضل للمشاهدة

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ضحكك في الأجزاء الخاطئة كان نصف المتعة على أي حال

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس تماماً، لقد علقت في نفس الجزء لمدة ساعة

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أن هذا هو دوري الآن

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're very good at it 😌
A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد قليل، ترسل مديرة أعمالها رسالة...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: عدت إلى محادثتك، بعد بضع دقائق...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أوه، قد أكون في المنزل متأخرة قليلاً غداً

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعض الناس من العمل يتناولون العشاء

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
Yeah
A group thing this time?
Yeah, a few of us
Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل جربت فعل أي شيء بشكل مختلف؟ 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, just let me know when you're back
I will ❤️
No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما في داعي تراقب موبايلك طول المساء

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما رح أنسى أرسل لك رسالة

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
And I did have a lovely time yesterday
You already told me 😊
I know, I just wanted to say it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف، بس حبيت أقولها مرة ثانية

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: رح أحط صحن العشاء وأدخل السرير

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
Sleep well
You too handsome. Love you ❤️
Love you too
Including blaming the controller?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بما في ذلك لوم وحدة التحكم؟

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the first thing
Very thorough 😌
What are you doing?
Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: غيرت بالفعل. سأعد شيئاً سريعاً، ثم لن أتحرك كثيراً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
{{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: سحب {{name:player}} {{name:hailey}} من السرير بعد عدة رسائل تجاهلتها

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ومع ذلك، أنت اللي لسه في السرير

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
Don’t make me come up there

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مرحباً 😊 لا يوجد إنذار اليوم، وقررت أن أرتدي ملابسي بعد الإفطار ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد كنت أحرسه طوال الصباح

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قبل أن تغادر المنزل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حسنًا، لدي الطعام، الفيلم، والغلاف الذي يناسب هذه المرة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد حزمت أمتعتك كما لو كنت ذاهبًا في رحلة صغيرة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: فقط لأنني لا أستطيع الوثوق بك في امتلاك ما يكفي من المناديل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحضر نفسك. كل شيء آخر قابل للتفاوض

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان ذلك لطيفًا بما يكفي ليجعلني أتوقف عن الشكوى

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأستمتع بالصمت طالما أنه يدوم

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ليس لفترة طويلة. أنا في طريقي ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: في العشرين دقيقة القادمة، بالتأكيد 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بعد ذلك سأذهب إلى السوق الصغيرة بجانب المخبز

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لشيء تحتاجه؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحتاج للخروج من المنزل دون أخذ نفس الطريق مرة واحدة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وأحتاج شيئاً لذيذاً لأتناوله معك لاحقاً ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ظننت أن المعكرونة كانت شيئاً لذيذاً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم. لكن المعكرونة لا تُعتبر حلوى، مهما مدحتها

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ها هي خطة بعد الظهر الخاصة بي تذهب سدى

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ستشاهد الفيلم الذي اخترته أيضاً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أذكر. لم أرتب لانقطاع غامض للكهرباء

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يبدو أن هذا يوم عطلة مشبوهة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: من الأفضل ألا تفعل. لقد وجدت أخيرًا واحدة لم تخبرني بنهايتها بعد

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حدث ذلك مرة واحدة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قلت إن الأخ بدا مشبوهًا قبل أن يتحدث حتى

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان يرتدي قفازات في الداخل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان يغسل الصحون 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تنكر مقنع

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنك الاحتفاظ بعملك كشرطي لنفسك اليوم

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم 😌 لا دوام، لا عجلة في أي مكان هذا الصباح

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وأنا متحمسة لرؤية وجهك بدلاً من التساؤل عن معنى التوقف بين الرسائل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كان التوقف في الغالب لأنني كنت أحاول إيجاد الكلمات المناسبة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أعرف. اليوم يمكنك التحدث وفمك مليء مثل أي شخص عادي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنني التعامل مع ذلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جيد. أريد بعد ظهر جميل معك، وليس اجتماعًا جادًا آخر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بدوت سعيدًا جدًا الليلة الماضية لدرجة أنني كدت أتيت فقط لرؤية تعبير وجهك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنك فحصه هذا بعد الظهر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: فتحت النافذة وأشرب قهوتي وهي لا تزال ساخنة ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنوي ذلك. من مسافة قريبة جدًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأحاول ألا أبدو متعجرفًا جدًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سيكون ذلك تغييرًا جميلًا 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل ستبقى في المنزل بعد ذلك؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لم أقرر كل المساء بعد

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا جزء مما يعجبني في اليوم

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تجربة غير مألوفة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} أرسل لي صورة لافتة صالة الألعاب earlier

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل اكتشف مكانًا آخر ليشتكي فيه من خسارته؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يبدو أنه كان يقدم اقتراحًا مفيدًا ليوم إجازتي فقط

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذه هي الطريقة التي يخدعك بها

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أخبرته أن لدي خططًا معك هذا بعد الظهر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قال أن أسألك إذا كانت طاولة هوكي الهواء تُعتبر أرض محايدة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: فقط حتى يخسر. ثم تصبح الطاولة متورطة في مؤامرة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قد أذهب لاحقًا. سأستمتع بمشاهدته يحاول تفسير ذلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا تقبل بأفضل من ثلاث بعد أن فزت بالفعل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جداً. قد أصبح صعبة العيش معي إذا تعودت على ذلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأكتب ذلك 😌📝

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الشاب من الأمس أرسل لي رسالة عن ذلك الكتاب الذي نظرنا إليه

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الذي من المتجر؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم. يبدو أن الصفحة الأولى كانت تستحق العودة إلى المنزل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد قرأت الغلاف الخلفي فقط، لذا أخبرته ألا يتفاخر بذلك بعد

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: بداية واعدة لنادي الكتاب

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: معظم الأمر هو أننا نجد طرقًا جديدة لتجنب قول أننا نريد الاستمرار في الحديث

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد لاحظت، إذن

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قد؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قد أتوقف عن كونى غير مباشر لاحقًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: في الوقت الحالي، أخبرته أنني سأقضي بعد الظهر معك. سنتحدث هذا المساء 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جيد. سأكره أن أشارك تعليقي الممتاز على الفيلم مع هاتف

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأتركه في حقيبتي. للتعليق، وليس لك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صحيح، يجب أن أرتدي ملابس حقيقية قبل أن تبيع المخبز كل ما أريده 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت لم تقرر حتى ما تريده

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لهذا السبب أحتاج إلى خيارات

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأنتظر التحقيق

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لا تأكل كل وجباتك الخفيفة قبل أن أصل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: احترس، لا زلت أقرر ماذا سأحضر لك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: في وقت لاحق من صباح ذلك اليوم

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تحديث صغير: المرأة في المخبز تذكرتني

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا يبدو لطيفًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تذكرت أنني دائمًا أقول إنني أشتري الخبز فقط

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ليس لطيفًا جدًا لدفاعك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كانت قد مدت يدها بالفعل إلى حقيبة أكبر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا بالتأكيد ليس مجرد خبز

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يوجد خبز هناك. في مكان ما

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحضرت لنا فطيرتين من التفاح، وكثير من الأشياء الأخرى تجعل المشي إلى المنزل يستحق ذلك 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تبدو سعيدًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، قضيت عشر دقائق أنظر إلى الزهور دون حساب أين يجب أن أكون بعد ذلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لم أشتري أي شيء. فقط استمتعت بوجودي هناك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يجب أن يكون لدينا المزيد من الأيام مثل هذه

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، يجب أن نفعل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأذهب إلى المنزل لأخذ الحاوية، ثم سأأتي بعد الغداء كما قلنا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الساعة الواحدة والنصف لا تزال مناسبة؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: مثالي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأضع المشروبات في الثلاجة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: واترك جانبي من الأريكة خاليًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: تبدو وكأنك قد تصالحت بالفعل مع عدم القيام بشيء

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: هل رأيت كيف تبدو مؤخرتي وأنا أرتديه؟ 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: للصالة الرياضية ولا لموعدك مع مدربك؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لازم ما تكونش بتدور على ملابس غير لائقة تانية
يا لها من ملابس رياضية ملفتة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحبًا ❤️ أنا بالكاد نزلت في الشارع وقد فكرت بالفعل في سبب آخر يجعل نظريتك عن الفيلم غير منطقية 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
The photo booth is tempting 😊
To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا، لأنني أريد أن أرى إذا كنت تستطيع أن تأخذ أربع صور دون أن تخرج وجه غريب.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: من غير المحتمل. هذا تحدٍ غير عادل للغاية.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد بضع دقائق، في كشك الصور

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تدرك أنني سأفسد واحدة على الأقل من هذه الصور.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اقترب أكثر، إذن. أحتاج كل ميزة ممكنة.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه ليست طريقة عمل أكشاك الصور.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد فات الأوان. العد التنازلي قد بدأ.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تم التقاط سلسلة من الصور الشخصية.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أريد لها أن تستمتع بالأمسية، ويمكنني الاعتراف بأنني فضولي بشأن مدى تقاربهما.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
Photo Booth Strip I
Photo Booth Strip II
You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت أخرجت وجه غريب في الأولى.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت ابتسمت في جميعها، لذا ما زلت أعتقد أنني فزت.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
Then explain the last picture
You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: والآن تم الحفاظ عليه إلى الأبد. على الرحب والسعة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أقصد الجزء الذي توقفنا فيه عن الحديث وجلسنا معًا فقط

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل ما زلت تختار لعبة البينبول بعد كل هذا؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. وما زلت لن أقضي كل المساء في تسجيل النقاط

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك فعلاً نقاط في تلك اللعبة أيضاً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
LATER, OUTSIDE
I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد نسيت كم يمكن أن يبدو الشارع صاخباً حتى عندما يكون هادئاً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: آذاني ما زالت داخل تلعب لعبة السباق

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كرامتك موجودة هناك في مكان ما أيضاً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما كنتش عارفة قد إيه افتقدتك جنب مني إلا لما كنت هناك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حتى مع أنك لن تتخلى عن ذلك أبداً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
Shall I walk with you for a bit?
Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. كنت أفكر في تحضير الشاي عندما أعود

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
That was almost an invitation
Almost?
Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل تود أن تأتي لتناول فنجان من الشاي؟ لا زلنا نملك الحلوى التي رفضت تناولها قبل عرضك الكبير

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحببت ذلك أيضًا. حتى عندما وجدت كوعك ضلوعي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ولا تسأل أين أحتفظ بالتحكم الثاني

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأذهب إلى المنزل وأستولي على الأريكة لنفسي قليلاً 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأبقى على قيد الحياة. لدي كتاب وشخص يبدو أنه قرأ أكثر مني

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. كنا نتبادل الرسائل الصغيرة منذ أن تركت منزلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تذكر أنني كنت أراك وانتظر حتى قلت إنني متفرغة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت بتاخد نصيب الأسد من الوسادة!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. كنت سأعترض على مقاطعته للنزاع المهم حول الوسائد

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أحد كان سيفهم ذلك بدون عدة صور

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: من المؤسف أنه لا يوجد فيلم وثائقي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
BACK AT HOME
Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وجدت مكاني في الكتاب. كانت لا تزال علامة الصفحة التي وضعوها في المتجر 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد أحرزت تقدمًا أكبر في المحادثة من القراءة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأجيب عليه بشكل صحيح بدلاً من التظاهر بأنني أستطيع القيام بالأمرين

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم ❤️ هذه الصورة كانت لك، بالمناسبة. لم يكسب قصة علامة الصفحة المحرجة 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في وقت لاحق من تلك الأمسية

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لدي صورتان قد تعجبك. قال إنه لا بأس أن أريك صورته أيضًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. هذه هي الابتسامة التي طلبها

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كون لطيف. تركت لك بقايا حقيقية المرة دي!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وهذه هي الصورة التي التقطها في مطبخه. أرسلها لك، دون أن أزعم أني مصورة 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل كان المئزر يهدف إلى إثبات مؤهلاته؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أن العشاء لم يستطع الابتسام للكاميرا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. ضحكت قبل أن أتمكن من التظاهر بعدم الضحك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أعلم أنك ستلاحظ تلك أولاً ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: احتفظ بها بأمان. هنتظر لم الشمل الدرامي!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هروح أقابل {{name:aiden}} بعد ما أرجع الحاوية للبيت 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أيوة. قال إنه هيكون عيب لو نصيحتك الخبيرة راحت هدر.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هو أصلاً حذرني إن واحدة من الآلات بتأكل الفلوس.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مفيد. عذر جاهز قبل ما توصل.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت مشغولة بمحاولة مشاهدته بينما كنت تتهم الجميع بشيء ما

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت عايزة أشوفه تاني، وفعلاً عمل حاجة معاه كان أحلى من محادثة حذرة تانية على القهوة.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اذهب واستمتع. لا تحتاج إلى مزيد من الإرشادات مني

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. لقد حصلت على ما يكفي من التعليمات من المحقق على الأريكة 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وصلت 🎮 يمكنك سماع هذا المكان من الرصيف

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد وصل للتو وأشار إلى آلة سباق

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
I was right about one person
I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأضع هاتفي بعيدًا. تمنى لي حظًا سعيدًا 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
INSIDE THE ARCADE
You came prepared
For what?
Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحذية عملية. هذا شخص يتوقع الفوز

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا شخص تجول في السوق هذا الصباح

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
A consolation prize already?
A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: معجنات. لا زلت أستطيع أكلها بنفسي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
No, I'll accept the apology in advance
You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تجعل من الصعب جدًا أن أكون مدروسًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شكرًا لك. كان ذلك لطيفًا منك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هو. هل ترى كم كان ذلك سهلًا؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
Only the annoying ones
That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا معظم ما لدي من مواد

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
That first point didn't count
Thorough detective work
The machine disagrees
You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد ضربتها قبل أن أكون جاهزًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت تشرح كم سيكون هذا سهلاً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
You said you'd go easy on me
And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ومن الواضح أن ذلك كان خطأ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعترف أن هناك مجالًا للعبة ثانية

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا. أنت اخترت الآلة الأولى. سأختار التالية

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
{{name:lena}} wins the first round
HAK//NOTICE
And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ومع ذلك، لم تلاحظني وأنا أسرق آخر قضمة من حلوىك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
{{name:player}} put you up to this
He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد حذرني أنك ستطلب جولة أخرى إذا خسرت

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
About knowing you too well?
About coaching the opposition
I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تمكنت من ضرب القرص بدون مساعدتكم.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت فعلت. تلك التسديدة الأخيرة كانت جيدة.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: آسفة، هل يمكنك تكرار ذلك؟ كانت الآلة تصدر ضوضاء.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
I noticed. I let you have it
I might need a moment to appreciate it
I'll give you five seconds
You really do count everything
Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل يمكنني أخذ صورة معك؟ أود أن أرسل له واحدة.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالطبع. هل ستظهر لوحة النتائج في الصورة؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: على الأقل أعطني ثانية لأبدو أقل هزيمة.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: فات الأوان. هذه هي الوجهة التي أريدها.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وافق على الصورة. التعبير هو عمله بالكامل.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
He's blaming you for warning me
Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قل له أنني أستمتع بتقاعدي من الاستماع إلى أعذاره.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
Thank you for this afternoon ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
But isn’t it weird for you?
All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: في الحقيقة، ده بيخلي الأمور أسهل
ما في داعي تخبي أي شيء

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: هي تبغى كارديو أكثر من أي شيء 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: صار شيء في غرفة الملابس لما كنا نغادر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: هي كانت تبغى تكمل الجلسة شوية أكثر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: يا رجل، ما كنت أتوقع أتكلم معك عن {{name:hailey}} بهذا الشكل 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: لكن حتى لو كان غريب... هو نوعاً ما رائع

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: أنا عارف إنكم الاثنين معجبين ببعض

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: مرحبًا 😊 أنا مدين لك بغطاء حاوية. بطريقة ما تمكنت من إحضاره إلى المنزل أيضًا 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هذا أقل بكثير من ضجيج صالة الألعاب.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ليس لديك فكرة. لقد استعدت سمعي تقريبًا. أجزاء أخرى مني أقل هدوءًا.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: تبدو سعيدًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أنا ❤️ سنترك الهواتف جانبًا لبعض الوقت.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: نتحدث لاحقًا.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بعد أن تضع هاتفها بعيدًا.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: في وقت لاحق من تلك الليلة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: إذا بقيت هكذا لفترة أطول، سأنسى أنني كنت أنوي المغادرة.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هذا ليس حادثًا.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: قميصك ارتفع.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لقد لاحظت. يمكنك إبقاء يدك هناك.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أنت تجعل الأمر صعبًا جدًا لأكون الشخص الذي يقف أولًا.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ثم قبلني مرة أخرى ثم انهض. لن آخذك إلى السرير الليلة.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لم أكن لأطلب ذلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: كنت تفكر في ذلك. وأنا أيضاً. لهذا أقولها الآن

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: قبلة عميقة أخيرة على الأريكة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: يده على خصرها، ويدها تحت حافة قميصه

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: الأمر يتقدم بسرعة، وأريد أن نواصل الحديث بصدق عما نشعر أنه مناسب.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أحببت الليلة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: حتى الجزء الهادئ؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بعد قليل، في المنزل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: خصوصاً ذلك الجزء. فمك. يديك. كل شيء

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: يمكنك المغادرة دون محاولة قول ملاحظة ذكية أخيرة، تعرف ذلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: كنت سأقول إنني أود رؤيتك مرة أخرى

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: يمكنك الاحتفاظ بتلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أرسل لي رسالة غداً. سنجد حلاً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: سأفعل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: وخذ علبة المعجنات. إذا تركتها هنا، سأقوم بأكل الباقي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: مسؤولية صعبة جداً

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بشكل ما أعتقد أنك ستتأقلم

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بعد مغادرته

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:player}}؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لقد ذهب إلى منزله. بقينا على الأريكة لفترة أطول مما خططنا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: كان الشاي فكرة ناجحة، إذن

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: جداً. تحدثنا، جلسنا قريبين، ثم جذبته إلي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: كانت يديه تحت قميصي. ويداي تحت قميصه. قبلنا حتى كان علي أن أخبره أننا لن نذهب أبعد من ذلك الليلة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أخيرًا توقف عن السؤال إذا كان أفضل منك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هذه خطوة كبيرة للأمام

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لا تخلي عدم التنافس يتحول لمنافسة 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أنا أتعلم

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: كان الإحساس مختلف الليلة. أقل شعورًا بأننا نحاول نكتشف وش المفروض يصير

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: نعم. جلبت بالخطأ غطاء حاويته إلى المنزل

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: كنت أريد يديه علي، فوضعتها هناك. ما كان يحتاج لخطاب آخر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: تبدو مرتاحًا مع هذا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: نعم. أشعر بشيء من الخجل. وأنا سعيدة أنني قضيت هذا العصر معك أيضًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أنا وحدي مرة أخرى. كانت أمسية جميلة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: تبدو سعيدًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: نعم. متعبة بطريقة لطيفة، لا زلت أشعر بالدفء، وسعيدة جدًا أنني ما قضيت يومي كله أراقب الساعة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: احتفظ بالتفاصيل التي تريد الاحتفاظ بها. أنا سعيدة أنك استمتعت

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: شكرًا. لا زلت أريد بضع دقائق معك قبل أن أنام ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أنتم الاثنين بحاجة إلى جرد

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: في وقت لاحق من تلك الليلة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: سبب للابتسامة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أخيرًا وضعت التطبيق 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هل تمكنت من قراءة أي شيء من الكتاب؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بعض الشيء. قليل جدًا بعد أن بدأنا نتحدث عن الأمس. ثم أقل بعد الصور

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: قال لي إنه كان يبحث عن عذر لعدم مغادرة المكتبة. وأنه يريد أن يلمسني بشكل صحيح

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: وأنت كنت تحاول التفكير في سبب للبقاء

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لديه ملعقتي. نحن نتفاوض

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بالضبط. يبدو أننا حللنا ذلك سوء الفهم 😌❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أصبحت الرسائل أقل حذرًا بكثير الليلة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لم يكن عليك الاستمرار في التظاهر بأنك تناقش الكتاب فقط؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لا. قلت له أنني أريد رؤيته مرة أخرى. وليس فقط الحديث

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: وأرسلنا لبعضنا البعض المزيد من الصور. ثم بعض الصور التي كانت أقل براءة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: وافق على أنني يمكنني إظهار هذين لك. أما الصور اللاحقة فتظل بينه وبينني

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: يمكنني التوسط

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هذه هي الابتسامة التي تعني عادة أنك تتظاهر بأنك لم تفعل شيئًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لقد لاحظ ذلك أيضًا. كان غير مريح بالنسبة لي. الحزام لم يكن يساعدني

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: وهذه هي الصورة التي أخذها وأعادها

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: يبدو أنكما تستمتعان بالمحادثة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: نعم، لم نقرأ كثيرًا بعد ذلك. احتفظت بالصور الأخيرة لنفسي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: يا مسكين الكتاب

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: سيتعافى. لست متأكدة إن كنت سأتعافى قبل الغد

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هل كان الحديث في الرسائل أسهل؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لقد تنازعت على نتيجة معروضة بالأرقام. لا أعتقد أنك مؤهل لذلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بعض الشيء. كنت أستطيع التفكير لثانية دون القلق من أن الصمت يبدو غريبًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لكنني أيضًا وجدت نفسي أريد سماع كيف سيقول شيئًا، وليس مجرد قراءته. وأريد يديه بدلاً من صورة أخرى

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: يبدو أن هذا سبب لموعد آخر

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: نعم. سنتحدث غدًا ونختار وقتًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: بالنسبة لليلة، لقد انتهيت من التبديل بين المحادثات

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: أود قضاء بعض الوقت معك قبل أن أنام ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لقد انتهيت من الرسائل لليلة. قضيت مساءً جميلًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هل حصل الكتاب على الكثير من الاهتمام؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هل تريد سكر؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ليس بما يكفي لأتظاهر أنني أصبحت قارئًا جادًا

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: سأحتفظ برأيي حتى تصل إلى الفصل التالي

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: شكرًا لك. سأحتفظ ببقية التفاصيل لنفسي الليلة

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: لا بأس. كيف تشعر؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: سعيدة. الجو دافئ قليلاً للنوم فورًا. ومستعدة فقط للتحدث معك لدقيقة ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: واحد، من فضلك

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هل هذه طريقتك لترتيب زيارة أخرى؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: كيف كانت أمسيّتك بعد مغادرتي؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هادئة. أنهيت ترتيب المكان، ثم لعبت لبعض الوقت

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هل علقت تفكر مرة أخرى؟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: شوي، لكن بعد الظهر ساعد أكثر من الجلوس هنا أحاول أتوقع كل شيء

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: هاك//إشعار

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And for once, no question afterward
