story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم 😊 لقد دعاني لتناول العشاء في مكانه

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يبدو أنه مستعد للدفاع عن طهيه شخصيًا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you win?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل انتصرت؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا يبدو كمساء يستحق البقاء على قيد الحياة خلال يوم العمل من أجله

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أود الذهاب. هل أنت موافقة على أن أذهب إلى منزله؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: نعم، حبيبي. أنا كذلك ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: كنت أعني ما قلته. أود أن تفعلي ما تشعرين برغبة في فعله

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أعلم. لكنني أردت أن أسألك كيف تشعرين حيال الليلة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: وأنا سعيدة لأنك فعلت. لا تحتاجين لإقناع نفسك بعدم فعل ما تريده

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حسنًا 😊 سأذهب إلى المنزل وأستعد أولاً، ثم سأذهب هناك حوالي الثامنة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: اعتني بنفسك، لكن. احتفظ بهاتفك مشحونًا وأرسل لي رسالة عندما تصل هناك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got up. Interpret that however you like
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: استيقظت. فسر ذلك كما تشاء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأفعل. لدي العنوان، ويمكنني الحصول على تاكسي للعودة متى احتجت لذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: إذا قررت البقاء بدلاً من ذلك، سأخبرك أيضًا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جيد. لا أحتاج رسالة كل خمس دقائق. أريد فقط أن أعرف أنك بخير

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I can promise ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكنني أن أعدك بذلك ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ويمكنك إخباري إذا كنت تشعرين بالتوتر مرة أخرى

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: قليلاً. لكن هذا لا يعني أنني أتمنى لو لم تذهبي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Work today?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هل لديك عمل اليوم؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لقد ساعدني أمس. أحببت أنني كنت أعلم أننا يمكن أن نكون أنفسنا معًا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يمكننا. بما في ذلك سرقتي لوسادتك ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: هذا الجزء ما كان فيه شك أبداً

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're being very calm about this
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنت هادئة جدًا بشأن هذا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أنا أبتسم لهاتفي، في الواقع 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: جيد. إذن لدينا وجوه غبية متطابقة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yours is prettier
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الأجمل هو لك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: الآن أنت تحاول فقط إبقائي هنا ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: حتى السادسة، ثم أحتاج لشراء بعض الأشياء في الطريق إلى المنزل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: صحيح، يجب أن أذهب قبل أن تتحول صباحيتي الهادئة إلى جري في الشارع

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أتمنى لك يوماً سعيداً. كل شيء جيد خلال استراحتك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at you taking over my job 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: انظر إليك تأخذين وظيفتي 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: يجب أن يذكرك أحدهم عندما تكونين مشغولة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحبك. سأرسل لك رسالة عندما أكون في المنزل وأستعد ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too. Speak tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: أحبك أيضاً. سنتحدث الليلة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأكون مشغولة معظم اليوم، فلا تتفاجأ إذا كنت هادئة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: سأحاول ألا أعتبر تركي لقائمة التسوق أمرًا شخصيًا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: لديه أشياء أقل إثارة للاهتمام ليقولها مقارنة بك 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: بعد الظهر المبكر — رتبت خططك مع {{name:hailey}} بدري كفاية عشان تكون في البيت قبل ما توصل {{name:lena}} عند الخامسة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don’t react to her nonsense
They make this look easy, while I'm still trying to name the knot in my stomach.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: يجعلان الأمر يبدو سهلًا، بينما ما زلت أحاول تسمية هذه العقدة في معدتي.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Come on, at least put on an underwear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: هيا، ارتدي ملابس داخلية على الأقل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not pull out another crazy outfit
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لا تلبسي شيء غريب مرة ثانية

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s the reward for the best coach 😌
Alright, let’s play before he nags at us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: حسناً، دعنا نلعب قبل أن يزعجنا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see if you can stay focused too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: لنرَ إن كنت تستطيع الحفاظ على تركيزك أيضًا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} kept moving on {{name:aiden}}’s lap during the games
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} استمرت في التحرك على حجر {{name:aiden}} خلال المباريات

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: LAST GAME – FIRST TO FINISH WINS EVERYTHING
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: آخر مباراة – أول من ينهي يفوز بكل شيء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m telling {{name:aiden}} not to look at you
Subject claiming victory under unusual circumstances
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: الموضوع يدعي النصر في ظروف غير عادية

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} claimed {{name:aiden}} finished first during the last game
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} ادعت أن {{name:aiden}} أنهى أولاً خلال المباراة الأخيرة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: These are honestly the best game afternoons
Looking forward to the next one
I'm glad she isn't hiding what she wants, but I need to be honest about my feelings too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: يسعدني أنها لا تخفي ما تريده، لكنني أحتاج أن أكون صادقًا بشأن مشاعري أيضًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Man I was really looking forward to playing again 🔥
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: يا رجل، كنت متحمسة للعب مرة ثانية 🔥

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:ethan}} already came to pick me up
Do you want me to wait for you for dinner?
At least I won’t have to eat alone with {{name:mason}} like last time
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: على الأقل ما راح أكل وحدي مع {{name:mason}} مثل المرة الماضية

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:lena}} is staying over tonight. I'll leave you a plate for when you get back.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:lena}} ستبقى الليلة. سأترك لك طبقاً عندما تعود.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks. Save me some dessert too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: شكراً. احتفظ لي ببعض الحلوى أيضاً.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Finally home, and I'm getting ready to leave in a little while. How was your day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحباً 😊 أخيراً في المنزل، وأنا أستعد للمغادرة بعد قليل. كيف كان يومك؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not tonight. I came over, I didn’t come to sleep here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ليس الليلة. جئت هنا، لم أتيت لأنام هنا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a shame. He gets you after this?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يا للأسف. هل سيأخذك بعد هذا؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He gets a message that I got home. You get to message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سيحصل على رسالة أنني عدت إلى المنزل. يمكنك مراسلتي غداً

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll take that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأقبل ذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Walk me to the door without a clever last remark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. امشِ بي إلى الباب بدون تعليق ذكي في النهاية

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد أن تعود إلى المنزل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay the night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحباً ❤️ أنا في المنزل. لم أبقِ الليل هنا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شكراً لأنك أخبرتني

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen, rather than leave you guessing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم نذهب إلى النهاية. أردت أن أخبرك بما حدث، بدلاً من تركك تخمن

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تبدين جميلة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed on the sofa. Then he put his hand under my dress and fingered me until I came
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد العشاء، قبلنا على الأريكة. ثم وضع يده تحت فستاني ولمسني حتى وصلت

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I went down on him after. He came in my mouth. I swallowed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نزلت عليه بعد ذلك. جاء في فمي. ابتلعت

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I came home. That was the whole of it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم عدت إلى المنزل. كان هذا كل شيء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف تشعرين؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A little flushed. Glad I went, and glad I left when I meant to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سعيدة. أشعر بالخجل قليلاً. سعيدة لأنني ذهبت، وسعيدة لأنني رحلت عندما كنت أريد

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was my decision. I wasn’t trying to get to some next step because I thought I should
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كانت قراري. ما كنت أحاول الوصول لخطوة جديدة لأنني شعرت أنه يجب علي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you know how you feel about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة أنك تعرف كيف تشعر حيال ذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. He spent half the evening trying to work out whether he was doing better than you. I didn’t answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفعل. قضى نصف المساء يحاول معرفة ما إذا كان أفضل منك. لم أجب

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s probably kinder than a ranking
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا ربما ألطف من التصنيف

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the idea 😌 And I wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كانت هذه هي الفكرة 😌 وأردت دقيقة معك قبل أن أنام ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the answer I was hoping for ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كانت تلك هي الإجابة التي كنت آملها ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the rest of the details to myself tonight, like we talked about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة. سأحتفظ ببقية التفاصيل لنفسي الليلة، مثلما تحدثنا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s okay. Knowing you’re home and comfortable is enough
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا بأس. معرفة أنك في المنزل ومريح يكفي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. I still wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا كذلك. لكني حبيت دقيقة معك قبل ما أنام ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد قليل، في منزله

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm here 😊 Found the right building and everything's fine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا هنا 😊 وجدت المبنى الصحيح وكل شيء على ما يرام

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. How’s the evening looking?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. كيف تبدو الأمسية؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were there other acceptable answers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل كانت هناك إجابات مقبولة أخرى؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells like dinner rather than smoke, so I’m choosing to be optimistic 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تبدو رائحة العشاء بدلاً من الدخان، لذلك سأختار أن أكون متفائلة 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please tell me you didn’t open with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: من فضلك قل لي أنك لم تبدأ بذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I said hello first
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا. قلت مرحباً أولاً

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very diplomatic
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دبلوماسي جداً

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s setting the table. Here, your promised proof that I arrived
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هو يقوم بإعداد الطاولة. ها هي، دليلك الموعود أنني وصلت

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, smiling, and not about to be poisoned by a burnt pizza 😊
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: آمنة، مبتسمة، ولن أسمح لأنفسي أن أسمم ببيتزا محترقة 😊

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m reassured about at least two of those things
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا مطمئن بشأن اثنين من تلك الأشياء على الأقل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t start 😭 I’m good, really
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تبدأ 😭 أنا بخير، حقًا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy yourself, sweetheart. I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: استمتع، حبيبي. أنا هنا إذا احتجت أي شيء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Several. Yours was the best one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: عدة. كانت إجابتك هي الأفضل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I’ll check in later. I’m putting my phone away now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شكرًا لك ❤️ سأتحقق لاحقًا. سأضع هاتفي بعيدًا الآن

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد أن تضع هاتفها بعيدًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You found it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وجدته

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: First try. Of course
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: المحاولة الأولى. بالطبع

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I would have come down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت سأهبط

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That’s why I didn’t text you from the pavement
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. لهذا السبب لم أرسل لك رسالة من الرصيف

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks much better than the dinner you carefully left out of your photograph
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو ذلك أفضل بكثير من العشاء الذي تركته بعناية خارج صورتك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was going to lead with an apology
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت سأبدأ باعتذار

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m joking. You can stop apologizing for one burnt pizza
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أمزح. يمكنك التوقف عن الاعتذار عن بيتزا محترقة واحدة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I’ll stop. Sit. I set your side already
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذن سأتوقف. اجلس. لقد أعددت جانبك بالفعل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get there safely, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وصل هناك بأمان، عزيزي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My side. We’ve had one bookshop and a lot of messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جانبي. كان لدينا مكتبة واحدة والعديد من الرسائل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was paying attention
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أتابع

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أثناء العشاء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How have you been?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف حالك؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than I expected to be. Work was busy. This is the first part of today that feels like mine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل مما كنت أتوقع. كان العمل مشغولاً. هذه هي أول جزء من اليوم يشعر بأنه لي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your boyfriend?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وصديقك؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s all right. Quieter than he lets on. He spends a lot of time deciding what he’s allowed to want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هو بخير. أهدأ مما يظهر. يقضي الكثير من الوقت في تحديد ما يُسمح له برغبته.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds tiring
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو أن ذلك مرهق.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It is, for him. He used to plan everything so nothing could surprise him. He’s trying not to do that with me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم، بالنسبة له. كان يخطط لكل شيء حتى لا يفاجئه شيء. يحاول ألا يفعل ذلك معي.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you’re here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل يعرف أنك هنا؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. You'll get your arrival message, I haven't forgotten
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأفعل. ستتلقى رسالة وصولك، لم أنسَ.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I told him I arrived. He doesn’t need a transcript of the dinner
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. أخبرته أنني وصلت. لا يحتاج إلى نص العشاء.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fair. I wouldn’t want one of his evenings either
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: منصف. لا أود أن أكون في واحدة من أمسياته أيضًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’d be surprised what you’d recognize
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ستتفاجأ بما يمكنك التعرف عليه.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: عذرًا؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing. The sauce. This is actually recognizable. I’m impressed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا شيء. الصلصة. هذا في الواقع يمكن التعرف عليه. أنا معجبة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t sound so surprised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تبدو متفاجئًا جدًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m allowed to be surprised. You sent me a picture of your face instead of the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يحق لي أن أكون متفاجئة. أرسلت لي صورة لوجهك بدلاً من الطعام.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The food didn’t know what to do with its face
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الطعام لم يعرف ماذا يفعل بوجهه.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If you’re going to stare, you can at least feed me the next bite
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذا كنت ستحدق، يمكنك على الأقل إطعامي اللقمة التالية.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Open, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: افتح، إذن.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Now we’re even with last night’s photos
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هي. الآن نحن متساويان مع صور الليلة الماضية.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don’t think we’re even
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا أعتقد أننا متساويان.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so proud. You still have sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تبدو فخورًا جدًا. لا زال لديك صلصة على إبهامك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could deal with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنك التعامل مع ذلك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat first. You’re very easy to distract
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كل أولاً. أنت سهل جدًا في التشتت.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came over. I’m allowed to be distracted
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد جئت. يحق لي أن أكون مشغولة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I came over for dinner. The rest can wait until the plates are clear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جئت لتناول العشاء. يمكن أن تنتظر البقية حتى تتضح الأطباق.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد العشاء.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought the book
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت جلبت الكتاب.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought the book. I’ve even made it past the bookmark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا جلبت الكتاب. لقد تجاوزت حتى علامة الصفحة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s more than I expected
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا أكثر مما توقعت.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t get used to it. I read one page on the way here and then thought about you instead
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تتعود على ذلك. قرأت صفحة واحدة في الطريق هنا ثم فكرت فيك بدلاً من ذلك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a better review than the book was going to get
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه مراجعة أفضل مما كان سيحصل عليه الكتاب.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here, I marked the page I wanted to talk to you about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هنا، لقد وضعت علامة على الصفحة التي أردت التحدث إليك عنها.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can talk about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكننا التحدث عن ذلك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actually, the book can wait. I didn’t come here just to compare notes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في الواقع، يمكن أن ينتظر الكتاب. لم أتيت هنا فقط لمقارنة الملاحظات.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تعال هنا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Beyond the Messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما وراء الرسائل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s what I was trying to say without typing it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا ما كنت أحاول قوله دون كتابته.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit. I want my hand on you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اجلس. أريد يدي عليك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so surprised. Last night’s photos were the warning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تبدو متفاجئًا جدًا. كانت صور الليلة الماضية هي التحذير.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her Hand
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يدها

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Slower. Yes, like that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ببطء. نعم، هكذا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your turn. I want your mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دورك. أريد فمك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: His Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: فمه

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها هنا. لا تتوقف.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا قريبة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She Comes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هي تأتي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. That was really good
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسنًا. كان ذلك جيدًا حقًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still got it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما زلت أملكها

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Quiet. I got outside for a bit, then came back to the incredibly demanding task of doing nothing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هادئ. خرجت قليلاً، ثم عدت إلى المهمة الشاقة المتمثلة في عدم فعل أي شيء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shut up
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اخرس

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not staying the night. I should go while I still mean that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أبقى الليلة. يجب أن أذهب بينما لا زلت أعني ذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: راسلني غدًا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ربما

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد أن تعود إلى المنزل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مرحبًا ❤️ أنا في المنزل. لم أبقَ

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Thank you for letting me know
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تمام. شكرًا لأنك خبرتني

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم نذهب إلى النهاية. أردت أن أخبرك بما حدث

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed by the window. I used my hand on him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد العشاء، قبلنا بجانب النافذة. استخدمت يدي عليه

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد قليل، في منزله

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he went down on me until I came. I came home after that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم نزل لي حتى جئت. عدت إلى المنزل بعد ذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling about it?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف حاسس حيال هذا؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Happy I went, and happy I didn’t keep everything behind a screen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. سعيدة أنني ذهبت، وسعيدة أنني لم أحتفظ بكل شيء خلف الشاشة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تحدثنا خلال العشاء أولاً. عندما قررت، كنت أعلم أن هذا ما أريده. كنت أعلم أيضًا أنني أريد النوم في سريري الخاص

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيد إنك حسيت بالراحة معه

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: حسيت. العشاء كان جيد كمان، إذا كنت لسه قلقان من هالشي 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بوقف تجهيز خطة إنقاذ المطعم، إذن

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: احتفظ بالخطة. ممكن نحتاجها لأنفسنا في وقت ما ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا عند {{name:aiden}} 😊 كل شيء تمام، كما وعدت.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا سعيدة. سأحتفظ بالتفاصيل لنفسي الليلة، لكنني أردت أن تعرف أنني عدت إلى المنزل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذا تمام. ما تحتاج تخبرني أكثر من كذا

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شكرًا لك ❤️ كانت قرارًا جيدًا أن أذهب

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت؟ كيف حالك؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found it easily?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل وجدته بسهولة؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: احتجت لحظة قبل ما أجاوب، لكن أنا بخير

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: الجو مختلف الآن بعد ما صرنا هنا. أفضل أقول كذا بدل ما أتصنع إني ما أتوتر

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل لو تقول كمان. تحبني أتصل؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا، أنا سعيد إننا نتحدث. بس احتجت لحظة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تمام. تقدر تخبرني إذا تغير هذا ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: راح أخبرك. أنا سعيد إنك قضيت مساء جيد

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وأنت؟ كيف حالك؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I liked seeing your message come in
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. أحببت رؤية رسالتك تصل.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. فتح الباب وهو يحمل طبقين.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re very sweet tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت لطيف جدًا الليلة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have my moments 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لدي لحظاتي 🙂.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت كذلك. أكثر مما أعتقد أحيانًا ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll try not to ruin this one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأحاول ألا أفسد هذه.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحبك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you too ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحبك أيضًا ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأرسل لك رسالة في الصباح، قبل أن تبدأ في وضع خطط للاحتفاظ بملعقتي.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought it was mine now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كنت أعتقد أنها أصبحت لي الآن.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالطبع لا. ولا جانبي من الأريكة 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أطباق حقيقية. كنت أستعد نفسيًا للأكل مباشرة من علبة الطعام 😭.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كلاهما بأمان. احصل على بعض النوم، عزيزي.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thanks again for all of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وشكرًا مرة أخرى على كل ذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا تشكرني. كنا نريد ذلك. أنا سعيدة أننا نفعل هذا معًا ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبح على خير

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تصبح على خير ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s making an effort, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إذًا، هو يبذل جهدًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يبدو ذلك. صورة سريعة بينما يضعهم.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: آمنة، في الداخل، وعلى وشك أن أُطعم 😊 يمكنك التوقف عن التساؤل إذا كنت قد ضعت.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: شكرًا لإخباري. استمتع بليلتك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please accept my sympathy 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يرجى قبول تعاطفي 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأفعل ❤️ سأضع هاتفي الآن. نتحدث لاحقًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا هنا إذا احتجت أي شيء.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد أن تضع هاتفها بعيدًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have I passed the inspection?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل نجحت في الفحص؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قلت إنني وصلت. لم أكن أكتب مراجعة لمنزلك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. الكرسي الذي عليه كل شيء سيخسرني نجمة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد لاحظت.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you did
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بالطبع فعلت.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قال لي أن أستمتع بليلة جيدة. يمكنك البدء بإطعامي.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: اشتريت العشاء في الطريق إلى المنزل. لا أpretend أنني تعلمت الطهي فجأة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was work?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كيف كانت العمل؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: صادق ومنظم. هذه تركيبة غير متوقعة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: احترس. إذا أضفت مجاملة أخرى، سأعتقد أنك تحب أن تكون هنا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب ذلك. يمكنك قبول ذلك دون الحاجة لبناء خطاب كامل حوله.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll get the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: سأحضر الطعام.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excellent decision
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: قرار ممتاز.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أثناء العشاء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re watching my mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تراقب فمي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re taking too long. Open
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تأخذ وقتًا طويلاً. افتح

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل يُطعم بهذه الطريقة، أم أن هذه خدمة خاصة؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re stalling
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تتأخر

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: مشغولة بما يكفي لأجد قهوتي باردة كلما تذكرتها

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: والآن لديك صلصة على إبهامك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then deal with it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ثم تعامل مع ذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بكل سرور. هو لا يحصل على هذه الجزئية، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كل. ثم يمكنك أن تكون مزعجًا في مكان أكثر فائدة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بعد العشاء.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: انتظر، هل هذه الشريط من كشك الصور؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It looked better there than in my pocket
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كان يبدو أفضل هناك من جيبي.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: وضعت الصورة التي عينيك مغلقتين في المقدمة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn’t looking at the camera
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم أكن أنظر إلى الكاميرا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أذكر ذلك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لكن كل شيء في قائمتي تم، وهاتفي مشحون

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to turn it around?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل تريدني أن أقلبها؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. Leave it there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا. اتركها هناك.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’ve gone quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لقد أصبحت هادئًا.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحب أنك احتفظت بها في مكان سترى فيه.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أحببت المساء. كان من الواضح الاحتفاظ بالصور.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a nice answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: كانت تلك إجابة لطيفة.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: يمكنني أحيانًا إدارة واحدة. أفضل من إحاطة؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here before you spoil it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تعال هنا قبل أن تفسدها.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هنا؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know what I mean
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت تعرف ما أعنيه

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound pleased to have the evening back
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تبدو سعيداً لاستعادة المساء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No Need for a Score
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا حاجة لنتيجة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was that the reward for a nice answer?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل كانت هذه المكافأة على إجابة لطيفة؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لا. كان ذلك لأنني أردت أن أقبلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أفضل من ذلك. هل يُقبل بهذه الطريقة بعد العشاء؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: توقف عن الكلام. اجلس، وابقِ يديك حيث وضعتها

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the dress?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تحت الفستان؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ON THE SOFA
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: على الأريكة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Two fingers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: إصبعان؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Slow, then less slow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: نعم. ببطء، ثم أقل بطء

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جداً. دعني أريك شيئاً قبل أن أضع حذائي

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أخبرني إذا كنت أفضل مما هو عليه

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not answering that. Keep going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لن أجيب على ذلك. استمر

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the Dress
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: تحت الفستان

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هناك. لا تجرؤ على تسجيل ذلك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنت قريب

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. لا تتوقف

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sound. Does he get that too?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ذاك الصوت. هل يشعر بذلك أيضاً؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit back. My turn
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: استلقِ. دوري الآن

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HER TURN
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: دورها

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don’t have to—
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ما عليك—

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I want to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أعرف. أريد أن

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هل هذه هي اللحظة التي أخسر فيها أمامه عمداً؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: هذه هي اللحظة التي تتوقف فيها عن الكلام. يديك في شعري. لا تسحبني إلا إذا قلت لك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Between His Knees
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: بين ركبتيه

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أنا قريبة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Stay there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: جيد. ابق هناك

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In Her Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: في فمها

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn’t have to swallow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: لم يكن عليك أن تبتلع

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: أردت ذلك. لا تتظاهر بالسرور

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ابق

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ها 😊 تمكنت من الظهور وكأن لدي أكثر من عشرين دقيقة للاستعداد

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s to reward me for being so attentive to my studies 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: إنها مكافأة لي لأنني منتبهة جدًا لدراستي 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I still have the rest of the reward to enjoy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: لا زال عندي بقية المكافأة للاستمتاع بها

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You really sent that to him?
How did the practice test go?
She seems sure of herself here, and I'm still learning what that means for me.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: تبدو واثقة من نفسها هنا، وما زلت أتعلم ما يعنيه ذلك لي.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:ethan}} giving cunnilingus as a reward after the successful practice test
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:ethan}} يقوم بعمل cunnilingus كمكافأة بعد اختبار الممارسة الناجح

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Careful… if you finish too early you’ll get penalty points
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: احترس... إذا خلصت بسرعة، رح تحصل على نقاط عقوبة

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not only good at studies…
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: أنت مو بس جيد في الدراسة...

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For the next lessons… what’s the objective?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: بالنسبة للدروس القادمة... ما هو الهدف؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we’ll have to go deeper into the subjects
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: لكن لازم نغوص أعمق في المواضيع

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I’m really looking forward to going deeper into all of that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: إذاً، أنا متحمسة حقًا للغوص أعمق في كل ذلك 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But I passed it with flying colors 😌
Not too disappointed you didn’t get the punishment?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: مو زعلانة إنك ما حصلت على العقوبة؟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did you enjoy this little day?
The part where you watched everything during the game session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: الجزء اللي كنتي تتفرجي فيه على كل شيء خلال جلسة اللعبة 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Looking forward to the next training session 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: - هايدي: مش عارفة... يمكن نلاقي شي يناسبنا الاثنين.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: If you admit properly I’ll show you something even better
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: إذا اعترفت بشكل صحيح، راح أوريك شيء أفضل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look what your best friend left me like when he left
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: شوفي كيف تركني أفضل صديق لك لما رحل

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where I sent you a photo of my reward 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: الجزء اللي أرسلت لك فيه صورة مكافأتي 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And that’s the kind of crazy you love
Be ready to see even more
I don’t know what you’re talking about
Too bad… I had another surprise for you if you liked it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: يا للأسف... كان عندي مفاجأة ثانية لك لو عجبتك
- هايدي: مش عارفة... يمكن نلاقي شي يناسبنا الاثنين.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: For finally admitting it, you get a reward too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: لأنك اعترفت أخيراً، تحصل على مكافأة أيضاً

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: بعد وضع هاتفك، تستقر بجانب {{name:lena}} وتغفو معاً.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Good morning ☀️
Trying to wake up slowly
Of course you are 😏
I swear you never rest your thumbs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أقسم أنك لا ترتاح أبداً من إبهاميك

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're happy when my fingers are used to text you, no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أنت سعيد عندما تُستخدم أصابعي لكتابة الرسائل لك، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true ❤️
By the way…
About the tickets for our trip
I don't even know what to do with them now
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: لا أعرف حتى ماذا أفعل بهم الآن

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What do you think I should do?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ماذا تعتقد أنه يجب علي فعله؟

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Give them to someone who really needs a break
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أعطهم لشخص يحتاج حقًا إلى استراحة

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and why not go with {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: احتفظ بهم ولماذا لا تذهب مع {{name:aiden}}؟

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and find someone else to go with
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: احتفظ بهم وابحث عن شخص آخر للذهاب معه

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Hey you 🙂
That's actually really kind of you 😊
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: هذا في الواقع لطيف جدًا منك 😊

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You always try to do the right thing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أنت دائمًا تحاول القيام بالشيء الصحيح

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I am, look at how much luck I have these days thanks to karma 😅
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: بالطبع أنا كذلك، انظر إلى مدى حظي هذه الأيام بفضل الكارما 😅

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Well having me as your girlfriend is not good enough?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: حسناً، هل وجودي كصديقتك ليس كافياً؟

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It is! I'm the luckiest man in the world ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: إنه كذلك! أنا أسعد رجل في العالم ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Really?
I swear
I'm also the luckiest girl in the world
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أنا أيضًا أسعد فتاة في العالم

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
For having a vegetable as your man? Not sure about that 😄
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: هل من الجيد أن يكون لديك خضار كرجل؟ لست متأكدًا من ذلك 😄

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You know how much I love vegetables 😉
You're too sweet
With {{name:aiden}}?
Why?
He always wanted to go to that island and at least he has his two legs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: لقد أراد دائمًا الذهاب إلى تلك الجزيرة وعلى الأقل لديه ساقاه الاثنتان

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't think I will be very comfortable going alone with him
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: لا أعتقد أنني سأكون مرتاحًا جدًا للذهاب معه بمفردي.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm okay
Even if he is my friend and your best friend, it feels weird no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: حتى لو كان صديقي وأفضل أصدقائك، يبدو الأمر غريبًا، أليس كذلك؟

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Now that you said it like that I guess it does
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: الآن بعد أن قلت ذلك، أعتقد أنه كذلك.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I trust you both and I don't want you to miss the trip just because of me and at the same time he will finally have the trip to the island he wanted so much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: لكنني أثق بكما ولا أريد أن تفوتا الرحلة بسببى وفي نفس الوقت سيكون لديه أخيرًا الرحلة إلى الجزيرة التي أرادها كثيرًا

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're right I'm thinking too much
And it is in more than a month so I got time to think about it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: وما زال أمامي أكثر من شهر لذا لدي وقت للتفكير في ذلك

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Exactly
You won't be jealous?
Of course I will
My best friend going to the vacation we prepared and spending time with my girlfriend in my place, who on earth won't be jealous!
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أفضل صديق لي سيذهب في عطلة، نحن حضرنا وقضينا وقتًا مع صديقتي في منزلي، من على وجه الأرض لن يشعر بالغيرة!

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true, and sweet it shows that you care a lot about me ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: هذا صحيح، ومن الجميل أنه يظهر أنك تهتم بي كثيرًا ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What about you?
That's called love
You're too much of a sweet talker
Only with you ❤️
You better 😌
Someone else?
That feels a little cold 😕
Sorry I didn't mean it that way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: آسف لم أقصد ذلك بهذه الطريقة

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm good 😊
It's more like you need to find someone else who would like to go to the island with you so you can enjoy the trip even if it's not with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: الأمر أشبه بأنك بحاجة للعثور على شخص آخر يرغب في الذهاب إلى الجزيرة معك حتى تتمكن من الاستمتاع بالرحلة حتى لو لم تكن معي

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Yeah…
You're upset?
No
I mean I just wasn't expecting you to say something like that
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أعني، لم أكن أتوقع منك أن تقول شيئًا مثل ذلك

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why? I did not mean it in a bad way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: لماذا؟ لم أقصد ذلك بطريقة سيئة

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know sorry I made a big deal out of nothing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أعرف، آسف لقد جعلت من لا شيء صفقة كبيرة

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's just that I'm sad that I won't go with you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أنا فقط حزينة لأنني لن أذهب معك

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Me too and you know it
But next time as soon as I'm healed we will go together ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: لكن في المرة القادمة، بمجرد أن أتعافى، سنذهب معًا ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Still in bed actually 🛌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ما زلت في السرير في الواقع 🛌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I hope so
Promise
Also
I’m coming over today
Sasha and I postponed our plans, so I can spend the day with you 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أجّلنا أنا وساشا خططنا، لذا يمكنني قضاء اليوم معك 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You really don’t have to come all the way here on your only day off
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ليس عليك حقًا أن تأتي إلى هنا في يوم عطلتك الوحيد.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don’t want you to feel like you have to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: لا أريدك أن تشعر أنك مضطر إلى

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know
But I want to
I miss you
And I’d come anyway even if you tried to stop me 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: وسأأتي على أي حال حتى لو حاولت إيقافي 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Thank you
That really means a lot
See you in half an hour ❤️
5 MINUTES LATER
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أحتفظ بملابس الليلة الماضية لموعد خروجي الجديد مع ساشا. الخطط تتغير، والاختيارات الجيدة تبقى.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أحتفظ بملابس الليلة الماضية لموعد خروجي الجديد مع ساشا. الخطط تتغير، والاختيارات الجيدة تبقى.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And what are you doing?
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: أحتفظ بملابس الليلة الماضية لموعد خروجي الجديد مع ساشا. الخطط تتغير، والاختيارات الجيدة تبقى.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Playing on the PlayStation

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you awake?
It’s going to be okay. Don’t overthink it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: سيكون كل شيء على ما يرام. لا تفكر في الأمر كثيرًا.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: And if something happens, we’ll figure out a solution together
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: وإذا حدث شيء، سنجد حلاً معًا

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Yes..  you're right
By the way, {{name:lena}} is coming over today
That’s good
You shouldn’t stay alone too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: لا ينبغي عليك البقاء وحدك لفترة طويلة

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’ll come by later and air your room a little
It needs fresh air anyway
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: إنه يحتاج إلى هواء نقي على أي حال

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Thank you
You’re welcome
How is the leg this morning?
It’s okay. Still a little stiff
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: لا بأس. لا زلت متصلبًا قليلاً.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: That’s normal
Just don’t try to be brave and overdo it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: فقط لا تحاول أن تكون شجاعًا وتبالغ في الأمر

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How are you?
I’m alright
Stress is starting to get to me about going back to work, but I’ll manage
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: بدأ الضغط يؤثر عليّ بشأن العودة إلى العمل، لكنني سأدبر الأمر

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You don’t need to worry about me
Are you sure?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do one chill match later, no ranked sweat
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: قم بلعب مباراة مريحة لاحقًا، بدون ضغط التصنيف.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: One game later if you want. Doctor mode orders
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: لعبة واحدة لاحقًا إذا كنت تريد. أوامر وضع الطبيب

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Ping me if your leg hurts later
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: راسلني إذا كانت ساقك تؤلمك لاحقًا

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you actually doing this morning?
Head is still heavy from yesterday
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: ما زال رأسي ثقيلاً من البارحة

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I almost called because your replies were slow
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: كنت على وشك الاتصال لأن ردودك كانت بطيئة

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: If those guys ever show up again, I swear I'll break their...
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: إذا ظهر هؤلاء الرجال مرة أخرى، أقسم أنني سأكسر...

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Forget it, bad idea. I am trying to stay calm
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: انسَ الأمر، فكرة سيئة. أحاول البقاء هادئًا.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Stop acting like everything is an attack
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: توقف عن التصرف وكأن كل شيء هو هجوم

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I was just asking because I've seen you going more often lately
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: كنت أسأل فقط لأنني رأيتك تذهب أكثر في الآونة الأخيرة

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I'm getting in shape and it takes work
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: أنا أعمل على تحسين لياقتي ويتطلب ذلك جهدًا

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: And don't blame the leg for all of it
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: ولا تلوم الساق على كل شيء

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I know what my body looks like
Right now I can't do any sport
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: الآن لا أستطيع ممارسة أي رياضة

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: But when I'm healed, I'll get back in shape
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: لكن عندما أتعافى، سأعود إلى لياقتي

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: If you see her, tell her I want it back before lunch
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: إذا رأيتها، قل لها أريدها مرة أخرى قبل الغداء

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: You're going to the gym today?
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: هل ستذهب إلى الصالة الرياضية اليوم؟

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: In my '{{name:hailey}} owes me one' book
Thanks for dealing with my rugby mess yesterday 🏉
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: شكرًا لتعاملك مع فوضى الرجبي الخاصة بي أمس 🏉

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: I know I kind of dropped it on you like a little menace 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: أعلم أنني تركتها عليك كأنني شقي صغير 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: You made it sound like a house emergency
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: لقد جعلت الأمر يبدو كأنه حالة طارئة في المنزل

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: Or I'll climb through the window
I'm really fast when I want something
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: أنا سريع حقًا عندما أريد شيئًا

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: And I want to see youuu

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: And I can move a little by myself already
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: وأستطيع أن أتحرك قليلاً بمفردي بالفعل
يحتاج الأمر فقط إلى مزيد من الوقت

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: I just don’t want you to push it and hurt yourself because nobody is around
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: أنا فقط لا أريدك أن تضغط على نفسك وتؤذي نفسك لأنه لا أحد حولك

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So ask if you need anything
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: لذا اسأل إذا كنت بحاجة إلى أي شيء

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Everything is folded. I’ll give it to you when {{name:lena}} is gone
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: كل شيء مطوي. رح أعطيك إياه لما تروح {{name:lena}}.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Also, don’t forget. I start work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: أيضًا، لا تنسَ. سأبدأ العمل مرة أخرى غدًا

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So in the afternoon I won’t be here to help you
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: لذا في فترة بعد الظهر لن أكون هنا لمساعدتك

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: But {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} will be here to help me

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Did you hurt yourself when you came to open the door?
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: هل جُرحت عندما جئت لفتح الباب؟
في المرة القادمة لا تفعل ذلك

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’ll call {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} if they’re there
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: رح أتصل بـ {{name:hailey}} أو {{name:evelyn}} إذا كانوا موجودين.
همم... كن حذرًا في المرة القادمة

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Anyway, I’m sending you the photos I took today 📸
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: على أي حال، سأرسل لك الصور التي التقطتها اليوم 📸

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: And send me the ones you took 😏
And if I did… I’d keep them for myself 😌
I don’t care 😤 Send them or I curse you forever
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: لا يهمني 😤 أرسلهم أو ألعنك إلى الأبد

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Oh wow 😳 You took more than I thought
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: أوه واو 😳 لقد أخذت أكثر مما كنت أعتقد

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I look ugly… you should delete them
You’re the most beautiful girl I know ❤️
But thank you… that means a lot 🥺
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: لكن شكرًا لك... هذا يعني الكثير 🥺

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Thank you for taking care of me today
Stop… that’s too many compliments 😅, but i feel the same
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: توقف... هذه الكثير من المجاملات 😅، لكنني أشعر بنفس الشيء

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’m going to take a shower now 🚿

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: أرسل لي صورة سيلفي في الدش؟ 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: In the shower? You never stop!
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: في الدش؟ أنت لا تتوقف أبداً!

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: It was the best part of my week

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: But seriously, if you need water, food, or someone to reach a shelf because your leg is being dramatic, just say it 🤍
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: لكن بجد، إذا كنت بحاجة إلى ماء، طعام، أو شخص ليصل إلى رف لأن ساقك تتصرف بشكل درامي، فقط قل ذلك 🤍

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Try not to abuse the service though 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: حاول ألا تسيء استخدام الخدمة على الرغم من ذلك 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me she starts work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: {{name:evelyn}} قالت لي إنها ترجع تشتغل بكرة.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: So if you need something while she's out, she said you'll have to beg for my help 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: لذا إذا كنت بحاجة إلى شيء بينما هي خارج المنزل، قالت أنه سيتعين عليك التوسل لمساعدتي 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: That sounds surprisingly unlike something {{name:evelyn}} would say
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: يبدو أن هذا بعيد بشكل مدهش عن شيء {{name:evelyn}} قد يقوله

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: She said it, I was there 😌
Alright, alright, maybe she didn't say anything about begging 😇

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm still sorry I can't really help

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: أخبار جيدة، لا أعمل الليلة أو الليلة القادمة

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: ركز فقط على التعافي، هذا هو الشيء الأكثر أهمية الآن

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for everything you do

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: آسف لأنني عبء عليك الآن

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't say that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا تقل ذلك

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You are not a burden
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: أنت لست عبئًا

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And none of this is your fault
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: وليس هذا خطأك

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You just need time to recover, that's all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: تحتاج فقط إلى بعض الوقت للتعافي، هذا كل شيء

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: بعد العشاء الليلة، يمكننا قضاء بعض الوقت معًا إذا أردت 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd love that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: سأحب ذلك

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we'll do that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: إذن سنفعل ذلك

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'll finally have some free time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: لذا سأكون أخيرًا لدي بعض الوقت الحر

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: أظن أنني سأستغله لتنظيف البيت وغسل بعض الملابس

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you have anything that needs washing too?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل لديك أي شيء يحتاج إلى غسيل أيضًا؟

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، لدي بعض الأشياء.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But are you sure you don't need help?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: لكن هل أنت متأكد أنك لا تحتاج إلى مساعدة؟

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: No, don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: لا، لا تقلق

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to rest until you're fully healed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: تحتاج إلى الراحة حتى تتعافى تمامًا

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure ?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: هل أنت متأكد؟

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: نعم، أعلم أنك تريد المساعدة لكن يمكنني التعامل مع هذا

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Are you almost done in the bathroom?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Also yes I did the worksheet before leaving

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Professor would probably materialize from the shadows if I skipped it

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I do have good ideas sometimes

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No bar
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: لا بار

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No late nights forced by a manager

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Meeting people?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For what?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: People pay just to talk?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Some people feel really lonely

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling today?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: They want company without pressure
